title: Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild
summary: Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR) is central to deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world embodied tasks, yet remains inadequately evaluated. Existing benchmarks primarily assess spatial reasoning in static images or synthetic indoor environments, where semantic shortcuts often suffice, making it difficult to faithfully evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities in the wild. In light of this, we present Lost on Campus, a benchmark for evaluating ESR in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed by 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our benchmark introduces a unified reasoning-action evaluation framework that seamlessly integrates diagnostic QA for isolated reasoning with closed-loop interactive navigation for active reasoning under multimodal instructions. To enable fine-grained diagnosis, we evaluate six capability aspects of ESR: action grounding, spatial foresight, metric awareness, goal-directed planning, ego-allocentric localization, and spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments reveal that: (i) Compared to indoor settings, real-world outdoor environments impose substantially higher demands on spatial reasoning, where existing models exhibit poor performance; (ii) VLMs still struggle with fine-grained visual alignment, with failures in spatial foresight and ego-allocentric localization emerging as primary bottlenecks; (iii) Improving multimodal interaction capabilities and long-term spatial reasoning is crucial for advancing embodied intelligence. These findings highlight that faithful evaluation of ESR demands benchmarks tightly coupling perception, reasoning and action within realistic and continuous environments.

AI.title_zh: 迷失校园：评估视觉语言模型在真实开放环境中的具身空间推理
AI.abstract_zh: 具身空间推理（Embodied Spatial Reasoning, ESR）是将视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）部署于真实世界具身任务中的核心，然而目前对其的评估仍不充分。现有基准主要在静态图像或合成室内环境中评估空间推理，在这些场景中语义捷径往往已足够，因而难以忠实评估真实开放环境（in the wild）中的空间推理能力。鉴于此，我们提出 Lost on Campus，这是一个用于在由 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建的大规模真实世界室外三维环境中评估 ESR 的基准。我们的基准引入了一个统一的推理—行动评估框架，将用于孤立推理的诊断性 QA 与用于多模态指令下主动推理的闭环交互式导航无缝整合。为实现细粒度诊断，我们评估 ESR 的六个能力方面：动作落地（action grounding）、空间预见（spatial foresight）、度量感知（metric awareness）、目标导向规划（goal-directed planning）、自我—异我中心定位（ego-allocentric localization）以及时空一致性（spatio-temporal consistency）。大量实验揭示：(i) 与室内环境相比，真实世界室外环境对空间推理提出了显著更高的要求，现有模型在其中表现不佳；(ii) VLMs 在细粒度视觉对齐方面仍然存在困难，其中空间预见与自我—异我中心定位方面的失败成为主要瓶颈；(iii) 提升多模态交互能力与长期空间推理对于推进具身智能至关重要。这些发现突出表明，要忠实评估 ESR，需要能够在真实且连续的环境中紧密耦合感知、推理与行动的基准。

title: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
summary: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and task requirements, with stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement. It comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups and 27 indoor environments, covering object and room search, counting, geometric judgments, direction reasoning, and relocation. Human evaluators achieve 84% strict task success on 100 sampled tasks, with every correct outcome satisfying the required checks. Across seven frontier vision-language models, we identify two complementary failure modes: correct outcomes with unmet task requirements, and incorrect outcomes despite passing stronger checks. Oracle-input diagnostics show that more complete target observations and calibrated feedback improve final spatial judgments.

AI.title_zh: ROAM-Bench：通过证据验证评估具身主动空间智能
AI.abstract_zh: 具身空间智能要求智能体通过探索与交互来收集信息，并利用这些信息进行推理和行动。现有基准不足以区分正确的结果与这些任务要求的完成情况。我们提出 ROAM-Bench，用于在机器人运动与碰撞约束下评估这些能力。独立检查利用仿真状态和回合记录来评估结果与任务要求，并通过更强的检查考察几何、覆盖范围或放置情况。该基准包含 250 个经人工验证的任务，涵盖五组共 11 种任务类型、27 个室内环境，覆盖物体与房间搜索、计数、几何判断、方向推理以及重定位。人类评估者在 100 个抽样任务上达到 84% 的严格任务成功率，且每个正确结果都满足所要求的检查。在七个前沿视觉-语言模型上，我们识别出两种互补的失败模式：结果正确但任务要求未满足，以及尽管通过了更强的检查但结果错误。Oracle 输入诊断表明，更完整的目标观测与经过校准的反馈能够改善最终的空间判断。

title: iWAM: Efficient Action Prediction from World Models without Explicit Future Prediction
summary: World-action models (WAMs) build policies on pretrained video-generation models, on the premise that predicting how a scene evolves helps determine how to act. However, generating future scenes is expensive for real-time control. This motivates efficient proxies for future imagination, but how to train such proxies without sacrificing action-prediction quality remains unclear. An effective proxy need not generate a high-resolution frame; it only needs to provide enough information to distinguish between possible futures. This leads to the design principle behind iWAM: rather than denoising an entire future frame, can we condition the action policy on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation? We show that the answer is yes. Exploiting the reversible dynamics of flow-matching models, we invert each training future into the corresponding latent noise vector. However, a single velocity evaluation at this latent does not necessarily yield informative features for action prediction. We therefore learn a bidirectional flow map that amortizes future-generation computation, enabling a single model evaluation to provide effective conditioning features. At inference, we sample a latent noise vector from the prior and condition the policy using just one video-backbone forward pass. Across simulated benchmarks and real robots, iWAM recovers the generalization benefits of WAMs while substantially reducing its inference cost.

AI.title_zh: iWAM：无需显式未来预测的高效世界模型动作预测
AI.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）将策略建立在预训练视频生成模型之上，其前提是预测场景如何演化有助于确定如何行动。然而，生成未来场景对于实时控制而言代价高昂。这促使人们采用高效的未来想象代理（proxies），但如何在不牺牲动作预测质量的前提下训练此类代理仍不清楚。一个有效的代理无需生成高分辨率帧；它只需提供足以区分各种可能未来的信息。这引出了 iWAM 背后的设计原则：与其对整个未来帧进行去噪，能否让动作策略以单次视频模型评估所得的中间特征为条件？我们表明答案是肯定的。利用流匹配（flow-matching）模型的可逆动力学，我们将每个训练未来反演为对应的潜噪声向量。然而，在该潜变量上进行单次速度评估并不必然产生对动作预测有信息量的特征。因此，我们学习一个双向流映射（bidirectional flow map），以摊销未来生成的计算，使得单次模型评估即可提供有效的条件特征。在推理时，我们从先验中采样一个潜噪声向量，并仅通过一次视频骨干网络前向传播即可为策略提供条件。在模拟基准和真实机器人上，iWAM 恢复了 WAMs 的泛化优势，同时大幅降低了其推理成本。

title: Physicl Scenes: An Artist-created 3D Dataset for Learning Perception and Action
summary: We present Physicl Scenes, a high-quality artist-created and curated dataset of 6,499 3D scenes spanning household rooms, public interiors, and outdoor spaces. The dataset combines detailed geometry, physically based materials, and carefully composed environments with object- and part-level semantic annotations, providing rich, joint supervision for visual and embodied learning. We demonstrate its value as training data across inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and mobile manipulation. Across these tasks, training state-of-the-art methods with our scenes improves performance over alternative synthetic datasets. In addition, we introduce a mobile manipulation benchmark, evaluating vision-language-action models performing physical pick and place in diverse 3D scenes with realistic layouts, and using our part annotations to also score where each object is grasped. Our dataset will be released publicly to facilitate research in visual and embodied AI.

AI.title_zh: Physicl Scenes：一个由艺术家创建的用于感知与动作学习的三维数据集
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Physicl Scenes，这是一个高质量、由艺术家创建并策展的数据集，包含 6,499 个三维场景，涵盖家庭房间、公共室内空间与户外空间。该数据集将精细的几何结构、基于物理的材质以及精心构图的环境，与物体级和部件级语义标注相结合，为视觉学习与具身学习提供丰富且联合的监督信号。我们展示了其作为训练数据在逆向渲染、三维重建、场景理解与移动操作等任务中的价值。在这些任务上，使用我们的场景训练最先进的方法，相比使用其他合成数据集可提升性能。此外，我们引入了一个移动操作基准，用于评估视觉-语言-动作模型在具有真实布局的多样三维场景中执行物理抓取与放置（pick and place）的表现，并利用我们的部件标注对每个物体被抓取的位置进行评分。我们的数据集将公开发布，以促进视觉与具身人工智能领域的研究。

title: Spectrify: Framework for Hyperspectral Image Generation Using Computer Graphics
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) record the full spectrum of light at every pixel, so projecting an HSI through a camera's spectral sensitivities gives that camera's RAW image, and one HSI can supply training data for hyperspectral reconstruction and camera-pipeline methods. Real HSIs, however, are slow and expensive to capture, and the largest datasets hold only about 1,000 images. High-level vision commonly replaces scarce real data with images rendered from 3D scenes. Low-level tasks, however, need physically correct spectra, which requires spectral rendering with a measured spectrum for every material in a scene, and existing spectral renderings cover only a handful of scenes, mostly with a simplified image formation model. We present Spectrify, a framework that converts 3D scene datasets into HSIs, together with a library of reflectance spectra labeled by material and compiled from close-range hyperspectral datasets and spectrophotometer measurements. In Spectrify, spectra follow the material: each object receives a physically based optical model and measured reflectance spectra or optical constants from its material category, each lamp an emission spectrum of its type and the sky a modeled daylight spectrum, and Mitsuba 3 path-traces the full light transport of each scene per wavelength. We show that a hyperspectral reconstruction network trained only on our synthetic HSIs generalizes to unseen real datasets better than networks trained on the largest real HSI datasets on most test sets, and that assigning spectra by material category instead of by color alone improves this transfer on every test set. RAW images projected from our HSIs are also useful training data for color constancy, performing on par with existing synthetic RAW generators. We release the 4,500 rendered HSIs, the code of Spectrify and its material-labeled reflectance library.

AI.title_zh: Spectrify：使用计算机图形学进行高光谱图像生成的框架
AI.abstract_zh: 高光谱图像（HSI）记录每个像素处的完整光谱，因此将一幅 HSI 通过相机的光谱敏感度进行投影即可得到该相机的 RAW 图像，而一幅 HSI 可为高光谱重建与相机流水线方法提供训练数据。然而，真实 HSI 的采集既缓慢又昂贵，最大的数据集也仅包含约 1,000 幅图像。高层视觉通常用由 3D 场景渲染得到的图像来替代稀缺的真实数据。但低层任务需要物理上正确的光谱，这要求进行光谱渲染，并为场景中每种材质提供实测光谱，而现有的光谱渲染仅覆盖少数场景，且大多采用简化的成像模型。我们提出 Spectrify，这是一个将 3D 场景数据集转换为 HSI 的框架，同时配套一个按材质标注的反射光谱库，该库由近距高光谱数据集与分光光度计测量数据汇编而成。在 Spectrify 中，光谱随材质而定：每个物体依据其材质类别获得基于物理的光学模型以及实测反射光谱或光学常数，每盏灯获得其对应类型的发射光谱，天空则采用建模的日光光谱，并由 Mitsuba 3 按波长对每个场景的完整光传输进行路径追踪。我们表明，仅在合成 HSI 上训练的高光谱重建网络在大多数测试集上比在最大真实 HSI 数据集上训练的网络更好地泛化到未见的真实数据集，并且按材质类别而非仅按颜色分配光谱可在每个测试集上改善这一迁移效果。由我们的 HSI 投影得到的 RAW 图像同样是颜色恒常性任务的有用训练数据，其表现与现有的合成 RAW 生成器相当。我们公开发布 4,500 幅渲染 HSI、Spectrify 的代码及其材质标注反射光谱库。

title: Hybrid AI for AI-Native RAN Control: A Functional Perspective
summary: AI-native radio access network (RAN) control involves interdependent decisions across network entities, protocol layers, and timescales. Understanding how AI and conventional methods can jointly support these decisions requires a common basis for comparing their functional roles. This survey introduces a technique-agnostic taxonomy of RAN decision-making organized around four complementary capabilities: Representation and Reasoning, Prediction and Simulation, Adaptive Control, and Decision Synthesis. These capabilities are defined by their roles in the control process, independently of the techniques used to implement them. Through this perspective, we examine representative AI and model-based approaches, including foundation models, world models, reinforcement learning, and optimization. We then apply the taxonomy to representative RAN control solutions across slow, medium, fast, and cross-timescale applications to identify which capabilities they implement and how these capabilities are combined in hybrid AI systems. We also review datasets, benchmarks, simulators, digital twins, and experimental platforms according to their support for the decision-making process and reproducible evaluation. The review highlights a gap between the availability of resources for closed-loop experimentation and the standardization of tasks, metrics, and evaluation protocols needed for meaningful comparisons.Finally, we identify research directions for hybrid AI in AI-native RAN, including capability integration, multi-agent and cross-timescale coordination, constraint handling, and reproducible closed-loop evaluation. A curated list of surveyed works and evaluation resources is available at https://github.com/pegahani/Hybrid-AI-RAN-Survey.

AI.title_zh: 面向AI原生RAN控制的混合AI：功能视角
AI.abstract_zh: AI原生无线接入网（RAN）控制涉及跨网络实体、协议层和时间尺度的相互依赖决策。理解AI与传统方法如何共同支持这些决策，需要一个共同基础来比较它们的功能角色。本综述引入一种与具体技术无关的RAN决策分类法，围绕四项互补能力组织：表示与推理、预测与仿真、自适应控制以及决策综合。这些能力由其在控制过程中的角色定义，而与实现它们所用的技术无关。通过这一视角，我们考察了具有代表性的AI方法与基于模型的方法，包括基础模型、世界模型、强化学习和优化。随后，我们将该分类法应用于慢速、中速、快速和跨时间尺度应用中具有代表性的RAN控制解决方案，以识别它们实现了哪些能力，以及这些能力在混合AI系统中如何组合。我们还依据对决策过程与可复现评估的支持程度，评述了数据集、基准、仿真器、数字孪生和实验平台。该综述揭示了闭环实验所需资源的可用性与开展有意义比较所需的任务、指标和评估协议标准化之间存在差距。最后，我们指出了AI原生RAN中混合AI的研究方向，包括能力集成、多智能体与跨时间尺度协调、约束处理以及可复现的闭环评估。所评述工作与评估资源的精选列表见https://github.com/pegahani/Hybrid-AI-RAN-Survey。

title: RePix-VFI: Re-rendering Observed Pixels for Video Frame Interpolation with Generative Priors from One-Step Diffusion
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/RePix-VFI_site
summary: Multi-frame video frame interpolation (VFI) aims to reconstruct dense video from sparse keyframes, requiring accurate intermediate motion and faithful appearance. As temporal gaps grow, flow-based methods can retain observed textures but misplace them under ambiguous motion, whereas iterative latent-diffusion models can synthesize plausible content but incur substantial sampling costs and may alter details during reconstruction with a variational autoencoder (VAE). We present RePix-VFI, named for Re-rendering observed Pixels, a multi-frame VFI framework that couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with reconstruction from observed keyframes. A pretrained video diffusion model refines a flow-rendered draft of the whole window in a single forward pass. For each target frame, our generative readback matches its two bounding keyframes to the generated prediction using an optical-flow estimator. The resulting correspondences guide re-rendering of original keyframe RGB pixels outside the VAE. A lightweight appearance fusion head combines these renderings with generated appearance. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate significant improvements in reconstruction and perceptual quality. On SNU-FILM at $\times$8 and $\times$16, RePix-VFI achieves the highest PSNR and the lowest LPIPS, FloLPIPS, and tOF among the compared methods, exceeding the best evaluated diffusion-based baseline by 1.71 and 1.48dB in PSNR, respectively. It also runs 32--42$\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art multi-frame VFI diffusion model.

AI.title_zh: RePix-VFI：重渲染观测像素以实现基于单步扩散生成先验的视频帧插值
AI.abstract_zh: 多帧视频帧插值（VFI）旨在从稀疏关键帧重建稠密视频，要求准确的中间运动与忠实的表观。随着时间间隔增大，基于光流的方法能够保留观测到的纹理，但在运动存在歧义时会将其错置；而迭代式潜扩散模型能够合成看似合理的内容，却带来可观的采样开销，并且在利用变分自编码器（VAE）进行重建时可能改变细节。我们提出 RePix-VFI，其名称意为重渲染观测像素（Re-rendering observed Pixels），是一个将草稿条件化的单步视频扩散与基于观测关键帧的重建相耦合的多帧 VFI 框架。一个预训练视频扩散模型在单次前向传播中精化整个窗口由光流渲染得到的草稿。对于每个目标帧，我们的生成式读回（generative readback）利用光流估计器将其两个边界关键帧与生成的预测进行匹配。由此得到的对应关系引导在 VAE 之外重渲染原始关键帧的 RGB 像素。一个轻量级表观融合头将这些渲染结果与生成的表观相结合。在基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在重建质量和感知质量上均取得显著提升。在 SNU-FILM 的 $\times$8 和 $\times$16 上，RePix-VFI 在所比较的方法中取得了最高的 PSNR 以及最低的 LPIPS、FloLPIPS 和 tOF，其 PSNR 分别比所评估的最佳扩散基线高出 1.71 和 1.48dB。它的运行速度也比最先进的多帧 VFI 扩散模型快 32--42$\times$。

title: DynaMimic: A Physics-Informed World Model for Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Whole-body motion tracking enables humanoid robots to reproduce diverse skills from human demonstrations. Existing model-free reinforcement learning methods either distill motion specialists into a single policy at the cost of performance or train a generalist policy directly using cluster-scale computation. SuperMimic reduces this computational cost through a differentiable world model that implicitly learns the physics shared across motions by predicting the next state from the current state and action. However, this implicit formulation may not fully capture the underlying physical processes. Errors around changes of support can accumulate over imagined rollouts used to train the tracking policy. To address this challenge, we introduce DynaMimic, a differentiable world model that explicitly incorporates shared physics into state prediction. Specifically, its network predicts a contact wrench at each candidate support link and a residual generalized force. DynaMimic then uses these predictions to compute the next state through closed-form Lagrangian forward dynamics. Across 60 full LAFAN1 motions, DynaMimic reduces mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 18.6% relative to SuperMimic. For terrain tracking, we give both methods the same local height maps. Relative to terrain-conditioned SuperMimic, DynaMimic reduces MPJPE by 14.9% on A3 Parkour (66.15 to 56.28~mm) and by 10.8% on GRAIL terrain clips (141.88 to 126.57~mm). On a real A3 humanoid, the learned policies can perform diverse skills, such as floor recovery, cartwheel and a box vault.

AI.title_zh: DynaMimic：一种用于人体运动跟踪的物理信息世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 全身运动跟踪使类人机器人能够复现来自人类演示的多样化技能。现有的无模型强化学习方法要么将运动专家策略蒸馏为单一策略，但以性能为代价，要么直接使用集群规模的计算训练一个通用策略。SuperMimic 通过一个可微世界模型降低了这一计算成本，该模型通过由当前状态和动作预测下一状态，隐式地学习各运动之间共享的物理规律。然而，这种隐式表述可能无法完全刻画底层的物理过程。在用于训练跟踪策略的想象推演（imagined rollouts）中，支撑状态变化附近的误差可能会不断累积。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 DynaMimic，一种将共享物理显式地纳入状态预测的可微世界模型。具体而言，其网络在每个候选支撑连杆处预测接触力旋量（contact wrench）以及残差广义力（residual generalized force）。DynaMimic 随后利用这些预测，通过闭式拉格朗日前向动力学计算下一状态。在 60 个完整的 LAFAN1 运动上，DynaMimic 相对于 SuperMimic 将平均每关节位置误差（MPJPE）降低了 18.6%。对于地形跟踪，我们为两种方法提供相同的局部高度图。相对于以地形为条件的 SuperMimic，DynaMimic 在 A3 Parkour 上将 MPJPE 降低了 14.9%（从 66.15 降至 56.28~mm），在 GRAIL 地形片段上降低了 10.8%（从 141.88 降至 126.57~mm）。在真实的 A3 类人机器人上，所学策略能够执行多样化技能，例如倒地起身、侧手翻和跳箱翻越。

title: Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking
summary: World models support embodied decision-making by predicting future environment states. In embodied visual tracking, uncertain target motion and robot-induced viewpoint changes jointly affect visual observations, making future-state prediction challenging. We propose Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions. A Geometry--Progress module jointly models geometric paths and single-step travel distances through shared motion modes and path-conditioned progress distributions. This formulation captures uncertainty in route selection and motion progress while preserving their dependence. Action-induced coordinate transformations express predicted paths in the next robot frame, providing geometrically grounded conditions for future visual-state prediction. Future visual feature reconstruction supervises the motion predictor through the conditioned transition branch, linking explicit motion representations to subsequent observations. The model is jointly optimized with motion likelihood, feature reconstruction, and expert-action supervision, enabling the tracking policy to combine visual context with predictive motion cues.Experiments on three embodied tracking benchmarks demonstrate improved tracking performance and cross-environment generalization with a lightweight $0.5$B backbone.

AI.title_zh: 面向具身视觉跟踪的运动条件世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型通过预测未来环境状态来支持具身决策。在具身视觉跟踪中，不确定的目标运动与机器人引起的视角变化共同影响视觉观测，使得未来状态预测具有挑战性。我们提出运动条件世界建模（Motion-Conditioned World Modeling），将预测的目标运动分布与机器人自我运动纳入潜在状态转移之中。一个几何—进度（Geometry--Progress）模块通过共享的运动模式与路径条件化的进度分布，联合建模几何路径与单步行进距离。该形式化刻画了路径选择与运动进度中的不确定性，同时保留二者之间的依赖关系。动作诱导的坐标变换将预测路径表达在下一机器人坐标系中，为未来视觉状态预测提供具有几何依据的条件。未来视觉特征重建通过条件化转移分支对运动预测器进行监督，将显式的运动表示与后续观测联系起来。该模型以运动似然、特征重建与专家动作监督进行联合优化，使跟踪策略能够将视觉上下文与预测性运动线索相结合。在三个具身跟踪基准上的实验表明，在轻量级 $0.5$B 骨干网络下，跟踪性能与跨环境泛化能力均得到提升。

title: EEG-World: Context-Conditioned Dynamics of the Watching Brain
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables; appendix with 3 figures and 6 tables. Ancillary file lists the clip split
summary: Brain encoding models predict neural responses from audiovisual input, but typically overlook how ongoing brain activity shapes an individual's response. We introduce EEG-World, a recurrent world model that forecasts 10 seconds of EEG band-power dynamics from 6 seconds of preceding EEG and the subsequent audiovisual stimulus. Pretrained on continuous EEG, EEG-World learns shared neural dynamics and adapts to unseen individuals through lightweight subject-specific readouts. Using 2,584 hours of EEG from 78 participants, we show that nonlinear recurrent forecasting surpasses strong history-aware linear baselines at scale. EEG-World achieves a forecasting correlation of 0.261 versus 0.233 for the strongest history-and-video linear model, with a 3.3-second forecasting-horizon advantage. Its learned dynamics transfer to unseen participants, outperforming the linear baseline in 23 of 24 individuals after calibration. While ongoing EEG history accounts for most predictive performance, controlled stimulus analyses reveal an additional video-dependent component. This component also enables evaluation of visual representations, with V-JEPA 2 improving clip-locked prediction by 35% over combined CLIP and DINOv2 features. Our results demonstrate the value of transferable neural dynamics for individual EEG forecasting and highlight the importance of separating state-driven from stimulus-driven predictability.

AI.title_zh: EEG-World：观看中的大脑的上下文条件动力学
AI.abstract_zh: 大脑编码模型从视听输入预测神经反应，但通常忽视了持续进行的脑活动如何塑造个体的反应。我们提出 EEG-World，一个循环世界模型，它根据先前 6 秒的 EEG 以及随后的视听刺激，预测未来 10 秒的 EEG 频带功率动力学。EEG-World 在连续 EEG 上预训练，学习共享的神经动力学，并通过轻量级的被试特异性读出适配未见过的个体。使用来自 78 名被试的 2,584 小时 EEG，我们表明非线性循环预测在大规模上优于强大的历史感知线性基线。EEG-World 达到 0.261 的预测相关性，而最强的历史与视频线性模型为 0.233，并具有 3.3 秒的预测视野优势。其学习到的动力学可迁移至未见过的被试，在标定后在 24 名个体中的 23 名上优于线性基线。虽然持续进行的 EEG 历史解释了大部分预测性能，但受控刺激分析揭示了额外的视频依赖成分。这一成分还使得能够评估视觉表征，其中 V-JEPA 2 相较 CLIP 与 DINOv2 特征组合将片段锁定预测提升了 35%。我们的结果证明了可迁移神经动力学对个体 EEG 预测的价值，并凸显了区分状态驱动与刺激驱动可预测性的重要性。

title: PhysMend: Verification-Guided Program Refinement for Physics-Aware Video Generation
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Video generative models synthesize realistic scenes, yet their interactions often violate physics. A ball dropped onto sand should displace grains and settle into a crater, whereas a generated video may show it passing through the surface or leaving the sand flat. Post-hoc methods typically score generated videos with a vision-language model (VLM), but such scores offer limited guidance on which object or parameter to modify, and each correction costs another synthesis. Simulation-based pipelines instead run fixed stages before synthesis, so simulation errors reach the video. To address these limitations, we present PhysMend, a training-free framework for verification-guided program refinement. PhysMend describes the target event as an editable physical program of grounded objects, events, and required relations, paired with tunable execution parameters. Our key insight is to verify and repair the event on its simulated rollout and on the depth video that conditions the generator (depth control) rather than on generated videos, enabling quantitative violation measurement, targeted editing, and fast re-verification before synthesis. A hybrid verifier evaluates semantic event consistency, physical plausibility, solver stability, and visibility in the depth control. VLM judgments are confined to event semantics and cannot override failed physical measurements, which limits the impact of VLM hallucinations. Each failed check localizes the program fields eligible for repair, and its measured violation scales a bounded update of their parameters. Only accepted depth control reaches the generator, which runs once per input. Experiments on the commonly used benchmarks Physics-IQ, PhyGenBench, and VBench-2.0 demonstrate substantial gains across different generator backbones; for example, PhysMend raises the overall Physics-IQ score of Wan-VACE from 27.33 to 39.40.

AI.title_zh: PhysMend：面向物理感知视频生成的验证引导式程序精化
AI.abstract_zh: 视频生成模型能够合成逼真的场景，但其交互往往违反物理规律。一个掉落到沙子上的球应当排开沙粒并陷入形成凹坑，而生成的视频却可能显示球穿过表面，或使沙子保持平整。事后（post-hoc）方法通常用视觉-语言模型（VLM）对生成的视频打分，但此类分数对于应当修改哪个对象或参数所提供的指导有限，且每一次纠正都要再付出一次合成成本。基于仿真的流程则在合成之前运行固定阶段，因此仿真误差会传递到视频中。为应对这些局限，我们提出 PhysMend，一个无需训练的、验证引导式程序精化框架。PhysMend 将目标事件描述为一个可编辑的物理程序，由具对象、事件与必需关系构成，并配以可调的执行参数。我们的关键见解是：在仿真推演（simulated rollout）上、以及在为生成器提供条件的深度视频（depth control）上验证并修复事件，而非在生成的视频上进行验证与修复，从而在合成之前实现定量的违规度量、有针对性的编辑以及快速的再次验证。一个混合验证器评估语义事件一致性、物理合理性、求解器稳定性以及深度控制中的可见性。VLM 的判断被限定在事件语义范围内，不能推翻失败的物理测量，从而限制了 VLM 幻觉的影响。每一项未通过的检查都会定位出可进行修复的程序字段，其测得的违规量则用于缩放这些字段参数的有界更新。只有被接受的深度控制才会送入生成器，而生成器对每个输入仅运行一次。在常用基准 Physics-IQ、PhyGenBench 和 VBench-2.0 上的实验表明，该方法在不同的生成器骨干网络上均取得显著提升；例如，PhysMend 将 Wan-VACE 的 Physics-IQ 总体得分从 27.33 提升到 39.40。

title: Residual Guidance for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
summary: Real-time interactive video generation allows users to change the prompt during generation to steer the evolving video. However, existing streaming models, which generate videos chunk by chunk, often keep following the previous prompt after a switch. We trace this failure to context inertia, where the previous chunk acts as a strong prior that suppresses the new prompt. Furthermore, we find that this inertia persists even when the cache retains only the previous chunk, yet discarding the context breaks visual continuity, which limits approaches that edit the cache. Rather than editing the cache, we propose Residual Guidance (RG), a simple, training-free method that counteracts context inertia with a correction measured outside the cache. Specifically, RG denoises the re-noised previous chunk once under the new prompt without the cache and adds the resulting residual to the early denoising steps of the next chunk, where its content is largely decided and the new prompt is most suppressed. Across settings ranging from a single switch to long multi-switch generation, RG substantially improves prompt switching capability on existing streaming models, including those with dedicated switching mechanisms, while largely retaining visual quality. As it requires no training or per-model tuning and adds only one forward pass per chunk, RG can be easily integrated into existing real-time video generation pipelines.

AI.title_zh: 面向实时交互式视频生成的残差引导
AI.abstract_zh: 实时交互式视频生成允许用户在生成过程中更改提示词，以引导正在演变的视频。然而，现有的流式模型逐块（chunk by chunk）生成视频，在提示词切换后往往仍继续遵循先前的提示词。我们将这一失败归因于上下文惯性（context inertia），即先前的块充当了强先验，压制了新的提示词。此外，我们发现即便缓存中仅保留前一个块，这种惯性依然存在；但丢弃上下文会破坏视觉连续性，这限制了通过编辑缓存来应对的方法。我们不编辑缓存，而是提出残差引导（Residual Guidance, RG），这是一种简单、无需训练的方法，通过在缓存之外测量的修正量来抵消上下文惯性。具体而言，RG 在不使用缓存的情况下，用新提示词对重新加噪的前一个块进行一次去噪，并将得到的残差加到下一个块的早期去噪步骤中——在该阶段，块的内容基本确定，且新提示词受到的压制最强。从单次切换到长时间多次切换生成的各类设置中，RG 在现有流式模型（包括那些具有专门切换机制的模型）上大幅提升了提示词切换能力，同时基本保持了视觉质量。由于它无需训练、无需逐模型调参，且每个块仅增加一次前向传播，RG 可以很容易地集成到现有的实时视频生成流水线中。

title: Atomic Policy: Composing Atomic Manipulation Skills with Agentic Reasoning
summary: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to translate task intent into physical interactions as the scene changes. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer semantic and spatial reasoning, while visuomotor policies provide fine-grained control. Yet ambiguous goals and dependencies between actions make their integration challenging. We introduce Atomic Policy, a framework that composes learned manipulation skills through grounded steering and execution feedback. A VLM estimates the symbolic state and goal, and a PDDL solver constructs a skill plan. An agentic harness steers each skill through language, visual pointing, or both, and verifies its outcome to guide phase transitions and replanning. A common phase-level interface supports specialized policies and generalist action models. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot show how Atomic Policy improves task following and supports recovery in complex, long-horizon manipulation. Project page: https://aaronzkd.github.io/atomic-policy/

AI.title_zh: 原子策略：以智能体推理组合原子操作技能
AI.abstract_zh: 长时程操作（long-horizon manipulation）要求机器人在场景变化时将任务意图转化为物理交互。视觉-语言模型（VLM）提供语义与空间推理，而视觉运动策略（visuomotor policies）提供细粒度控制。然而，模糊的目标以及动作之间的依赖关系使二者的集成充满挑战。我们提出原子策略（Atomic Policy），一个通过基于场景的引导（grounded steering）与执行反馈来组合已学习操作技能的框架。VLM 估计符号状态与目标，PDDL 求解器构建技能计划。一个智能体式执行框架（agentic harness）通过语言、视觉指向或二者兼用的方式引导每个技能，并验证其结果以指导阶段转换与重规划。一个通用的阶段级接口支持专用策略与通用动作模型。在仿真与真实机器人上的实验表明，原子策略如何改进任务遵循能力，并在复杂的长时程操作中支持恢复。项目页面：https://aaronzkd.github.io/atomic-policy/

title: Interactive Neural Computers
summary: Computers and their interfaces are usually treated as fixed, so a person, or increasingly an AI agent, must adapt to whatever the operating system presents. This is limiting when someone needs a different workflow, or an interface suited to hands-free use or a disability. We explore an overlooked alternative. Rather than training an agent to operate an existing computer, we train a generative model to be the computer, predicting each next screen from past screens and the user's mouse and keyboard actions. Treating a desktop as an interactive world model raises problems that natural-video world models largely avoid. Without a camera pose to index memory, the model must remember content that has left the screen without any geometric cues. Arithmetic in a terminal has to be exactly right, not merely plausible. Small interface text must also stay legible at interactive frame rates. Our Interactive Neural Computer is structured like a Neural Turing Machine and starts to address these problems with three modules trained end to end from pixels and actions. A surprise-gated slot memory, supervised by latent next-frame prediction (MEMORY-JEPA), stores what is off screen. An exploratory query bridge brings in the reasoning of a pretrained VLM, and a residual renderer predicts only the latent changes between frames. In long closed-loop rollouts, our model recalls occluded files in 64.2% of trials (chance is 33.3%), compared with at most 56.0% for recurrent and sliding-window baselines. It also raises terminal-text OCR accuracy from 1.3% to 50.1%. Finally, because the memory is explicit, it can be transplanted at test time to causally change what the model renders.

AI.title_zh: 交互式神经计算机
AI.abstract_zh: 计算机及其界面通常被视为固定的，因此人（以及越来越多的 AI 智能体）必须去适应操作系统所呈现的一切。当某人需要不同的工作流程，或需要适合免手操作或残障人士使用的界面时，这种状况就具有局限性。我们探索了一种被忽视的替代方案。我们不去训练智能体操作一台已有的计算机，而是训练一个生成模型来充当这台计算机，根据过往屏幕以及用户的鼠标和键盘操作来预测下一个屏幕。将桌面视为一个交互式世界模型，会带来自然视频世界模型在很大程度上回避的问题。在没有相机位姿可用于索引记忆的情况下，模型必须在没有任何几何线索的条件下记住已经离开屏幕的内容。终端中的算术必须完全正确，而不仅仅是看似合理。小号界面文字还必须在交互式帧率下保持清晰可读。我们的交互式神经计算机（Interactive Neural Computer）结构上类似于神经图灵机（Neural Turing Machine），并通过三个从像素和动作端到端训练的模块开始解决这些问题。一个由惊奇门控的槽记忆（surprise-gated slot memory）由潜在下一帧预测（MEMORY-JEPA）监督，用于存储屏幕之外的内容。一个探索性查询桥（exploratory query bridge）引入预训练 VLM 的推理，而一个残差渲染器只预测帧与帧之间的潜在变化。在长时间闭环推演中，我们的模型在 64.2% 的试验中回忆出被遮挡的文件（随机水平为 33.3%），而循环基线和滑动窗口基线最多为 56.0%。它还将终端文本 OCR 准确率从 1.3% 提升到 50.1%。最后，由于记忆是显式的，它可以在测试时被移植，从而因果性地改变模型所渲染的内容。

title: Simulator-as-Proxy World Model for Robot Manipulation
comment: 27 pages. Project page: https://sim-pwm.pages.dev Code: https://github.com/TingtingLiao/SimPWM
summary: Video world models for robots are increasingly conditioned on a simulated or rendered proxy of the scene, on the assumption that the video will show what the proxy shows. Testing this assumption requires a proxy whose state is explicit and can be perturbed. We present SimPWM (Simulator-as-Proxy World Model): given a calibrated camera, it represents, from the first frame alone, the robot by its 3D model and the objects the gripper may touch as 3D points; a rule-based simulator with no trained parameters moves them under the actions, and a video model renders the result. SimPWM returns the realistic video together with the simulated state. We then freeze the simulated objects while the arm moves as recorded and check whether the video still shows the object lifted. On DROID episodes from unseen setups, the answer differs for the arm and for the objects. With each of three base video models, the arm follows the proxy (robot IoU 0.75-0.78, against at most 0.69 for end-to-end models); rendering the robot alone already gives this. What the simulated objects add is the object state: against a robot-only proxy, they cut missed pick-ups from 54% to 38%, and the video follows them only with some base models: on rigid objects, freezing them lowers the lift rate of MiniMax-H3, fine-tuned on episodes whose simulation agrees with the real video, from 42% to 10%, but that of LTX-2.3, trained on the same episodes, only from 57% to 49%, as if it inferred the grasp from the arm motion; more than half of the remaining lifts of MiniMax-H3 are of cloth and rope, which the simulator carries rigidly. With any base model, the simulated state records what the simulation did; under perturbed actions, a video that disagrees with it reveals that the video ignores the simulated state.

AI.title_zh: 以模拟器为代理的世界模型用于机器人操作
AI.abstract_zh: 面向机器人的视频世界模型日益以场景的模拟或渲染代理（proxy）为条件，其假设是视频将呈现代理所呈现的内容。检验这一假设需要一个状态显式且可被扰动的代理。我们提出 SimPWM（Simulator-as-Proxy World Model，以模拟器为代理的世界模型）：给定一个已标定的相机，它仅凭第一帧就将机器人表示为其三维模型，并将夹爪可能接触的物体表示为三维点；一个无可训练参数的基于规则的模拟器在动作驱动下移动这些元素，再由视频模型渲染其结果。SimPWM 返回逼真的视频以及模拟状态。随后，我们固定模拟物体不动，同时机械臂按记录运动，并检验视频是否仍显示物体被抬起。在来自未见设置的 DROID 片段上，答案对于机械臂和物体是不同的。在三种基础视频模型各自的情况下，机械臂都遵循代理（机器人 IoU 为 0.75–0.78，而端到端模型至多为 0.69）；仅渲染机器人本身即可得到这一结果。模拟物体所增加的是物体状态：相对于仅含机器人的代理，它们将漏检的抓取从 54% 降至 38%，且视频只有在部分基础模型下才会遵循它们：对于刚性物体，固定它们会使 MiniMax-H3（在模拟与真实视频一致的片段上微调）的抬起率从 42% 降至 10%，但同样在这些片段上训练的 LTX-2.3 仅从 57% 降至 49%，仿佛它是从机械臂运动推断出抓取；MiniMax-H3 剩余抬起中超过一半是布料和绳索，而模拟器将其作为刚体携带。在任意基础模型下，模拟状态记录了模拟做了什么；在扰动动作下，与之不一致的视频表明该视频忽略了模拟状态。

title: Learning World Models through Contrastive Identification of Actions
summary: Latent world models enable goal-directed planning from offline visual data, but prediction alone does not specify which action-related distinctions their representations should preserve. Inverse dynamics provides auxiliary supervision, yet squared-error action regression rewards additional information only through changes in the conditional action mean. We propose Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), which identifies the executed action among alternatives sampled from a history-conditioned behavior proposal. Comparing actions plausible in the same context targets information supplied by the next latent beyond history. Under exact behavior matching, we show that CIA can reward action information that leaves optimal inverse-regression error unchanged, and verify this distinction through a controlled learning example. CIA achieves higher planner-averaged mean success than the base world model and a regression inverse-dynamics baseline across five visual control benchmarks, without modifying the planner.

AI.title_zh: 通过动作对比辨识学习世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 潜在世界模型能够基于离线视觉数据实现目标导向的规划，但仅靠预测并不能确定其表示应保留哪些与动作相关的区分。逆动力学提供了辅助监督，然而平方误差的动作回归只能通过条件动作均值的变化来奖励额外信息。我们提出动作对比辨识（Contrastive Identification of Actions, CIA），它从以历史为条件的行为提议中采样候选动作，并在这些备选中辨识实际执行的动作。在同一上下文中比较合理的动作，所针对的是下一个潜在状态在历史之外所提供的信息。在精确的行为匹配条件下，我们证明 CIA 能够奖励那些不改变最优逆回归误差的动作信息，并通过一个受控的学习示例验证了这一区别。在五个视觉控制基准上，CIA 在不修改规划器的情况下，取得了比基础世界模型和回归逆动力学基线更高的规划器平均平均成功率。

title: MemAnchorWorld: A Sparse World Model with Horizon-Conditioned Memory Retrieval for Autonomous Driving
summary: Sparse world models for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting represent scenes with a small set of evolving queries to efficiently predict future geometry and semantics for autonomous driving. However, existing sparse world models face a bottleneck in using historical temporal evidence for long-horizon forecasting. They rely on scene states to carry historical information implicitly, allowing errors to propagate and accumulate across successive forecasting steps and causing geometric and semantic deviations. To address this limitation, we present MemAnchorWorld, a sparse occupancy world model that explicitly retrieves relevant historical geometric and semantic evidence for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting. Inspired by the von Restorff effect, we introduce a forecast-time-conditioned hierarchical dual-path memory-anchor retrieval mechanism. Guided by the effective age and semantic compatibility of historical information, it combines query-level candidate selection with point-level memory-anchor retrieval to provide historical evidence for sparse points at different forecast times. To better use memory anchors and existing features, a point-level residual adapter jointly gated by the task and forecast time separately controls residual corrections to semantics, occupancy confidence, and spatial positions. On Occ3D-nuScenes, MemAnchorWorld achieves an average mIoU of 13.55% and an average IoU of 22.84% across the 1-3 s forecasting horizons, attaining state-of-the-art performance on both metrics.Project page: https://memanchorworld.github.io/

AI.title_zh: MemAnchorWorld：一种面向自动驾驶的、带有时域条件记忆检索的稀疏世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 用于4D语义占据预测的稀疏世界模型通过一小组不断演化的查询（queries）来表示场景，从而为自动驾驶高效地预测未来的几何与语义。然而，现有的稀疏世界模型在利用历史时序证据进行长时域预测时面临瓶颈。它们依赖场景状态来隐式携带历史信息，使得误差在连续的预测步骤中传播并累积，进而导致几何与语义偏差。为解决这一局限，我们提出MemAnchorWorld，一种显式检索相关历史几何与语义证据以进行4D语义占据预测的稀疏占据世界模型。受von Restorff效应启发，我们引入了一种以预测时刻为条件的分层双路径记忆锚点检索机制。该机制在历史信息的有效年龄（effective age）与语义兼容性的引导下，将查询级候选选择与点级记忆锚点检索相结合，为不同预测时刻的稀疏点提供历史证据。为了更好地利用记忆锚点与现有特征，一个由任务与预测时刻联合门控的点级残差适配器分别控制对语义、占据置信度与空间位置的残差修正。在Occ3D-nuScenes上，MemAnchorWorld在1-3秒的预测时域内取得了13.55%的平均mIoU和22.84%的平均IoU，在这两项指标上均达到当前最优性能。项目页面：https://memanchorworld.github.io/

title: TokenMatte: Unlocking T2V Diffusion Priors for Pixel-Native Video Matting
summary: High-resolution video matting requires accurate recovery of continuous alpha values, including fine hair, soft boundaries, and motion blur, yet dense alpha supervision remains scarce. Pretrained text-to-video diffusion transformers (DiTs) offer rich spatio-temporal priors, whereas existing generative video matting approaches typically route alpha predictions through RGB-trained VAE latents, which can attenuate fine details and introduce additional decoding overhead. We present TokenMatte, which adapts a pretrained video DiT into a single-pass, auxiliary-free RGB-to-alpha predictor with a pixel-native output interface. At its core is a single shared linear readout that maps each spatio-temporal token directly to its corresponding ($t \times p \times p$) block of alpha pixels, predicting spatial details and temporal variations within the same local video block. Tiling these blocks produces the full-resolution alpha sequence without a convolutional decoder or learned upsampling. The predicted alpha is supervised directly in pixel space, while the ground-truth alpha never enters the VAE, eliminating target-side alpha encoding and output-side VAE decoding. Leveraging the pretrained video prior, TokenMatte is trained using only existing public matting datasets, without additional data curation or auxiliary inputs at inference. Compared with a matched latent-output baseline, our pixel-native interface improves matting accuracy while achieving a 1.51$\times$ inference speedup. TokenMatte establishes a new auxiliary-free state of the art on VideoMatte, YouTubeMatte, and V-HIM60.

AI.title_zh: TokenMatte：为像素原生视频抠像释放 T2V 扩散先验
AI.abstract_zh: 高分辨率视频抠像需要精确恢复连续的 alpha 值，包括细小毛发、柔和边界和运动模糊，然而稠密的 alpha 监督仍然稀缺。预训练的文本到视频扩散 Transformer（DiT）提供了丰富的时空先验，而现有的生成式视频抠像方法通常经由在 RGB 上训练的 VAE 潜空间来输出 alpha 预测，这会削弱细节并引入额外的解码开销。我们提出 TokenMatte，它将预训练视频 DiT 适配为一个单遍、无需辅助输入的 RGB 到 alpha 预测器，并采用像素原生（pixel-native）的输出接口。其核心是一个单一的共享线性读出层，它将每个时空 token 直接映射到其对应的（$t \times p \times p$）alpha 像素块，在同一局部视频块内同时预测空间细节和时间变化。将这些块平铺即可生成全分辨率的 alpha 序列，无需卷积解码器或可学习上采样。预测的 alpha 直接在像素空间接受监督，而真值 alpha 从不进入 VAE，从而消除了目标侧的 alpha 编码和输出侧的 VAE 解码。借助预训练视频先验，TokenMatte 仅使用现有公开抠像数据集进行训练，无需额外的数据整理，推理时也无需辅助输入。与匹配的潜空间输出基线相比，我们的像素原生接口在提升抠像精度的同时实现了 1.51$\times$ 的推理加速。TokenMatte 在 VideoMatte、YouTubeMatte 和 V-HIM60 上建立了新的无辅助输入（auxiliary-free）最先进水平。

title: DiffGR00T: Execution-Aware Differentiable Training for Humanoid Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Conference preprint. Corresponding author: Hesheng Wang
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong results in arm-centric manipulation, yet humanoid whole-body control (WBC) requires dynamic balance and tightly coupled full-body coordination. Existing hierarchical humanoid VLAs typically decouple motion generation from physical execution, leaving tracking and balance errors unable to directly optimize the VLA generator. We propose DiffGR00T, an end-to-end differentiable training framework that couples GR00T N1.7 with SONIC, a pretrained whole-body behavior foundation model. To enable execution-aware differentiable training, we replace the non-differentiable simulator with a learned, action-conditioned world model, allowing multi-step body-execution losses to backpropagate through the frozen whole-body controller and the flow-matching sampler directly into the VLA action head. On four HumanoidArena simulation tasks, DiffGR00T improves average task success by 12.5 percentage points over the supervised base VLA (59.2% to 71.7%), demonstrating that execution-aware gradients effectively align high-level motion generation with closed-loop whole-body dynamics.

AI.title_zh: DiffGR00T：面向人形全身视觉-语言-动作模型的执行感知可微训练
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在以手臂为中心的操纵任务中已取得良好效果，然而人形全身控制（WBC）需要动态平衡与紧密耦合的全身协调。现有的分层式人形 VLA 通常将运动生成与物理执行解耦，使得跟踪误差与平衡误差无法直接优化 VLA 生成器。我们提出 DiffGR00T，一个端到端可微训练框架，将 GR00T N1.7 与预训练的全身行为基础模型 SONIC 相耦合。为实现执行感知的可微训练，我们用学习得到的、以动作为条件的世界模型替代不可微的仿真器，使多步身体执行损失能够经由冻结的全身控制器与流匹配采样器直接反向传播至 VLA 动作头。在四个 HumanoidArena 仿真任务上，DiffGR00T 相较监督训练的基线 VLA 将平均任务成功率提升 12.5 个百分点（59.2% 提升至 71.7%），表明执行感知梯度能够有效地将高层运动生成与闭环全身动力学对齐。

title: Economic World Model
summary: Can artificial intelligence reproduce the economic dynamics that emerge as households, firms and governments interact and adapt through markets and institutions? To answer this question, we define an economic world model (EWM) as an agent's internal representation of how an economic system works, enabling counterfactual simulation and decision-making under resource constraints. We then propose a general framework for studying EWMs that links three tasks: simulating agent behaviour, learning economic transitions and systematically evaluating the dynamics. As an initial implementation, we learn household policies from microeconomic data and calibrate a structural economic transition model using macroeconomic data, linking individual decisions to aggregate dynamics. Our micro-to-macro evaluation framework compares simulated individual actions and group distributions with observed microdata and assesses macroeconomic dynamics through forecasting and counterfactual experiments. Results show that simulated and observed household consumption distributions overlap by 94.9%, while EWM forecasts closely track real GDP and several other aggregate levels. In government-borrowing counterfactuals, the EWM reproduces the benchmark life-cycle model's short-run transmission from borrowing to consumption. For ex ante planning, the EWM enables an LLM agent to achieve 10.29% higher simulated GDP under the epidemic shock than direct LLM decisions. This initial EWM is only a starting point. We invite economists and AI researchers to build a stronger EWM together. Economists can contribute richer economic models and knowledge, while AI researchers can develop stronger data-driven methods for simulating agent behaviour and learning economic transitions. Together, we aim not only to reproduce real economic dynamics, but also to discover and test new mechanisms that support better decisions and benefit society.

AI.title_zh: 经济世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 人工智能能否复现家庭、企业与政府通过市场和制度相互作用并相互适应时所涌现的经济动态？为回答这一问题，我们将经济世界模型（economic world model, EWM）定义为一个智能体关于经济系统如何运行的内部表征，使其能够在资源约束下进行反事实模拟与决策。随后，我们提出一个研究 EWM 的通用框架，该框架连接三项任务：模拟智能体行为、学习经济状态转移以及系统性地评估动态。作为初步实现，我们从微观经济数据中学习家庭策略，并使用宏观经济数据校准一个结构性经济转移模型，从而将个体决策与总体动态相连接。我们的微观到宏观评估框架将模拟的个体行为和群体分布与观测到的微观数据进行比较，并通过预测和反事实实验评估宏观经济动态。结果表明，模拟的家庭消费分布与观测到的家庭消费分布重叠度为 94.9%，同时 EWM 的预测紧密跟踪实际 GDP 及其他若干总体水平。在政府借贷的反事实实验中，EWM 复现了基准生命周期模型关于借贷对消费的短期传导。对于事前规划，EWM 使 LLM 智能体在流行病冲击下实现的模拟 GDP 比直接由 LLM 决策高出 10.29%。这一初步的 EWM 仅是一个起点。我们邀请经济学家和人工智能研究者共同构建更强大的 EWM。经济学家可以提供更丰富的经济模型和知识，而人工智能研究者可以开发更强的数据驱动方法，用于模拟智能体行为和学习经济状态转移。我们共同的目标不仅是复现真实的经济动态，还要发现并检验能够支持更好决策、造福社会的新机制。

title: DexWAC: A Unified World-Actor-Critic Model for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot demonstrations provide more than actions to imitate: they reveal how actions change the world and how those changes contribute to task success. Recent world-action models (WAMs) extend vision-language-action (VLA) models with the first signal by jointly predicting actions and future observations, yet this predictive ability serves only as an auxiliary loss for policy learning. Meanwhile, most policy improvement methods learn dynamics and values in separate models, increasing training overhead and limiting representation sharing between these complementary objectives. We introduce DexWAC, a unified world-actor-critic model that jointly learns an actor, an action-conditioned world model, and a bootstrapped critic in a single robot pretraining stage. Our key insight is that visual prediction encourages control-relevant features, while value supervision promotes task-relevant representations; together, they shape a representation suited to policy learning. Built on an image-editing backbone, DexWAC predicts, for each action chunk, the visual latent and proprioception at its endpoint together with its reward and continuation, so the world model alone efficiently yields complete imagined transitions without generating intermediate video frames. After adapting the world model and critic on real rollouts, we improve the pretrained actor through either PPO on imagined rollouts or critic-guided best-of-$N$ selection. DexWAC surpasses the large-scale pretrained VLA and WAM baselines in simulation and achieves 75% average success on two real-world tasks, compared with 45% for $π_{0.5}$. Its world model is more accurate and faster than video-based baselines, and ablations confirm that learning dynamics and value together improves the policy.

AI.title_zh: DexWAC：一种用于灵巧机器人操作的统一世界-演员-评论家模型
AI.abstract_zh: 机器人演示提供的不仅仅是可供模仿的动作：它们揭示了动作如何改变世界，以及这些改变如何促成任务成功。近期的世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过联合预测动作和未来观测，用前一种信号扩展了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，然而这种预测能力仅作为策略学习的辅助损失使用。与此同时，大多数策略改进方法在分离的模型中学习动力学和价值，这增加了训练开销，并限制了这些互补目标之间的表示共享。我们提出 DexWAC，一种统一的世界-演员-评论家模型，在单个机器人预训练阶段中联合学习一个演员、一个以动作为条件的世界模型和一个自举评论家。我们的关键洞见是：视觉预测鼓励控制相关的特征，而价值监督促进任务相关的表示；二者共同塑造出适合策略学习的表示。DexWAC 构建于图像编辑骨干之上，对每个动作块预测其端点处的视觉潜变量和本体感觉，以及其奖励和延续（continuation），因此仅凭世界模型即可高效地产出完整的想象转移，而无需生成中间视频帧。在真实 rollout 上适配世界模型和评论家之后，我们通过想象 rollout 上的 PPO 或评论家引导的 best-of-$N$ 选择来改进预训练的演员。DexWAC 在仿真中超越了大规模预训练的 VLA 和 WAM 基线，并在两个真实世界任务上达到 75% 的平均成功率，而 $π_{0.5}$ 为 45%。其世界模型比基于视频的基线更准确且更快，消融实验证实，共同学习动力学和价值能够改进策略。

title: Sol$^{3}$: Accelerating Video Diffusion for Free via Hierarchical Sparse Attention Routing
summary: Sol-Attn (Sparsifying online attention) combines sparse exact computation with low-cost representative approximation to accelerate training-free inference in diffusion video models. However, intra-block attention can focus on only a few tokens. While preserving these key interactions exactly, the block-level decision incurs the cost of evaluating many low-response members. We propose Sol$^{3}$, a training-free hierarchical sparse attention method that further refines how exact computations are allocated. First, we introduce Gaussian-guided hierarchical routing, which determines the scope of exact computation step by step, from blocks to tokens, using statistical thresholds at each level. Only a subset of members within Mixed blocks that require refinement is selected for exact computation, while representative terms approximate the remaining members. We further design heterogeneous routing statistics that combine block-center correlations with variations in Key and Value within blocks to identify blocks that are difficult to approximate. Among these Mixed blocks, we uniformly compare raw token relevance to select members requiring exact computation. Experiments on video generation, audio-video co-generation, and world simulation tasks demonstrate that Sol$^{3}$ achieves 86% attention sparsity and delivers a $3.07\times$ attention speedup while preserving quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/FofGofx/sol3.

AI.title_zh: Sol$^{3}$：通过分层稀疏注意力路由免费加速视频扩散
AI.abstract_zh: Sol-Attn（Sparsifying online attention，稀疏化在线注意力）将稀疏精确计算与低成本的代表性近似相结合，以加速扩散视频模型中的免训练推理。然而，块内注意力可能仅聚焦于少数 token。在精确保留这些关键交互的同时，块级别的决策却会带来评估许多低响应成员的开销。我们提出 Sol$^{3}$，一种免训练的分层稀疏注意力方法，进一步细化精确计算的分配方式。首先，我们引入高斯引导的分层路由，它利用每一层级上的统计阈值，从块到 token 逐步确定精确计算的范围。在需要细化的 Mixed 块中，仅选择一部分成员进行精确计算，而其余成员由代表性项近似。我们进一步设计了异构路由统计量，将块中心相关性同块内 Key 与 Value 的变异相结合，以识别难以近似的块。在这些 Mixed 块中，我们统一比较原始 token 相关性，以选出需要精确计算的成员。在视频生成、音视频联合生成以及世界模拟任务上的实验表明，Sol$^{3}$ 在保持质量的同时实现了 86% 的注意力稀疏度，并带来 $3.07\times$ 的注意力加速。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/FofGofx/sol3 获取。

title: Contact Geometry for Generative Models: An Unbalanced Optimal Transport Formulation
comment: 50 pages, 20 figures; accepted for poster presentation at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Real-world generative problems in biology, medical imaging, or robotics, rarely come with perfectly paired source and target distributions. While unbalanced Optimal Transport (uOT) provides a robust framework to bridge unpaired datasets via minimum-length paths in probability space, existing formulations based on the Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) geometry introduce a structural bias toward high density regions, often triggering mode collapse. We introduce Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport (CuOT), a novel uOT formulation grounded in contact geometry that decouples density transport direction from mass growth to eliminate structural bias. This allows CuOT to adapt sampling steps to the local data structure, naturally reducing step sizes in high-density regions to prevent overshooting and ensuring stable convergence. The result is a stable, scalable path-length minimization solver that consistently outperforms WFR-based methods on biological dynamics reconstruction, unpaired image-to-image translation, and video generation.

AI.title_zh: 面向生成模型的接触几何：一种非平衡最优传输表述
AI.abstract_zh: 生物学、医学成像或机器人学中的真实世界生成问题，很少具备完全配对的源分布与目标分布。虽然非平衡最优传输（unbalanced Optimal Transport, uOT）提供了一个稳健的框架，通过在概率空间中沿最小长度路径来连接未配对数据集，但基于 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao（WFR）几何的既有表述引入了对高密度区域的结构性偏置，常常引发模式坍塌。我们提出接触非平衡最优传输（Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport, CuOT），这是一种以接触几何为基础的新型 uOT 表述，它将密度传输方向与质量增长解耦，从而消除结构性偏置。这使得 CuOT 能够使采样步长适应局部数据结构的特性，在高密度区域自然地减小步长以防止过冲，并确保稳定收敛。其结果是得到一个稳定、可扩展的路径长度最小化求解器，在生物动力学重建、非配对图像到图像翻译以及视频生成任务上持续优于基于 WFR 的方法。

title: Reliability-aware AI Agent Execution in Collaborative Edge Computing: A World Model Approach
summary: Collaborative edge computing supports AI agent applications by distributing execution across heterogeneous user-controlled devices with limited resources. This paper studies reliability-aware AI agent execution under node failures and wireless disruptions. These disruptions can make agent execution state unavailable or inconsistent, forcing recovery or recomputation that consumes the remaining deadline budget. Maintaining recoverable execution states can therefore improve request completion before deadlines. We formulate an online AI agent execution management problem that jointly selects resource allocations, state protection actions, and recovery targets to maximize the expected task success rate subject to resource, compatibility, and deadline constraints. We develop a world model that jointly captures evolving agent workflows and recoverable execution state under candidate management actions, accounting for node reliability, network conditions, and resource availability. The model enables the controller to simulate future execution and recovery trajectories under candidate actions and estimate their effects on execution progress and task completion before deadlines. We then employ world model-based model predictive control (WorldMPC) with Monte Carlo rollouts to jointly optimize resource allocation, state protection, and recovery decisions for long-term reliable agent execution under the dynamic environment. We evaluate the proposed approach on the simulation and real-world testbed using real-world and synthetic datasets. Experimental results show that WorldMPC improves task success rate over baselines in both simulation and real-world testbed.

AI.title_zh: 协作边缘计算中可靠性感知的AI智能体执行：一种世界模型方法
AI.abstract_zh: 协作边缘计算通过将执行分布到资源受限的、异构的用户可控设备上来支撑AI智能体应用。本文研究在节点故障和无线中断情况下的可靠性感知AI智能体执行。这些中断可能使智能体执行状态变得不可用或不一致，从而迫使进行恢复或重新计算，进而消耗剩余的截止期限预算。因此，维持可恢复的执行状态能够改善在截止期限之前完成请求的情况。我们构建了一个在线AI智能体执行管理问题，该问题联合选择资源分配、状态保护动作和恢复目标，以在资源、兼容性和截止期限约束下最大化期望任务成功率。我们开发了一个世界模型，该模型在候选管理动作下联合刻画不断演化的智能体工作流和可恢复执行状态，并考虑节点可靠性、网络状况和资源可用性。该模型使控制器能够在候选动作下模拟未来的执行与恢复轨迹，并估计它们对执行进度和截止期限前任务完成的影响。随后，我们采用基于世界模型的模型预测控制（WorldMPC）并结合蒙特卡洛推演，在动态环境下联合优化资源分配、状态保护和恢复决策，以实现长期可靠的智能体执行。我们在仿真和真实世界测试平台上使用真实世界数据集和合成数据集评估了所提出的方法。实验结果表明，WorldMPC在仿真和真实世界测试平台中均比基线方法提高了任务成功率。

title: GeoVLDrive: Geometry-Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) planners inherit semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models, but their reasoning is rarely grounded in 3D scene structure and its evolution over time. We introduce GeoVLDrive, a geometry-grounded VLA framework for 3D spatiotemporal reasoning and planning. Multi-layer features from a 3D foundation model augment the vision-language backbone through gated cross-attention. A structured latent chain of thought (CoT) organizes future scene geometry, key-agent motion, and meta-actions into ordered, separately supervised latent states. An action expert generates trajectory proposals from these states and multi-layer scene features, and ranks them using scene-grounded, interacting score tokens. We also introduce NAVSIM 3DQA to train and evaluate metric 3D spatial and motion understanding. GeoVLDrive achieves 91.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. On NAVSIM 3DQA, the geometry-grounded backbone scores 89.2% overall, 4.6 percentage points above the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B baseline. On LingoQA, the backbone achieves 68.6% Lingo-Judge accuracy.

AI.title_zh: GeoVLDrive：面向自动驾驶的几何锚定视觉-语言推理
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）规划器从预训练的视觉-语言模型中继承语义知识，但其推理很少以三维场景结构及其随时间的演化为依据（grounded）。我们提出 GeoVLDrive，一个基于几何的（geometry-grounded）VLA 框架，用于三维时空推理与规划。来自三维基础模型的多层特征通过门控交叉注意力（gated cross-attention）增强视觉-语言骨干网络。一种结构化的隐式思维链（chain of thought, CoT）将未来场景几何、关键智能体运动与元动作（meta-actions）组织为有序的、分别监督的隐状态。一个动作专家（action expert）根据这些状态和多层场景特征生成轨迹候选，并使用基于场景的、相互作用的评分 token 对其进行排序。我们还提出了 NAVSIM 3DQA，用于训练和评估度量三维空间与运动理解。GeoVLDrive 在 NAVSIM v1 上达到 91.8 PDMS，在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 90.9 EPDMS。在 NAVSIM 3DQA 上，几何锚定的骨干网络总体得分为 89.2%，比微调的 Qwen3-VL-2B 基线高出 4.6 个百分点。在 LingoQA 上，该骨干网络达到 68.6% 的 Lingo-Judge 准确率。

title: X-3DComposer: Feed-Forward 3D Scene Composition with Any Assets from Any Views
summary: Composing an editable 3D scene from images requires an asset for each object and a layout that places the assets. 3D generation and CAD retrieval now supply the assets, but layout still lacks a general solution: scene generation methods couple it with generation, and pose estimators handle one object at a time and need true-size CAD models, depth, or iterative refinement. We present X-3DComposer, a feed-forward model that predicts the layout separately from asset generation. Given one or more images of a scene, the object masks, and an asset for each object from any source, it jointly predicts the rotation, translation, and per-axis scale of all objects in a single forward pass of about one second. The key idea is to treat objects as views: renders of the assets are processed together with the scene images by a multi-view geometry model adapted from VGGT-$Ω$, and each object pose follows in closed form from the cameras predicted for its renders. Camera intrinsics, camera poses, and depth are optional inputs. When the meshes produced by five scene generation methods are kept fixed and only their layout is replaced, the layouts of X-3DComposer are more accurate than the native layouts of these methods. Compared with the stand-alone layout model SceneMaker, it reduces the scene-level Chamfer distance by 52% on IndoorMix, our test set from six indoor datasets, and by 28% on 3D-FUTURE.

AI.title_zh: X-3DComposer：面向任意来源资产与任意视角的前馈三维场景合成
AI.abstract_zh: 从图像合成可编辑的三维场景，需要为每个物体提供一个资产，以及一个放置这些资产的布局。三维生成与 CAD 检索如今能够提供资产，但布局问题仍缺乏通用解法：场景生成方法将布局与生成过程耦合在一起，而位姿估计器一次只处理一个物体，并且需要真实尺寸的 CAD 模型、深度信息或迭代细化。我们提出 X-3DComposer，这是一个将布局预测与资产生成分离的前馈模型。给定场景的一张或多张图像、物体掩码，以及每个物体来自任意来源的资产，它在约一秒的单次前向传播中联合预测所有物体的旋转、平移以及逐轴缩放。其核心思想是将物体视为视角：资产的渲染图与场景图像一起，由改编自 VGGT-$Ω$ 的多视角几何模型处理，每个物体的位姿由其渲染图所预测的相机以闭式解形式得出。相机内参、相机位姿和深度为可选输入。在保持五种场景生成方法所生成的网格固定、仅替换其布局的情况下，X-3DComposer 的布局比这些方法自身的原生布局更准确。与独立的布局模型 SceneMaker 相比，它在 IndoorMix（我们由六个室内数据集构建的测试集）上将场景级 Chamfer 距离降低 52%，在 3D-FUTURE 上降低 28%。

title: CodeWAM: A Code World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving world models anticipate action consequences through representations of how the world evolves. For autonomous driving, these representations must capture both the surrounding scene and the ego vehicle's motion under a candidate plan. We propose CodeWAM, a driving world model that incorporates executable code as part of its world representation. Code represents ego dynamics by expressing how the vehicle state evolves under plan execution, while a learned visual model captures scene-dependent consequences. Executing the code produces a candidate-conditioned motion sequence, which is evaluated relative to the prior plan and recorded motion history. The resulting execution consequences and learned scene outcomes jointly represent the candidate's future, enabling the planner to assess both what a plan may lead to and how the vehicle transitions into that future. The selected plan becomes part of the next decision's execution context, linking successive choices within the model. CodeWAM achieves 93.6 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, 92.1 EPDMS on v2 navtest, and 50.6 EPDMS on NAVHARD. Further experiments demonstrate improved pairwise execution consistency and gains on Hydra-MDP and DrivoR without additional training, supporting executable code as a complementary representation for driving world models.

AI.title_zh: CodeWAM：用于端到端自动驾驶的代码世界动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 驾驶世界模型通过刻画世界如何演变的表征来预判动作的后果。对于自动驾驶而言，这些表征必须同时捕捉候选规划下的周围场景与自车运动。我们提出 CodeWAM，一种将可执行代码纳入其世界表征的驾驶世界模型。代码通过表达车辆状态在规划执行下如何演变来表征自车动力学，而一个学习得到的视觉模型则捕捉依赖于场景的后果。执行该代码会产生一个以候选规划为条件的运动序列，该序列相对于先前的规划和已记录的运动历史进行评估。由此得到的执行后果与学习得到的场景结果共同表征候选规划的未来，使规划器能够同时评估一个规划可能导向何种结果以及车辆如何过渡到该未来。被选中的规划成为下一次决策执行上下文的一部分，从而在模型内部将相继的选择联系起来。CodeWAM 在 NAVSIM v1 navtest 上取得 93.6 PDMS，在 v2 navtest 上取得 92.1 EPDMS，在 NAVHARD 上取得 50.6 EPDMS。进一步的实验表明，在无需额外训练的情况下，成对执行一致性得到改善，并在 Hydra-MDP 与 DrivoR 上取得增益，从而支持将可执行代码作为驾驶世界模型的一种互补表征。

title: OmniPersist: Persistent Dynamic World Modeling via Coupled Panoramic Evolution
summary: Action-conditioned world models play a vital role in robotics and autonomous driving, yet existing video diffusion models struggle to maintain dynamic object persistence. When the camera turns away and returns, out-of-view moving entities fail to evolve plausibly in latent space, often mutating or vanishing entirely due to bounded perspective views. To resolve this issue, we propose OmniPersist, a unified framework that couples perspective video generation with panoramic evolution within a single-stage diffusion model, without relying on auxiliary models or initial panoramic inputs. To maintain efficiency, we model the panoramic stream at a lower frame rate, bridging both views across space and time via Geometric Anchoring (GeoAnch) for spatial correspondence and Temporal Compensation (TemComp) for temporal aggregation. OmniPersist is agnostic to camera-control architectures, supporting both latent-level and attention-level conditioning. Extensive experiments on a newly constructed dynamic benchmark across image-to-video and video continuation tasks demonstrate consistent gains in visual quality, camera controllability, revisit consistency, and dynamic persistence.

AI.title_zh: OmniPersist：通过耦合全景演化的持久动态世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 以动作为条件的世界模型在机器人学和自动驾驶中起着至关重要的作用，然而现有的视频扩散模型难以维持动态对象的持久性。当相机转开后再转回时，视野外的运动实体会在潜空间中无法合理地演化，常常由于有界透视视角而发生变异或完全消失。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 OmniPersist，一个统一框架，它在单阶段扩散模型内将透视视频生成与全景演化相耦合，且不依赖辅助模型或初始全景输入。为保持效率，我们以较低的帧率对全景流进行建模，并通过用于空间对应关系的几何锚定（Geometric Anchoring，GeoAnch）和用于时间聚合的时间补偿（Temporal Compensation，TemComp），在空间和时间上桥接两种视图。OmniPersist 与相机控制架构无关，同时支持潜空间层面和注意力层面的条件控制。在新建的动态基准上针对图像到视频和视频续写任务开展的大量实验表明，其在视觉质量、相机可控性、重访一致性和动态持久性方面均获得了一致的提升。

title: MAGPIE: Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction
summary: Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. The final proxy rendering serves as a visual plan for the image generator. Using MAGPIE-Instruct-3K, we train the generator to follow this plan while drawing each subject's appearance from its reference. MAGPIE improves both Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval. With FLUX, it improves overall success on DreamOmni2 by 28.21 percentage points over the original backbone and achieves the highest overall score among the models evaluated on SconeEval.

AI.title_zh: MAGPIE：通过可执行场景构建的智能体式多参考图像生成
AI.abstract_zh: 多参考图像生成要求模型在依据指令安排所选主体的同时，保持这些主体的外观。尽管基于参考的生成与组合控制近期取得了进展，但将所选主体可靠地组织成预期场景仍然具有挑战性。现有方法虽然提供了多种形式的组合引导，但所规划的关系并不总是在图像合成之前被显式实例化以供检查和修正。为解决这一局限，我们提出 MAGPIE，它将预期的构图表示为一个由可执行 Blender 程序定义的简化 3D 场景。一个编码智能体将每个场景实例与其参考图像关联起来，依据指令检查几何结构与渲染视图，并修改程序以纠正不一致之处。最终的代理渲染作为图像生成器的视觉规划。利用 MAGPIE-Instruct-3K，我们训练生成器遵循该规划，同时从各自的参考图像中获取每个主体的外观。MAGPIE 在 DreamOmni2 和 SconeEval 上均提升了 Qwen 和 FLUX 的表现。在 FLUX 上，它使 DreamOmni2 上的总体成功率相较原始骨干模型提升了 28.21 个百分点，并在 SconeEval 上所评估的模型中取得了最高的总体得分。

title: A Mesh to Remember: Persistent Appearance for Interactive Video Worlds
summary: Video world models synthesize photorealistic observations in response to user actions but struggle to remain consistent over long interactions. Coding agents and text-to-3D models instead generate explicit 3D worlds whose geometry and state persist by construction, but whose appearance falls far short of photorealism. Recent methods combine the strengths of both by rendering such worlds into coarse proxies that guide a video model. However, since these proxies only specify where things are, the renderer must invent what they look like as the world is explored, and anything it forgets is reinvented when a surface reappears. Our key insight is that a mesh identifies which surface each pixel shows, across frames and views, even as objects move, allowing it to serve as an address for what the renderer generates. We propose M2R (Mesh to Remember), a few-step causal video renderer that stores its own features on the surfaces they depict, in each object's frame, and retrieves them by rasterizing the mesh whenever those surfaces come back into view. Appearance thus travels with objects wherever they move, persists across revisits, and is shared by every agent that observes it, while memory grows with the surfaces seen instead of the number of frames. Trained only on synthetic data, M2R transfers zero-shot to real indoor scans and to worlds authored by coding agents. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods in consistency across static, dynamic, and multi-agent benchmarks, more than doubling object permanence and nearly doubling cross-agent consistency, while rendering 720p video in real time (40 FPS).

AI.title_zh: 值得记住的网格：交互式视频世界中的持久外观
AI.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型能够根据用户动作合成照片级逼真的观测，但难以在长时间交互中保持一致。编码智能体（coding agents）和文本到3D模型则相反，它们生成显式的3D世界，其几何与状态在构造上即持久存在，但其外观远未达到照片级真实感。近期方法结合了两者的优势，将此类世界渲染为粗略代理（proxy）以引导视频模型。然而，由于这些代理仅指定了物体的位置，渲染器必须随着世界的探索自行臆造其外观，而它遗忘的任何内容都会在某个表面重新出现时被重新臆造。我们的关键洞察是：网格确定了每个像素所显示的是哪个表面，且跨越帧与视角、即使物体运动时依然如此，从而使网格能够充当渲染器所生成内容的地址。我们提出 M2R（Mesh to Remember），一种少步因果视频渲染器，它将自身特征存储在其所描绘的表面上、位于每个物体的坐标系中，并在这些表面重新进入视野时通过光栅化网格检索这些特征。由此，外观随物体移动而移动、跨重访而持续存在，并被每一个观测到它的智能体所共享，同时内存随所见表面的数量增长，而非随帧数增长。M2R 仅在合成数据上训练，却能零样本迁移到真实室内扫描以及由编码智能体创建的世界。它在静态、动态及多智能体基准上的一致性均优于最先进方法，物体持久性提升超过一倍、跨智能体一致性接近翻倍，同时可实时渲染 720p 视频（40 FPS）。

title: CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers
summary: Visual world models enable goal-directed planning by predicting action outcomes. Gradient-based planners optimize actions to lower predicted goal cost, but continued optimization can exploit prediction errors after execution stops improving. Comparing plans requires informative relative scores; improving them also requires reliable update directions. Exact-state execution reveals that a frozen hierarchical world model ranks goal-conditioned proposals even when its rankings among outputs of prolonged gradient search are uninformative. Effective planning pairs goal-directed candidates with predictions that distinguish their outcomes. We introduce CriticJEPA, which learns goal-conditioned flow proposals from reward-free trajectories and uses frozen rollouts to select among them at every hierarchy level. Forward selection forms a complete planner; short anchored updates refine candidates before selection. Across visual navigation and manipulation, CriticJEPA increases success at a fraction of the planning compute, transferring shared settings across independently trained models, hierarchy depths, and unseen tasks while keeping every world-model weight fixed.

AI.title_zh: CriticJEPA：世界模型作为评判者优于作为优化器
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉世界模型通过预测动作结果来实现目标导向的规划。基于梯度的规划器通过优化动作来降低预测的目标代价，但当执行不再改善时，持续优化会利用预测误差。比较不同方案需要具有信息量的相对分数；改进这些分数还需要可靠的更新方向。精确状态执行表明，一个冻结的分层世界模型即使在长时间梯度搜索的输出之间给出的排序缺乏信息量时，仍能对目标条件化的候选方案进行排序。有效的规划将目标导向的候选方案与能够区分其结果的预测相配对。我们提出 CriticJEPA，它从无奖励轨迹中学习目标条件化的流（flow）候选方案，并利用冻结的 rollout 在每一层级上从中进行选择。前向选择构成一个完整的规划器；短的锚定更新在选择之前对候选方案进行细化。在视觉导航与操作任务中，CriticJEPA 以一小部分规划计算量提升了成功率，在独立训练的模型、不同层级深度和未见任务之间迁移共享的设置，同时保持所有世界模型权重固定不变。

title: LRQ-Cache: Compressing Feature Caches in Video Diffusion via Low-Rank Approximation and Quantization
summary: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity generation, but inference is expensive because every denoising step evaluates a large transformer over all spatiotemporal tokens of the video. Temporal caching accelerates them by reusing intermediate features across denoising steps. However, retaining dense feature tensors introduces a persistent storage cost that grows with video length, resolution, and cache coverage, reaching 109-346 GiB per video for the predictive caches we evaluate. Such states exceed the memory of a single GPU, so native caches must either be offloaded to the CPU, which slows generation, or be sharded across several GPUs, e.g., with sequence parallelism, so that the cache rather than the compute sets the number of GPUs. We instead shrink the cached state itself, exploiting its redundancy: a few channel patterns shared across tokens capture much of the energy of each cached feature. Based on this observation, we propose LRQ-Cache, a training-free method that combines low-rank approximation and quantization for feature-cache compression. LRQ-Cache represents each cached feature with a small set of factors, quantizes them before storage, and reconstructs the feature at reuse time, leaving cache mechanisms unchanged. Across three caching mechanisms on HunyuanVideo and Wan2.1, LRQ-Cache reduces the persistent state of predictive caches by 42-71x, to 2.3-4.9 GiB per video. VBench stays within 0.25 pp of the native cache for TeaCache, and the larger drops of the Wan2.1 predictive caches, up to 3.5 pp, shrink at higher ranks. As a result, predictive caches that exceed the memory of a single 80 GB H100 GPU fit on it with LRQ-Cache, making generation 2.7-5.9x faster than with CPU-offloaded native caches.

AI.title_zh: LRQ-Cache：通过低秩近似与量化压缩视频扩散中的特征缓存
AI.abstract_zh: 视频扩散Transformer（DiT）能够实现高保真生成，但其推理代价高昂，因为每个去噪步骤都要在视频的全部时空token上评估一个大型Transformer。时间缓存通过在去噪步骤之间复用中间特征来加速这一过程。然而，保留稠密的特征张量会带来持续的存储开销，该开销随视频长度、分辨率和缓存覆盖范围而增长；对于我们评估的预测性缓存，每个视频的存储量达到109–346 GiB。此类状态超出了单块GPU的内存容量，因此原生缓存要么必须卸载到CPU（这会拖慢生成），要么必须跨多块GPU进行分片（例如借助序列并行），从而使决定GPU数量的因素变成缓存而非计算。我们转而压缩缓存状态本身，利用其冗余性：跨token共享的少数通道模式即可捕获每个缓存特征的大部分能量。基于这一观察，我们提出LRQ-Cache，一种免训练方法，将低秩近似与量化相结合以压缩特征缓存。LRQ-Cache用一小组因子表示每个缓存特征，在存储前对其量化，并在复用时重建该特征，同时保持缓存机制不变。在HunyuanVideo和Wan2.1上的三种缓存机制中，LRQ-Cache将预测性缓存的持续状态缩减42–71倍，降至每个视频2.3–4.9 GiB。对于TeaCache，VBench与原生缓存的差距保持在0.25个百分点以内；而Wan2.1预测性缓存较大的下降（最高达3.5个百分点）在更高秩下会缩小。因此，原本超出单块80 GB H100 GPU内存的预测性缓存借助LRQ-Cache可以容纳于其上，使生成速度相比使用CPU卸载的原生缓存快2.7–5.9倍。

title: Get the Next Moment Right: Short-Term Event Planning for Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: Video generation models synthesize realistic imagery yet still struggle to produce physically plausible evolution. Existing methods guide generation with a motion trajectory predicted for the entire clip in advance, so prediction errors accumulate and degrade later frames. We propose STEP(Short-Term Event Planning), a training-free closed-loop framework that guides generation one short clip at a time. Each round consists of four steps: grounding measures the scene state from the latest frames, event planning predicts the next physical event and renders it into a control clip, latent-guided generation produces the next short clip under this control, and verification checks whether the event occurs and resamples the clip if it does not. Because each round is grounded in the frames actually generated, control relies only on reliable short-range predictions. STEP improves the physical plausibility of three frozen generators on Physics-IQ Verified and PhyGenBench, and can be applied to new generators without training.

AI.title_zh: 把握下一个瞬间：面向物理合理视频生成的短期事件规划
AI.abstract_zh: 视频生成模型能够合成逼真的图像，但仍难以生成物理上合理的演化过程。现有方法使用预先为整段视频预测的运动轨迹来引导生成，因此预测误差会累积并导致后续帧质量下降。我们提出 STEP（Short-Term Event Planning，短期事件规划），这是一个无需训练的闭环框架，它一次引导生成一个短片段。每一轮包含四个步骤：grounding（场景定位）从最新的帧中测量场景状态；event planning（事件规划）预测下一个物理事件并将其渲染为控制片段；latent-guided generation（潜空间引导生成）在该控制下生成下一个短片段；verification（验证）检查该事件是否发生，若未发生则重新采样该片段。由于每一轮都基于实际生成的帧进行场景定位，控制仅依赖可靠的短程预测。STEP 在 Physics-IQ Verified 和 PhyGenBench 上提升了三个冻结生成器的物理合理性，并且无需训练即可应用于新的生成器。

title: SofaSpace: A Benchmark for Executable Visual Spatial Reasoning in Continuous Motion and Environment Construction
summary: A rigid body can fit at its start and goal yet collide with a wall as it moves between them. Inspired by the moving sofa problem, we introduce SofaSpace, a benchmark for visual spatial reasoning through continuous planar rigid-body transport and environment construction. SofaSpace contains 3,000 scenes organized around three challenges: geometric compatibility, nonlocal maneuver planning, and interactive and temporal coordination. Four task views ask models to plan a motion, reconstruct a layout, design an environment that meets transport requirements, or jointly generate a layout and a motion. A separate set of 534 SofaSpace-Hard tasks tests planning and judgment. A geometric verifier checks the entire body throughout each submitted motion. On static planning tasks, endpoint agreement and continuous validity differ substantially within the same submitted plans: Claude drops from 97.2% to 52.8%, DeepSeek from 100.0% to 30.6%, and Kimi from 97.2% to 29.4%, while the strongest configuration retains 98.3% full validity. Environment construction reveals a further gap. Of 295 feasible layouts generated by the strongest configuration, 181 satisfy all evaluated functional requirements; for Kimi, one of 172 does. These results show how executable checks distinguish endpoint agreement from valid motion and geometric feasibility from functional compliance.

AI.title_zh: SofaSpace：面向连续运动与环境构建的可执行视觉空间推理基准
AI.abstract_zh: 刚体在其起点与目标位置都能放得下，但在两者之间移动时却可能与墙壁碰撞。受移动沙发问题（moving sofa problem）启发，我们提出了 SofaSpace，一个通过连续平面刚体运输与环境构建进行视觉空间推理的基准。SofaSpace 包含 3,000 个场景，围绕三项挑战组织：几何兼容性、非局部机动规划，以及交互与时间协调。四种任务视图要求模型规划运动、重建布局、设计满足运输要求的环境，或联合生成布局与运动。另有一组独立的 534 个 SofaSpace-Hard 任务用于测试规划与判断。几何验证器会在每个提交的运动全过程中检查整个刚体。在静态规划任务上，同一批提交的计划中，端点一致性与连续有效性存在显著差异：Claude 从 97.2% 降至 52.8%，DeepSeek 从 100.0% 降至 30.6%，Kimi 从 97.2% 降至 29.4%，而最强配置仍保持 98.3% 的完全有效性。环境构建揭示了进一步的差距。在最强配置生成的 295 个可行布局中，有 181 个满足所有被评估的功能性要求；而对于 Kimi，172 个中仅有 1 个满足。这些结果表明，可执行检查如何将端点一致性与有效运动区分开来，并将几何可行性与功能合规性区分开来。

title: CaveBench: Benchmarking Abductive Physical Reasoning from Internal Observations
comment: 50 pages, 47 figures, 13 tables, including the appendix. Guanxin Lin and Chen Yang contributed equally. Chen Wang is the corresponding author. Project page: https://pier-lab.github.io/CaveBench/
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are advancing in physical reasoning, but whether they can understand external physical drivers from internal observations remains an open question. Existing benchmarks have not specifically targeted this setting. To this end, we introduce CaveBench, a benchmark for abductive physical reasoning from internal observations. Models receive apparatus descriptions and internal images while the external controls remain hidden, and must infer the operations responsible for the observed responses. CaveBench spans 20 apparatus scenes in five physical domains and contains 10,200 simulated episodes, split into 9,000 training, 1,000 validation, and 200 test episodes. Questions span one to six events and require the complete control set at every event, testing whether an explanation accounts for the entire process. Synchronized observations and control records provide the inputs and reference answers. Evaluating 27 VLM configurations yields six-event exact-match accuracies of 68.0% for the strongest closed-source model and 12.5% for the strongest open-weight model. Seven adaptation baselines show that single-event gains need not improve complete sequences. Error analysis identifies failures in visual identification, physical inference, evidence integration, and action composition, specifying where current models struggle to connect internal phenomena with their external causes.

AI.title_zh: CaveBench：从内部观测进行溯因物理推理的基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在物理推理方面不断取得进展，但它们能否从内部观测中理解外部物理驱动因素，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。现有基准尚未专门针对这一设定。为此，我们提出 CaveBench，一个用于从内部观测进行溯因物理推理的基准。模型接收装置描述与内部图像，而外部控制保持隐藏，模型必须推断出导致所观测响应的操作。CaveBench 涵盖五个物理域中的 20 个装置场景，包含 10,200 个模拟回合，划分为 9,000 个训练回合、1,000 个验证回合和 200 个测试回合。问题涉及一至六个事件，并要求在每个事件给出完整的控制集合，从而检验解释是否覆盖整个过程。同步的观测与控制记录提供了输入与参考答案。对 27 种 VLM 配置进行评估，六事件精确匹配准确率在最强闭源模型上为 68.0%，在最强开放权重模型上为 12.5%。七种适配基线表明，单事件上的增益未必能改善完整序列。错误分析识别出视觉识别、物理推断、证据整合与动作组合方面的失败，指明了当前模型在将内部现象与其外部原因相联系时所面临的困难所在。

title: Disentangling Visual Dynamics for World Model Planning
summary: Visual world models enable planning through predictive latent states. However, entangled agent and exogenous dynamics can obscure task progress. Disentangling visual dynamics for planning requires addressing two challenges: 1) suppressing cross-factor interference while retaining useful information; and 2) linking factors to task-relevant signals, since stability alone does not ensure meaningful planning distances. Therefore, we introduce FactorWorld, a disentangled visual dynamics framework for world model planning. To separate agent and exogenous dynamics, we propose a Counterfactual Consensus Residual Factorizer (CCRF) guided by bidirectional counterfactual pairs. CCRF separates shared context from dynamic residuals, combining average and worst-partner constraints to suppress interference with state and motion supervision to retain useful information. To translate these factors into planning decisions, we introduce semantic routing to refine full-representation task predictions for state estimation, trajectory scoring, and task-adapted planning. Experiments on MiniGrid, MetaDrive, and CARLA show improved bidirectional factor stability across two backbones. On MiniGrid, factor routing raises mean SR from 78.80% to 82.40%. Across four continuous control tasks, including Push-T, FactorWorld achieves mean success rates ranging from 91.67% to 100% across tasks. These results demonstrate that combining decoupled visual dynamics with explicit tasks can significantly improve the planning capabilities of world models.

AI.title_zh: 解耦视觉动力学以用于世界模型规划
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉世界模型通过预测性潜在状态实现规划。然而，纠缠的智能体动力学与外源动力学可能会掩盖任务进展。为规划而解耦视觉动力学需要解决两个挑战：1）在保留有用信息的同时抑制跨因子干扰；2）将各因子与任务相关信号关联起来，因为仅靠稳定性并不能保证有意义的规划距离。因此，我们提出 FactorWorld，一个用于世界模型规划的解耦视觉动力学框架。为分离智能体动力学与外源动力学，我们提出了一种由双向反事实对引导的反事实共识残差分解器（Counterfactual Consensus Residual Factorizer，CCRF）。CCRF 将共享上下文与动态残差分离，结合平均伙伴约束与最差伙伴约束，以在借助状态监督和运动监督保留有用信息的同时抑制干扰。为将这些因子转化为规划决策，我们引入了语义路由，用以细化用于状态估计、轨迹评分和任务自适应规划的完整表示任务预测。在 MiniGrid、MetaDrive 和 CARLA 上的实验表明，在两个骨干网络上双向因子稳定性均有所提升。在 MiniGrid 上，因子路由将平均 SR 从 78.80% 提升至 82.40%。在包括 Push-T 在内的四个连续控制任务中，FactorWorld 在各任务上的平均成功率为 91.67% 至 100%。这些结果表明，将解耦的视觉动力学与显式任务相结合可以显著提升世界模型的规划能力。

title: Seeing Is Not Reaching: Instruction Shortcuts Override Visual Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 31 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/QZhang2111/psg
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are expected to inherit visual grounding from vision-language models, yet often reach for an object's training location after it has been moved. Across six VLAs, we identify two shortcuts: a scene shortcut, where the arm follows the scene's original task despite a new instruction, and an instruction shortcut, where the instruction retrieves the requested object's training location. In $π_{0.5}$, the instruction shortcut persists even though object-name attention follows the moved target. We call this Seeing Is Not Reaching. To determine whether this grounding is unused or overridden, we separately mask an image-mediated grounding pathway and a direct instruction-to-action pathway. Masking the grounding pathway eliminates reaches to moved targets, whereas masking the direct pathway increases them. Thus, grounding already guides action but is often overridden by the instruction shortcut, which acts through the direct pathway. We introduce Pathway-Separated Guidance (PSG), which amplifies grounding and suppresses the shortcut without training or external target locations. On LIBERO-PRO Object under Position perturbations, PSG raises the target-reaching rate from 22.0% to 52.6% and task success from 16.6% to 40.8%, while largely preserving performance on the original tasks.

AI.title_zh: 看见并不等于够到：指令捷径在视觉-语言-动作模型中覆盖了视觉定位
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）被期望从视觉-语言模型中继承视觉定位能力，然而当物体被移动之后，它们常常仍会伸向该物体的训练位置。在六个 VLA 上，我们识别出两种捷径：场景捷径（scene shortcut），即尽管给出了新指令，机械臂仍遵循场景原本的任务；以及指令捷径（instruction shortcut），即指令检索出所请求物体的训练位置。在 $π_{0.5}$ 中，尽管物体名称的注意力会跟随被移动的目标，指令捷径依然持续存在。我们将这一现象称为"看见并不等于够到"（Seeing Is Not Reaching）。为了判定这种定位能力是未被使用还是被覆盖，我们分别对一条经由图像中介的定位通路和一条从指令直达动作的通路进行掩蔽。掩蔽定位通路会消除对移动目标的伸取，而掩蔽直接通路则会增加这种伸取。因此，定位能力已经在引导动作，但常常被通过直接通路起作用的指令捷径所覆盖。我们提出通路分离引导（Pathway-Separated Guidance, PSG），它在无需训练、也无需外部目标位置的情况下放大定位并抑制该捷径。在位置扰动下的 LIBERO-PRO Object 上，PSG 将目标伸取率从 22.0% 提升至 52.6%，将任务成功率从 16.6% 提升至 40.8%，同时基本保持了在原始任务上的性能。

title: RoboProbe: Benchmarking Physical Plausibility of Robot World Models
summary: Evaluating the physical plausibility of generated videos is critical for reliable robotic planning with world models. These videos inform action proposal and assessment before real-world execution, so undetected physical violations can lead to erroneous assessments of action feasibility and safety. Yet current video generators often produce physically implausible interactions.
