Detecting such violations directly with vision-language models (VLMs) remains challenging as physical verification requires evidence-grounded spatiotemporal reasoning beyond high-level semantic understanding. We develop five law-specific metrics for evaluating physical plausibility by combining spatiotemporal evidence from segmentation, tracking, 3D geometry, or appearance comparisons with targeted VLM reasoning: Contact fidelity, Object persistence, Solidity, Robot deformation, and Object deformation. Building on this metric suite, we introduce RoboProbe, an agentic evaluation framework that coordinates metric execution and selectively refines evaluations through constrained actions. To evaluate the physical plausibility of robot world models, we further introduce RP-Bench, with 761 human-labeled generated videos and 130 real demonstrations of 239 manipulation tasks from 12 robot datasets. On RP-Bench, all five metrics achieve AUROCs above 0.85 and outperform the evaluated learned judges, prior evaluators, and a frames-only Gemini baseline. Applying these metrics to five video generators reveals distinct patterns of physical violations across models, in both violation types and frequencies.

AI.title_zh: RoboProbe：机器人世界模型物理合理性的基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: 评估生成视频的物理合理性对于借助世界模型进行可靠的机器人规划至关重要。这些视频在真实世界执行之前为动作提议与评估提供依据，因此未被检测到的物理违规可能导致对动作可行性与安全性的错误评估。然而，当前的视频生成器常常产生物理上不合理的交互。直接用视觉语言模型（VLMs）检测此类违规仍然具有挑战性，因为物理验证需要基于证据的时空推理，而非高层语义理解。我们通过将来自分割、跟踪、3D几何或外观比较的时空证据与有针对性的VLM推理相结合，开发了五项针对特定定律的指标来评估物理合理性：接触保真度（Contact fidelity）、物体持续性（Object persistence）、固体性（Solidity）、机器人形变（Robot deformation）和物体形变（Object deformation）。在此指标套件的基础上，我们提出RoboProbe，一个代理式评估框架，它协调指标执行并通过受限动作选择性地细化评估。为了评估机器人世界模型的物理合理性，我们进一步提出RP-Bench，包含来自12个机器人数据集的239个操作任务的761个经人工标注的生成视频和130个真实演示。在RP-Bench上，全部五项指标均达到0.85以上的AUROC，并优于所评估的学习型评判器、先前的评估器以及仅使用帧的Gemini基线。将这些指标应用于五个视频生成器，揭示了不同模型在物理违规类型和频率上各具特点的模式。

title: The Old Scene Lives in the Cache: Diagnosing and Shedding Stale History in Streaming Video Generation
summary: Switching scenes while preserving the original subject in streaming video generation exposes a conflict: cached history helps maintain the subject but also sustains old-scene objects that should disappear. Through controlled interventions on text conditioning, denoising steps, the local window, and the attention sink, we identify how cached visual history keeps this obsolete content. When the original frames remain in the cache, KV flush and sink recomputation still leave old-scene objects in the generated videos. Replacing this history with target-scene history largely removes those objects, but also changes the subject, reducing face similarity to the pre-switch subject. We then propose Molt Forcing, a training-free method that rebuilds scene history from a cold-start target scene while selectively retaining subject tokens from the original cache. Across 16 scene families, Molt Forcing removes old-scene objects at least as reliably as an Echo-Forcing hard cut while keeping the subject much closer to its pre-switch appearance.

AI.title_zh: 旧场景栖身于缓存之中：诊断并蜕除流式视频生成中的陈旧历史
AI.abstract_zh: 在流式视频生成中，在保留原始主体的同时切换场景暴露出一种冲突：缓存的历史有助于维持主体，但也会延续本应消失的旧场景物体。通过对文本条件、去噪步骤、局部窗口和注意力汇（attention sink）进行受控干预，我们识别出缓存的视觉历史是如何保留这些过时内容的。当原始帧仍留在缓存中时，KV 清空（flush）和汇重计算（sink recomputation）仍会使旧场景物体残留在生成的视频中。用目标场景的历史替换该历史在很大程度上消除了这些物体，但也会改变主体，使面部相似度相对于切换前的主体降低。随后我们提出 Molt Forcing，这是一种无需训练的方法，它从冷启动的目标场景重建场景历史，同时有选择地保留来自原始缓存的主体 token。在 16 个场景类别上，Molt Forcing 消除旧场景物体的可靠性至少与 Echo-Forcing 硬切（hard cut）相当，同时使主体与切换前外观保持得更为接近。

title: PhysRF-WorldJEPA: Transforming Heterogeneous Large Language Models into Manifold-Decoupled Millimeter-Wave Radar World Models
summary: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving, all-weather physical scene understanding across darkness, smoke, and walls. However, standard instruction tuning treats continuous radar streams as static text-like tokens, causing near-random global radar-to-text retrieval and severe physical drift under sensor blackouts. Conversely, coupling pairwise contrastive losses (e.g., SigLIP) directly into the shared backbone improves retrieval but injects $O(B^2)$ repulsive gradients that fracture continuous coordinate manifolds ($R^2 < 0$). We present PhysRF-WorldJEPA, a manifold-decoupled Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) that separates continuous electromagnetic state prediction from cross-modal language alignment. An unattenuated 1.0x clock anchor and parallel dual-scale RF encoder feed a lean ~3% LoRA LLM trained with two-step state-space EMA-JEPA (Denoise -> Rollout) and sample-axis Batch-VICReg to predict +3.0 s physical states; a stop-gradient alignment head then maps frozen prompt states onto the text hypersphere with false-negative masking. On a 4,541-window tri-domain suite (77/60.25/60 GHz) against 10 baselines, freezing the physical backbone and training only the decoupled head lifts R->T R@10 from 5.95% to 15.01% and improves MedRank from 107.0 to 60.0 while preserving identical physical readout: 3.37 deg ($R^2=+0.961$) blackout +3.0 s torso tilt, 1.89 m ($R^2=+0.679$; 1.19 m/+0.863 at the RF front-end) cluttered UAV altitude, 2.04 m ($R^2=+0.461$) behind-wall NLOS range, 0.9976 virtual-RIS invariance, and 100% fall recall. Across five 0.5B-1.8B LLM families (15 zero-overhead models), World-JEPA improves retrieval and 75%-drop completion in 10/10 runs and blackout tilt in 4/5 (Span-Euc), 2/5 (Scatter), and 5/5 (per-family best) over SFT.

AI.title_zh: PhysRF-WorldJEPA：将异构大语言模型转化为流形解耦的毫米波雷达世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 将大语言模型（LLM）适配到毫米波（mmWave）雷达，可实现跨黑暗、烟雾与墙体环境的隐私保护、全天候物理场景理解。然而，标准的指令微调将连续的雷达流视为静态的类文本 token，导致近乎随机的全局雷达到文本检索，并在传感器中断（blackout）下产生严重的物理漂移。相反，将成对对比损失（如 SigLIP）直接耦合进共享主干可改善检索，但会注入 $O(B^2)$ 的排斥梯度，从而撕裂连续坐标流形（$R^2 < 0$）。我们提出 PhysRF-WorldJEPA，一种流形解耦的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），将连续电磁状态预测与跨模态语言对齐分离。一个不衰减的 1.0x 时钟锚点与并行的双尺度 RF 编码器，馈入一个精简的、约 3% LoRA 的 LLM，该 LLM 采用两步状态空间 EMA-JEPA（去噪 -> 推演，Denoise -> Rollout）与样本轴 Batch-VICReg 训练，以预测 +3.0 s 的物理状态；随后一个带停止梯度（stop-gradient）的对齐头在假负例掩蔽（false-negative masking）下将冻结的提示状态映射到文本超球面上。在包含 4,541 个窗口的三域套件（77/60.25/60 GHz）上，与 10 个基线相比，冻结物理主干、仅训练解耦头可将 R->T R@10 从 5.95% 提升至 15.01%，并将 MedRank 从 107.0 改善至 60.0，同时保持完全相同的物理读出：3.37 度（$R^2=+0.961$）中断 +3.0 s 躯干倾斜、1.89 m（$R^2=+0.679$；RF 前端处为 1.19 m/+0.863）杂波环境下的无人机高度、2.04 m（$R^2=+0.461$）穿墙 NLOS 距离、0.9976 虚拟-RIS 不变性，以及 100% 跌倒召回率。在五个 0.5B-1.8B 的 LLM 系列（15 个零开销模型）中，World-JEPA 在 10/10 次运行中改善了检索与 75% 丢包补全，并在 4/5（Span-Euc）、2/5（Scatter）以及 5/5（各系列最佳）的配置上相对 SFT 改善了中断倾斜。

title: PreferenceScene: Personalized Indoor Scene Synthesis from Feedback
summary: Text-to-scene methods turn a short instruction into a furnished 3D room, but the room that a particular person wants rarely comes across fully in words: many preferences surface only when the person sees a concrete room and can point to what they like and dislike in it. We therefore study personalized indoor scene synthesis under hidden user preferences: over several turns, a system shows a 3D scene, and the user, who sees only rendered images of the scene, replies with brief free-form feedback and a satisfaction score. The system must therefore bring the whole room toward the user's preferences from feedback that comments on only part of it at a time. It must also be able to change every part of the room, because a preference concerns not only single objects but the look and atmosphere that surfaces, lighting, textiles, furniture and their arrangement create together. We present PreferenceScene, in which a large language model keeps an explicit estimate of the user's preferences for every design attribute of the room and, after each turn, infers the taste behind the feedback and revises the whole estimate, including the parts that the feedback does not mention. A scene instantiation module builds every estimated value as its own part of the room, so that each of these parts can follow the user's preferences. We evaluate on the test set of a benchmark with 320 instances in ten room types, with a simulated user and a render-based evaluator. PreferenceScene matches the hidden preferences better than five published text-to-scene baselines adapted to the same interaction, and its match rises with every turn. It even surpasses them when they are given the preferences directly, and a vision-language model rates its scenes as the most realistic and functional.

AI.title_zh: PreferenceScene：基于反馈的个性化室内场景合成
AI.abstract_zh: 文本到场景（text-to-scene）方法能将一句简短指令转化为布置好家具的3D房间，但某个人所期望的房间很少能被文字完整表达：许多偏好只有在人看到具体房间、并能够指出自己喜欢和不喜欢之处时才会显现。因此，我们研究隐藏用户偏好下的个性化室内场景合成：在若干轮对话中，系统展示一个3D场景，而仅能看到该场景渲染图像的用户以简短的自由形式反馈和一个满意度分数进行回复。因此，系统必须依据每次只评论房间一部分的反馈，将整个房间朝用户偏好的方向调整。系统还必须能够改变房间的每一个部分，因为偏好不仅涉及单个物体，还涉及表面、光照、织物、家具及其布置共同营造的外观与氛围。我们提出PreferenceScene，其中大语言模型对房间的每一个设计属性都保持对用户偏好的显式估计，并在每一轮之后推断反馈背后的品味，修订整个估计，包括反馈中未提及的部分。场景实例化模块将每一个估计值构建为房间中各自对应的部分，从而使这些部分中的每一个都能遵循用户的偏好。我们在一个包含十种房间类型、320个实例的基准测试集上进行评估，使用模拟用户和基于渲染的评估器。PreferenceScene比五个经过适配以用于相同交互的已发表文本到场景基线更好地匹配隐藏偏好，且其匹配程度随每一轮提升。即使直接将偏好提供给这些基线，它也能超越它们；并且，一个视觉-语言模型将其场景评为最真实且最具功能性。

title: Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments
summary: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.

AI.title_zh: Clinical3D-Bench：评估与提升多模态大语言模型在医院环境中的空间智能
AI.abstract_zh: 医院中的空间推理要求追踪外观相似的设备、解读相对于患者的方向，以及判断通道宽度，然而现有基准对这些能力的覆盖有限。我们提出 Clinical3D-Bench，这是一个模拟基准，包含 3,368 个问题、共八种类型，基于 373 个医院病房布局的第一人称（egocentric）漫游视频。布局遵循医院设计指南，答案由 3D 场景计算得出，并通过成对的场景状态检验模型在相关证据发生变化时是否会改变其答案。视频具有照片级真实感，十位医生对布局进行了筛查。在 35 个多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中，表现最好的开源与专有模型分别达到 45.7% 和 53.6% 的宏平均准确率，相比之下答案先验（answer prior）为 40.8%，医生在子集上为 79.0%；32 个开源模型中有 27 个在两向患者相对方向任务上得分低于 40%。在我们包含 44,750 个问题的训练集 Clinical3D-45K 上进行微调，使两个 MLLM 比表现最好的专有模型高出 16–20 个百分点。作为输入提供给微调后 MLLM 的 3D 地图基本未被利用：将其替换为另一个视频的地图，即使替换为真实标注（ground truth），其准确率也几乎没有变化。所提出的 GeoJeV 则让 MLLM 借助 3D 进行计算：它从每个视频重建场景记忆，从 MLLM 的问题状态中选择 3D 操作及其参数，并将其证据加入到选项得分中。它在所有被评估的模型中取得了最高准确率，缩小了与医生的差距。

title: SurgGenesis: A Generative Surgical World Model for Future-Aware Surgical Understanding
summary: Surgical scene understanding is constrained by data scarcity and long-tail class imbalance, as annotating surgical videos demands scarce clinical expertise while rare procedural events remain underrepresented. We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

AI.title_zh: SurgGenesis：一种面向未来感知手术理解的生成式手术世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 手术场景理解受限于数据稀缺与长尾类别不平衡：标注手术视频需要稀缺的临床专业知识，而罕见手术事件仍然代表性不足。我们通过数据生成来应对这一问题，并提出 SurgGenesis——一种生成式手术世界模型，它从视觉观察和文本化的手术流程描述中，在潜空间中学习未来手术状态转移，从而充当可扩展的手术数据引擎。为使大规模视频扩散模型适应数据稀缺的手术领域而不发生灾难性遗忘，我们引入三阶段渐进式 LoRA 策略，逐步注入内窥镜视觉先验、手术流程语义和空间运动线索。我们不只以视觉保真度评判生成结果，而是沿两条轴线验证 SurgGenesis，以将其与世界模型区分于通用生成器：(i) 未来感知性，通过 GT 潜变量预测差距（GT-latent prediction gap）和时间跨度分析，将预测的未来与真实未来进行比较；(ii) 动作忠实的可用性，检查生成的片段是否包含所指令的手术三元组，以及将其用于重新平衡长尾事件并驱动下游理解（分割、三元组识别、3D 重建）是否能带来动作特定的增益。因此，条件化的未来可作为对常规长尾采样的补充。代码：https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

title: Instant LiDAR: Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction for LiDAR Simulation
summary: LiDAR reconstruction supports closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, but hours of per-scene optimization make large asset libraries costly to build and maintain. We present Instant LiDAR, a feed-forward pipeline that reconstructs multiple LiDAR scans as reusable Gaussian assets in minutes without per-scene optimization. LiDAR measurements provide strong geometric priors, but directly initializing Gaussians from them yields poor reconstruction due to nonuniform sampling and a limited field of view. Sparse returns leave surface gaps, while combining scans expands coverage but introduces redundant primitives. To address these challenges, Instant LiDAR combines measurement-anchored Gaussian prediction, sampling-aware Gaussian scales, and multi-frame consolidation. The predictor refines attributes anchored to recorded returns, while the scales adapt spatial support to LiDAR sampling. Multi-frame consolidation merges overlapping predictions into a compact asset spanning the driving log. Compared with NuRec, Instant LiDAR reconstructs scenes approximately 46 times faster on Physical AI (PAI) and 70 times faster on Waymo. It also achieves comparable downstream 3D detection accuracy on Waymo.

AI.title_zh: Instant LiDAR：面向 LiDAR 仿真的前馈高斯重建
AI.abstract_zh: LiDAR 重建支持闭环自动驾驶仿真，但每个场景需要数小时的优化，使得大型资产库的构建与维护成本高昂。我们提出 Instant LiDAR，一个前馈式流水线，可在数分钟内将多次 LiDAR 扫描重建为可复用的高斯资产，且无需逐场景优化。LiDAR 测量提供了强几何先验，但由于采样不均匀且视场有限，直接用其初始化高斯会导致重建效果不佳。稀疏的返回点在表面留下空隙，而合并扫描虽可扩大覆盖范围，却会引入冗余图元。为应对这些挑战，Instant LiDAR 结合了以测量为锚点的高斯预测、采样感知的高斯尺度以及多帧整合。预测器对锚定于记录返回点的属性进行细化，而尺度则将空间支撑自适应于 LiDAR 采样。多帧整合将重叠的预测合并为跨越整个驾驶日志的紧凑资产。与 NuRec 相比，Instant LiDAR 在 Physical AI（PAI）上的重建速度快约 46 倍，在 Waymo 上快约 70 倍；在 Waymo 上，其下游 3D 检测精度也达到可比水平。

title: DeCo-Attention: Decompose to Compensate for Low-Precision Attention
summary: Self-attention over tens of thousands of tokens dominates the generation time of video diffusion transformers, because its cost grows quadratically with sequence length. The FP4 matrix products of modern GPUs can speed up attention, but the 4-bit rounding of the queries Q and the keys K introduces large errors. We show that the exponential in softmax amplifies the error of their product QK, which therefore dominates the attention error. We propose DeCo-Attention, a co-design of algorithm and system for low-precision attention. DeCo-Attention is training-free and compensates the rounding error of Q and K along a few principal directions found by a per-head eigendecomposition. The lightweight compensation terms are appended to Q and K as extra channels, so the FP4 matrix product corrects its own rounding error while it computes the attention scores. Once the products run in FP4, the softmax bounds the kernel, and we optimize the softmax so that the gain of FP4 computation translates into realized speedup. With QK in FP4, we implement DeCo-Attention with the rest of attention in FP8 on GB300 and VR200 and in FP4 on RTX PRO 6000. On Wan2.2, these kernels run 2.13x, 2.49x, and 2.82x faster than BF16 attention, and the whole generation runs 1.55x, 1.68x, and 1.80x faster. On four video generation models, the FP8 configuration achieves LPIPS comparable to prior 8-bit QK methods, and the fully FP4 configuration lower LPIPS than prior fully 4-bit kernels.

AI.title_zh: DeCo-Attention：分解以补偿低精度注意力
AI.abstract_zh: 在数万个 token 上的自注意力主导了视频扩散 Transformer 的生成时间，因为其开销随序列长度呈二次方增长。现代 GPU 的 FP4 矩阵乘法可以加速注意力，但对查询 Q 和键 K 的 4 比特舍入会引入较大误差。我们表明，softmax 中的指数运算会放大二者乘积 QK 的误差，因此该误差主导了注意力误差。我们提出 DeCo-Attention，一种面向低精度注意力的算法与系统协同设计。DeCo-Attention 无需训练，并沿着由逐头特征分解（per-head eigendecomposition）得到的少数主方向补偿 Q 和 K 的舍入误差。轻量的补偿项作为额外通道附加到 Q 和 K 上，使得 FP4 矩阵乘法在计算注意力分数的同时修正自身的舍入误差。一旦这些乘积以 FP4 运行，softmax 便成为该内核的瓶颈，因此我们优化 softmax，使 FP4 计算的收益转化为实际加速。在 QK 采用 FP4 的情况下，我们在 GB300 和 VR200 上将 DeCo-Attention 实现为注意力其余部分采用 FP8，在 RTX PRO 6000 上则采用 FP4。在 Wan2.2 上，这些内核的运行速度分别比 BF16 注意力快 2.13 倍、2.49 倍和 2.82 倍，整个生成过程分别快 1.55 倍、1.68 倍和 1.80 倍。在四个视频生成模型上，FP8 配置取得了与先前 8 比特 QK 方法相当的 LPIPS，而全 FP4 配置的 LPIPS 低于先前的全 4 比特内核。

title: Do Occupancy World Models Really Follow Actions?
summary: Occupancy world models predict future 3D scenes conditioned on ego actions, yet their predictions may not faithfully follow the specified trajectory under counterfactual actions. Because driving datasets provide sparse coverage of alternative trajectories for each scene, existing models learn the spatial effect of ego motion implicitly from observed scene--trajectory combinations, which may entangle action effects with scene--trajectory correlations. We propose ReCast, an ego-trajectory-guided transformer that grounds future prediction in action-induced geometric correspondence across ego-centric frames. ReCast decouples historical encoding from future decoding and aligns deformable interactions using relative ego transformations, while retaining flexibility for non-rigid scene evolution. We also introduce a counterfactual action-faithfulness benchmark covering in-distribution, tail, and out-of-distribution trajectories. On Occ3D-nuScenes, ReCast achieves competitive standard forecasting performance while improving counterfactual forecasting, with particularly clear gains under out-of-distribution trajectories.

AI.title_zh: 占用世界模型真的遵循动作吗？
AI.abstract_zh: 占用世界模型以自车动作为条件预测未来的三维场景，然而在反事实动作下，其预测可能不会忠实地遵循所指定的轨迹。由于驾驶数据集对每个场景的替代轨迹覆盖稀疏，现有模型从观测到的场景—轨迹组合中隐式地学习自车运动的空间效应，这可能将动作效应与场景—轨迹相关性纠缠在一起。我们提出 ReCast，一种由自车轨迹引导的 Transformer，它将未来预测建立在跨自车中心帧的动作诱导几何对应关系之上。ReCast 将历史编码与未来解码解耦，并利用相对自车变换对齐可变形交互，同时保留对非刚性场景演化的灵活性。我们还引入了一个反事实动作忠实性基准，涵盖分布内、尾部以及分布外轨迹。在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上，ReCast 取得了具有竞争力的标准预测性能，同时改善了反事实预测，在分布外轨迹下增益尤为明显。

title: Learning Agent States for Latent Action Modeling
comment: 27 pages, 12 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://agent-state-lam.github.io
summary: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-like latents from unlabeled video by coupling frame-pair inference with latent-conditioned prediction, enabling policy and world-model pretraining. However, what the latent must explain depends on the representation space used for action inference and transition prediction. When this space entangles the agent's evolving physical state with visual context, such as background and persistent agent appearance, inferred latents can encode information unrelated to the agent's actions. To address this challenge, we propose Agent-State LAM, which jointly learns a compact agent-state representation and latent actions modeling its transitions. The compact state aggregates dense visual features into a shared space for both action inference and forward prediction. To guide what this state retains, we introduce spatially matched temporal discrimination (SMTD), which trains the state to distinguish its source frame from nearby frames through spatially flexible matching with frozen local visual features. Rather than comparing global frame representations, SMTD scores each frame by emphasizing its strongest local feature matches across spatial locations. This scoring allows background and persistent agent appearance to remain matched across frames despite displacement, making these shared cues less informative for identifying the source frame and encouraging the representation to capture the agent's evolving physical state. Extensive experiments on distracting control tasks and six real robot video datasets demonstrate improved action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM.

AI.title_zh: 学习用于潜在动作建模的智能体状态
AI.abstract_zh: 潜在动作模型（latent action models, LAMs）通过将帧对推理与以潜在变量为条件的预测相结合，从无标注视频中学习类似动作的潜在变量，从而支持策略与世界模型的预训练。然而，潜在变量必须解释什么，取决于用于动作推断和转移预测的表示空间。当该空间将智能体不断变化的物理状态与视觉上下文（例如背景和持续存在的智能体外观）纠缠在一起时，推断出的潜在变量可能编码与智能体动作无关的信息。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Agent-State LAM，它联合学习一个紧凑的智能体状态表示以及对其转移进行建模的潜在动作。该紧凑状态将稠密视觉特征聚合到一个共享空间中，供动作推断和前向预测共同使用。为引导该状态保留哪些信息，我们引入了空间匹配时间判别（spatially matched temporal discrimination, SMTD），它通过与冻结的局部视觉特征进行空间上灵活的匹配，训练该状态区分其源帧与邻近帧。SMTD 并非比较全局帧表示，而是通过在空间位置上强调每帧最强的局部特征匹配来对该帧打分。这种打分方式使得背景和持续存在的智能体外观即使发生位移也能在帧间保持匹配，从而使这些共享线索对于识别源帧的信息量降低，并促使表示捕捉智能体不断变化的物理状态。在带有干扰的控制任务和六个真实机器人视频数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在动作恢复、下游控制和世界模型预测方面均有提升。代码与检查点见 https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM 。

title: ADE: A Zero-Training Unlearning Method for Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models learn compact recurrent dynamics from offline trajectories, yet deployed simulators can retain backdoor triggers or stale transitions from outdated physical regimes. Existing unlearning methods fail in autoregressive physics: gradient updates distort latent manifolds and compound rollout drift, naive output zeroing suppresses valid control responses on trigger onset, and single-step deletion leaves corruption inside recurrent hidden states. We propose Analytical Dynamics Excision (ADE), a deterministic, zero-training closed-form unlearning algorithm for latent world models. Using only cached pretraining moments, ADE recovers retain covariances via single-pass matrix downdating without raw retain data and cascades closed-form edits across the input bottleneck, hidden states, and downstream heads. Pairing orthogonal excision with whitened recurrent damping and mean-preserving affine calibration neutralizes out-of-manifold backdoors and realigns in-manifold shifts without variance collapse. Across four regimes on three MuJoCo benchmarks, ADE outperforms seven tuned baselines on DreamerV1, eliminating HalfCheetah and Hopper velocity-flip triggers $4.4\times$ faster than fine-tuning, and transfers zero-shot to DreamerV3.

AI.title_zh: ADE：一种用于潜在世界模型的零训练遗忘方法
AI.abstract_zh: 潜在世界模型从离线轨迹中学习紧凑的循环动力学，然而已部署的模拟器可能残留后门触发器，或来自过时物理机制的陈旧转移。现有的遗忘方法在自回归物理中失效：梯度更新会扭曲潜在流形并累积展开漂移，朴素的输出置零会在触发器触发时抑制有效的控制响应，而单步删除会在循环隐藏状态内部留下污染。我们提出解析动力学切除（Analytical Dynamics Excision，ADE），一种用于潜在世界模型的确定性、零训练的闭式遗忘算法。ADE 仅使用缓存的预训练矩，通过单遍矩阵降秩更新（matrix downdating）恢复保留协方差，而无需原始保留数据，并将闭式编辑级联应用于输入瓶颈、隐藏状态和下游头。将正交切除与白化循环阻尼以及保均值仿射校准相配对，可在不造成方差崩溃的情况下中和流形外的后门并使流形内的偏移重新对齐。在三个 MuJoCo 基准上的四种情形中，ADE 在 DreamerV1 上优于七个经过调优的基线，消除 HalfCheetah 和 Hopper 速度翻转触发器的速度比微调快 $4.4\times$，并可零样本迁移至 DreamerV3。

title: SPAR: Self-Referenced World-Model Rewards for Physical Alignment in Video Generation
summary: Generating videos with physically plausible dynamics remains challenging despite advances in visual quality. Latent world models offer predictive signals for evaluating physical plausibility, but higher agreement between predicted and observed features may reflect easier-to-predict scene content rather than more plausible dynamics. We propose \textbf{S}elf-Referenced \textbf{P}hysical \textbf{A}lignment \textbf{R}ewards (\textbf{SPAR}), a framework that uses world-model predictions for inference-time physical alignment. SPAR compares each video's prediction error with that of static clips constructed by repeating its own frames, providing a content-matched reference for evaluating generated dynamics. To account for the uneven spatial and temporal distribution of physical interactions, we introduce a unified \textbf{spatiotemporal reward refinement} strategy. \textbf{Spatial refinement} emphasizes localized prediction discrepancies, while \textbf{temporal refinement} moderates brief error peaks and supplements prediction errors with agreement between predicted and observed feature changes. Evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SPAR improves the physical plausibility of both \textbf{text-to-video generation} and \textbf{image-to-video continuation}, bringing generated dynamics into closer alignment with the physical regularities governing real-world events. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/spar-page/

AI.title_zh: SPAR：用于视频生成中物理对齐的自参照世界模型奖励
AI.abstract_zh: 尽管视觉质量不断提升，生成具有物理上合理动力学的视频仍然具有挑战性。潜在世界模型（latent world models）为评估物理合理性提供了预测信号，但预测特征与观测特征之间更高的一致性可能反映的是更易于预测的场景内容，而非更合理的动力学。我们提出\textbf{自参照物理对齐奖励}（\textbf{S}elf-Referenced \textbf{P}hysical \textbf{A}lignment \textbf{R}ewards，\textbf{SPAR}），一个利用世界模型预测进行推理时物理对齐的框架。SPAR 将每个视频的预测误差与通过重复其自身帧所构建的静态片段的预测误差进行比较，从而为评估生成的动力学提供一个内容匹配的参照。为应对物理交互在空间和时间上分布不均的问题，我们引入一种统一的\textbf{时空奖励细化}（spatiotemporal reward refinement）策略。\textbf{空间细化}（Spatial refinement）强调局部化的预测差异，而\textbf{时间细化}（temporal refinement）则抑制短暂的误差峰值，并以预测特征变化与观测特征变化之间的一致性来补充预测误差。在多个基准上的评估表明，SPAR 提升了\textbf{文本到视频生成}（text-to-video generation）与\textbf{图像到视频延续}（image-to-video continuation）的物理合理性，使生成的动力学更贴近支配真实世界事件的物理规律。更多结果与资源见 https://gavin-jy.github.io/spar-page/

title: DraftKV: Protecting Persistent Worlds through Hierarchical Streaming Retrieval
comment: Includes supplementary material. Code and project page are available online
summary: Interactive video world models enable action- and camera-controlled exploration, yet struggle to maintain consistent spatial geometry and appearance when revisiting previously explored locations. Historical KV caches help auto-regressive video diffusion models maintain long-term consistency, but their retrieval and attention computation introduce substantial latency as history grows. We propose DraftKV, a training-free framework that retrieves historical KV caches based on geometric grounding and query-conditioned relevance, while combining CPU offloading with tile-wise streaming attention to reduce GPU memory usage and inference latency. Theoretically, we show that draft relevance reproduces the mean branch of full-resolution block relevance exactly, so its deviation is confined to the $β$-weighted max branch, and we bound retrieval utility loss in terms of the measured Top-K selection overlap. We further show that draft relevance cannot distinguish blocks with similar pooled descriptors regardless of camera pose, motivating geometric grounding before refinement. Then, we introduce streaming CG-Attention, which overlaps CPU-to-GPU KV transfers with attention computation through tile-wise streaming, hiding transfer latency while maintaining bounded GPU memory usage. Experiments across diverse model families show that DraftKV achieves superior generation quality and consistency while achieving $3.27\times$ end-to-end speedup and 42.2% peak GPU memory reduction over other CPU-offloaded KV cache retrieval methods. Notably, DraftKV enables high-quality interactive world generation with historical KV retrieval on a single H100 GPU using SolarWM-33B.

AI.title_zh: DraftKV：通过分层流式检索保护持久世界
AI.abstract_zh: 交互式视频世界模型能够实现由动作和相机控制的探索，但在重新访问先前探索过的位置时，难以保持一致的空间几何与外观。历史 KV 缓存有助于自回归视频扩散模型维持长期一致性，但随着历史增长，其检索与注意力计算会带来显著的延迟。我们提出 DraftKV，一个免训练框架，它基于几何锚定（geometric grounding）与查询条件相关性来检索历史 KV 缓存，同时结合 CPU 卸载与分块（tile-wise）流式注意力以降低 GPU 内存占用和推理延迟。在理论上，我们证明 draft 相关性精确复现全分辨率块相关性的均值分支，因此其偏差仅限于 $β$ 加权的最大值分支，并且我们以实测的 Top-K 选择重叠度来界定检索效用损失。我们进一步证明，draft 相关性无法区分池化描述子相似的块，无论相机位姿如何，这促使我们在细化之前先进行几何锚定。随后，我们引入流式 CG-Attention，它通过分块流式处理将 CPU 到 GPU 的 KV 传输与注意力计算重叠，从而隐藏传输延迟，同时保持 GPU 内存占用有界。在多种模型族上的实验表明，DraftKV 实现了更优的生成质量与一致性，同时相较于其他 CPU 卸载 KV 缓存检索方法，实现了 $3.27\times$ 的端到端加速和 42.2% 的峰值 GPU 内存降低。值得注意的是，DraftKV 使得在单块 H100 GPU 上使用 SolarWM-33B 进行带历史 KV 检索的高质量交互式世界生成成为可能。

title: ReJEPA: Bounded Predictive Regulation for Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models learn representations by predicting future states in an abstract embedding space rather than reconstructing raw pixels. When training across multi-frame sequences, however, not all frames and spatial regions are equally informative or predictable. We argue that forcing a world model to minimize every prediction error may be unnecessary and harmful. Under standard $L_2$ loss, unbounded gradients force the encoder and predictor to overfit noisy or transient frames at the expense of core physical structure, while amplifying gradient conflict with representation regularizers. Conversely, $L_1$ loss bounds large gradients, but its constant gradient magnitude near zero disrupts the local smoothness required for planning. We resolve this tension with \textbf{ReJEPA}, a bounded predictive regulation principle that combines bounded gradients for large errors with smooth quadratic behavior near zero, instantiated simply via the element-wise $\log\cosh$ loss. As a drop-in training replacement across Temporal Straightening, LeWorldModel, and V-JEPA~2.1, $\log\cosh$ consistently outperforms $L_2$, a curvature-matched quadratic control, $L_1$, and Smooth-$L_1$ baselines without altering architectures or inference procedures. Notably, the gains grow with environmental complexity, scaling from simple navigation to contact-rich manipulation and real-world autonomous driving on NAVSIM. Probing and geometric analyses confirm that relaxing the penalty on extreme errors yields representations that better capture physical states and align with the true planning cost landscape.

AI.title_zh: ReJEPA：面向隐世界模型的有界预测调节
AI.abstract_zh: 隐世界模型通过在抽象嵌入空间中预测未来状态而非重建原始像素来学习表示。然而，在多帧序列上训练时，并非所有帧和空间区域都具有同等的信息量或可预测性。我们认为，强制世界模型最小化每一个预测误差可能是不必要的，甚至是有害的。在标准 $L_2$ 损失下，无界梯度迫使编码器和预测器以牺牲核心物理结构为代价，对噪声帧或瞬态帧过拟合，同时加剧了与表示正则化项的梯度冲突。相反，$L_1$ 损失对较大梯度有界，但其在零附近的恒定梯度幅值会破坏规划所需的局部平滑性。我们以 \textbf{ReJEPA} 化解这一矛盾，这是一种有界预测调节原则，将大误差下的有界梯度与零附近的平滑二次行为相结合，并简单地通过逐元素 $\log\cosh$ 损失加以实现。作为在 Temporal Straightening、LeWorldModel 和 V-JEPA~2.1 上的即插即用式训练替换方案，$\log\cosh$ 在不改变架构或推理流程的情况下，一致优于 $L_2$、曲率匹配的二次对照、$L_1$ 以及 Smooth-$L_1$ 基线。值得注意的是，增益随环境复杂度而增长，从简单导航扩展到接触丰富的操作任务以及 NAVSIM 上的真实世界自动驾驶。探测分析与几何分析证实，放松对极端误差的惩罚所得到的表示能更好地刻画物理状态，并与真实的规划代价地形相吻合。

title: Loupe: Reinforcing Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation Agents
summary: Knowledge-intensive video generation remains challenging because prompts often omit the facts, appearances, and temporal relationships required for accurate generation. While search-based workflows can retrieve missing evidence, manually designed strategies limit adaptive planning, and conventional training suffers from costly video-level feedback and coarse trajectory-level credit assignment. In this paper, we present Loupe, a video generation agent that retrieves and verifies textual and visual evidence to construct evidence-grounded temporal video prompts with reference images. We further introduce Rubric-Based Credit (RBC), which leverages prompt-specific factual, visual, and temporal requirements to evaluate intermediate search and planning decisions before video rendering. Building on RBC, RBC-SFT reweights assistant-token learning by step quality, while RBC-GRPO incorporates step-level credits alongside a final planning reward, without rendering videos during RL. To address the lack of dedicated search-oriented evaluation, we construct Search-VBench, which contains 150 held-out prompts across seven categories. Experiments show that Loupe improves all four evaluation dimensions across three video generators, raising the overall score of MiniMax-H3 from 32.80 to 70.67 and outperforming an untrained search workflow. Ablation experiments show that full RBC training outperforms standard SFT followed by trajectory-level GRPO by 5.27 points. Human evaluations and results on Sci-VBench and KIVI-Bench further demonstrate improved generation quality, scientific grounding, factual precision, and helpfulness. Our project page is available at https://zengkaiya.github.io/Loupe/.

AI.title_zh: Loupe：强化知识密集型视频生成智能体
AI.abstract_zh: 知识密集型视频生成仍然具有挑战性，因为提示词往往缺失准确生成所需的事实、外观和时间关系。尽管基于搜索的工作流可以检索缺失的证据，但人工设计的策略限制了自适应规划，而传统训练又受制于代价高昂的视频级反馈以及粗粒度的轨迹级信用分配。本文提出 Loupe，一个视频生成智能体，它检索并验证文本与视觉证据，以借助参考图像构建基于证据的时间性视频提示词。我们进一步引入基于评分标准的信用（Rubric-Based Credit, RBC），它利用提示词特定的事实、视觉和时间要求，在视频渲染之前评估中间的搜索与规划决策。在 RBC 的基础上，RBC-SFT 按步骤质量对助手 token 的学习进行重加权，而 RBC-GRPO 则将步骤级信用与最终规划奖励结合，且在强化学习过程中无需渲染视频。为弥补缺乏专门的面向搜索的评测，我们构建了 Search-VBench，其中包含覆盖七个类别的 150 条留出提示词。实验表明，Loupe 在三个视频生成器上改善了全部四个评测维度，将 MiniMax-H3 的总分从 32.80 提升至 70.67，并优于未经训练的搜索工作流。消融实验表明，完整的 RBC 训练比标准 SFT 后接轨迹级 GRPO 高出 5.27 分。人工评估以及在 Sci-VBench 和 KIVI-Bench 上的结果进一步证明了生成质量、科学依据、事实准确性和有用性的提升。我们的项目页面见 https://zengkaiya.github.io/Loupe/。

title: Cheap Memory Costs Future Compute: Co-Designing Persistent KV and GPU Execution for Efficient Streaming Video Diffusion
summary: Block-causal video diffusion generates long videos block by block, conditioned on a persistent key-value (KV) cache. After each block is denoised, an extra noise-free ($t=0$) forward pass writes its clean KV into the cache; once distillation and speculative early exit make denoising cheap, this clean KV update dominates the runtime. Reusing stale KV shortens the update, but stale memory corrupts the conditioning of later blocks and inflates their denoising steps, so the saved compute reappears downstream. We present SAMR (Step-Aware Memory Reconstruction), a training-free method for frozen causal video DiTs that refreshes only part of the cache and reconstructs the rest without DiT forwards. Our key observation is that, once rotary position phases are removed, motion-aligned historical KV and the in-flight KV a token holds at its exit step are complementary estimates of its clean KV. SAMR debiases in-flight KV with offline-calibrated per-head affine maps in Pre-RoPE space, fuses the two estimates, and reserves true $t=0$ refreshes for tokens flagged by an attention-readout error proxy, all executed by tile-aligned, synchronization-free Triton kernels. On 48-second LongLive-1.3B videos, SAMR reduces DiT latency by 20.9% and principal FLOPs by 30.7% relative to dense KV updates, lowers downstream denoising steps, and improves final-quarter PSNR over token reuse by 1.61 dB (1.14 dB on held-out VidProM-16). The reconstruction also transfers to frozen Self-Forcing-DMD-1.3B: zero-shot, it reduces reuse-induced step inflation ($2.47 \to 2.30$ steps/token) and improves late PSNR by $+0.33$ dB, and a one-time training-free calibration recovers the diagnostic score that zero-shot transfer lowers ($89.62 \to 91.10$).

AI.title_zh: 廉价内存的代价是未来的算力：为高效流式视频扩散协同设计持久化 KV 与 GPU 执行
AI.abstract_zh: 块因果（block-causal）视频扩散以块为单位逐块生成长视频，并以持久化的键值（KV）缓存为条件。每个块去噪完成后，需额外执行一次无噪声（$t=0$）前向传播，将其干净的 KV 写入缓存；一旦蒸馏与推测式提前退出使去噪变得廉价，这一干净 KV 更新便主导了运行时。复用陈旧 KV 可缩短更新过程，但陈旧记忆会破坏后续块的条件信息并使其去噪步数膨胀，于是节省下来的算力又会以这种方式在下游重新出现。我们提出 SAMR（Step-Aware Memory Reconstruction，步数感知记忆重建），这是一种面向冻结因果视频 DiT 的免训练方法，它只刷新缓存的一部分，并在不进行 DiT 前向的情况下重建其余部分。我们的关键观察是：一旦去除旋转位置相位，运动对齐的历史 KV 与 token 在其退出步所持有的在途（in-flight）KV 便是其干净 KV 的两种互补估计。SAMR 在 Pre-RoPE 空间中使用离线校准的逐头仿射映射对在途 KV 进行去偏，融合这两种估计，并将真正的 $t=0$ 刷新保留给被注意力读出误差代理指标标记出的 token，所有这些都由 tile 对齐、无同步的 Triton 内核执行。在 48 秒的 LongLive-1.3B 视频上，相对于稠密 KV 更新，SAMR 将 DiT 延迟降低 20.9%、主要 FLOPs 降低 30.7%，减少下游去噪步数，并将最终四分之一片段的 PSNR 相较 token 复用提升 1.61 dB（在留出集 VidProM-16 上为 1.14 dB）。该重建方法也可迁移至冻结的 Self-Forcing-DMD-1.3B：在零样本设置下，它降低了复用导致的步数膨胀（$2.47 \to 2.30$ 步/token），并将后期 PSNR 提升 $+0.33$ dB，而一次免训练校准可恢复零样本迁移所降低的诊断分数（$89.62 \to 91.10$）。

title: AgentDRC: Multi-Agent Algorithms for Spatially-Aware Automated DRC Correction
summary: Design Rule Checking (DRC) error fixing remains a time-consuming bottleneck in physical design, often requiring manual intervention despite advanced EDA optimizations. Existing LLM-agent approaches fall short due to redundant contextual shapes, limited spatial reasoning over raw coordinates, and inefficient flat layout representations. We propose AgentDRC, which formulates iterative DRC correction as a multi-agent algorithm and introduces a spatial-aware verification and correction algorithm that reconstructs structured spatial relations among critical shapes and validates fixes through geometric and semantic constraint checking. The system coordinates four specialized agents to perceive multi-level, multi-modal geometric features, filter irrelevant shapes, and iteratively correct violations. Experiments show that AgentDRC achieves up to 30.4% pass@1 and 55.7% pass@5 on challenging violations, with 13.8% pass@5 improvement over the best baseline. We will open-source all code and benchmark tasks upon acceptance.

AI.title_zh: AgentDRC：面向空间感知的自动化DRC修正的多智能体算法
AI.abstract_zh: 设计规则检查（DRC）错误修复仍是物理设计中耗时的瓶颈，尽管已有先进的EDA优化，往往仍需人工干预。现有的LLM智能体方法因冗余的上下文图形、对原始坐标的空间推理能力有限以及低效的扁平版图表示而表现不足。我们提出AgentDRC，将迭代式DRC修正形式化为一种多智能体算法，并引入一种空间感知的验证与修正算法，该算法重建关键图形之间的结构化空间关系，并通过几何与语义约束检查来验证修正。该系统协调四个专用智能体，以感知多层级、多模态的几何特征，过滤无关图形，并迭代地修正违规。实验表明，AgentDRC在具有挑战性的违规上取得最高30.4%的pass@1和55.7%的pass@5，相较于最佳基线，pass@5提升了13.8%。我们将在论文录用后开源全部代码与基准任务。

title: Co-DRIS: Physics-Informed Predictive Belief and Variable-Impedance Learning for Reactive Catching under Coupled Uncertainty
summary: Reactive robotic manipulation is acutely sensitive to simultaneous sensing noise, measurement dropouts, joint execution errors, and contact parameter variations. While single-frame frameworks like Domain-Randomized Instance Set (DRIS) achieve strong robustness under isolated uncertainties (86.4%), they degrade severely when perception and actuation uncertainties co-occur (27.6% across 10 coupled stress scenarios) due to memoryless encoding and fixed high-stiffness PD control. We propose Co-DRIS + SuperMimic, a perception-action co-design framework coupling: (i) an inertial world-frame physics-informed world model combining exact ballistic kinematics with a zero-initialized contact residual to roll forward missing observations and accelerate training via zero-cost counterfactual dropout consistency; (ii) an action-conditioned dual-stream causal GRU belief encoder resolving the denoising-vs-lag deadlock; and (iii) phase-aware variable-impedance soft-catching that transitions the 7-DoF Franka Research 3 arm into an overdamped regime (zeta/zeta0 ~ 2.26x) at the torque layer. Under unbiased 3-seed tail evaluation on unseen throws (15,360 throws/scenario), our method achieves 89.6 +/- 0.4% on standard benchmarks (+10.5% on 4-sigma noise to 70.5%) and 66.6 +/- 0.5% across 10 coupled/dropout stress scenarios (+39.0% over DRIS; +30.4% on 50% dropout). We further validate impedance decoupling, causal contact triggering under +0.65 s flight-time shifts, and cross-task transfer to steel-plate ping-pong bouncing (87.5% to 100.0%) and FR3+Hand catching (+8.4% under 4x noise with 6-13% lower peak impact force).

AI.title_zh: Co-DRIS：面向耦合不确定性下反应式接取的物理信息预测信念与变阻抗学习
AI.abstract_zh: 反应式机器人操作对同时出现的传感噪声、测量丢包、关节执行误差以及接触参数变化极为敏感。尽管诸如域随机化实例集（Domain-Randomized Instance Set, DRIS）之类的单帧框架在孤立不确定性下具有较强鲁棒性（86.4%），但由于其无记忆编码与固定的高刚度 PD 控制，当感知与驱动不确定性同时出现时性能会严重下降（在 10 个耦合压力场景下为 27.6%）。我们提出 Co-DRIS + SuperMimic，一种感知-动作协同设计框架，将以下三部分耦合起来：(i) 一个惯性世界坐标系物理信息世界模型，将精确的抛体运动学与零初始化的接触残差相结合，以向前推演缺失的观测，并通过零成本的反事实丢包一致性来加速训练；(ii) 一个以动作为条件的双流因果 GRU 信念编码器，解决了去噪与滞后之间的僵局；(iii) 相位感知的变阻抗柔性接取，在力矩层将 7 自由度 Franka Research 3 机械臂转入过阻尼状态（zeta/zeta0 ~ 2.26 倍）。在未见投掷上的无偏 3 种子尾部评估中（每场景 15,360 次投掷），我们的方法在标准基准上达到 89.6 +/- 0.4%（在 4-sigma 噪声下提升 10.5%，达到 70.5%），并在 10 个耦合/丢包压力场景下达到 66.6 +/- 0.5%（相较 DRIS 提升 39.0%；在 50% 丢包下提升 30.4%）。我们进一步验证了阻抗解耦、在 +0.65 s 飞行时间偏移下的因果接触触发，以及向钢板乒乓球弹跳（87.5% 至 100.0%）和 FR3+Hand 接取（在 4 倍噪声下提升 8.4%，且峰值冲击力降低 6-13%）的跨任务迁移。

title: Gaze World Model
summary: Where a person looks indicates their focus of attention, and how their gaze shifts between targets reveals how that attention responds to a changing scene. Existing gaze target estimation methods largely operate frame by frame and do not model these shifts. Gaze shifts are often driven by dynamic changes in the scene, which is the kind of information world models are designed to encode. This relationship is subtle, however, since an event far across the frame may produce only a slight movement of the person's head or eyes. We therefore introduce the Gaze World Model (GWM), which co-trains latent scene prediction with person-conditioned gaze supervision on a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder; in our ablations, the latent prediction objective improves both shift detection and gaze localization. Given a video clip and the person's head box, GWM estimates gaze locations and detects gaze shifts in the observed clip, and forecasts future gaze and shifts from predicted scene features. To train and evaluate these tasks, we augment VideoAttentionTarget and ChildPlay with event-level gaze-shift annotations. GWM achieves state-of-the-art shift detection on these benchmarks, about 10 points higher in four-class AP than the strongest baseline, while remaining comparable to the strongest image-based models in gaze target estimation, and outperforms the compared baselines on future gaze localization and shift forecasting.

AI.title_zh: 注视世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 一个人看向何处指示了其注意力焦点，而其注视如何在目标之间转移，则揭示了该注意力如何对变化的场景作出响应。现有的注视目标估计方法大多逐帧运行，并未对这些转移进行建模。注视转移往往由场景中的动态变化所驱动，而这正是世界模型被设计用来编码的那类信息。然而这种关系是微妙的，因为画面另一端远处发生的事件可能只引起该人头部或眼部的轻微移动。因此，我们提出了注视世界模型（Gaze World Model, GWM），它在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器上，将潜在场景预测与以人为条件的注视监督进行联合训练；在我们的消融实验中，潜在预测目标同时提升了转移检测与注视定位。给定一段视频片段和该人的头部框，GWM 估计所观测片段中的注视位置并检测注视转移，并根据预测的场景特征预测未来的注视与转移。为训练和评估这些任务，我们为 VideoAttentionTarget 和 ChildPlay 扩充了事件级注视转移标注。GWM 在这些基准上取得了最先进的转移检测性能，四分类 AP 比最强基线高出约 10 点，同时在注视目标估计上与最强的基于图像的模型相当，并在未来注视定位与转移预测上优于所比较的基线。

title: G0.7: Scaling Up a Fast World Action Model with Long Context
summary: World action models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generators for robot control by jointly predicting future camera frames and actions, transferring physical priors learned from video into manipulation policies. However, generating future frames before every action makes test-time inference too slow for closed-loop control, while most existing policies remain restricted to short observation histories. Building on Fast-WAM, which showed that video prediction shapes policy representations during training so that future frame synthesis can be skipped at deployment, we present G0.7, a generalist world action model scaled along two axes: extending the context window from a single observation to up to five minutes of history, and scaling pretraining to a large-scale corpus of robot teleoperation and human egocentric (ego) video. Across public simulation suites and real-robot deployments, direct action decoding (Fast mode) matches imagine-then-act (IDM) inference from the same checkpoint while running in 60 ms per 16-step action chunk on a single RTX 5090 (7.6x faster than IDM) and supporting pause-free real-time chunking. Performance scales consistently with pretraining data, with human ego video driving the largest gains in out-of-distribution generalization: G0.7 achieves a 70.8 mean score across five simulation benchmark suites, 48% and 54% zero-shot pick-and-place success on Galaxea R1 Pro and R1 Lite, 96.7% in-distribution and 93.3% out-of-distribution success on video-conditioned in-context learning tasks, and 86.9% mean task progress across seven real-world post-training tasks including multi-minute box folding, drink preparation, and product bagging.

AI.title_zh: G0.7：以长上下文扩展快速世界动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合预测未来相机帧与动作，将预训练视频生成器适配于机器人控制，从而把从视频中学到的物理先验迁移到操作策略中。然而，在每个动作之前生成未来帧会使测试时推理对于闭环控制而言过于缓慢，而大多数现有策略仍局限于较短的观测历史。Fast-WAM 表明视频预测在训练期间塑造策略表征，因而在部署时可以跳过未来帧合成；在此工作的基础上，我们提出 G0.7，一个沿两个维度扩展的通用世界动作模型：将上下文窗口从单次观测扩展到最长五分钟的历史，并将预训练扩展到由机器人遥操作视频和人类第一人称（ego）视频构成的大规模语料库。在公开仿真套件与真实机器人部署中，直接动作解码（Fast 模式）在单个 RTX 5090 上以每 16 步动作块 60 ms 运行（比 IDM 快 7.6 倍），并支持无暂停的实时分块，其效果与同一检查点的先想象后执行（IDM）推理相匹配。性能随预训练数据一致地提升，其中人类第一人称视频在分布外泛化上带来最大增益：G0.7 在五个仿真基准套件上取得 70.8 的平均分，在 Galaxea R1 Pro 与 R1 Lite 上取得 48% 与 54% 的零样本抓取放置成功率，在视频条件化的上下文学习任务上取得 96.7% 的分布内成功率与 93.3% 的分布外成功率，并在包括耗时数分钟的折箱、饮品制备与商品装袋在内的七个真实世界后训练任务上取得 86.9% 的平均任务进度。

title: SceneMemBench: A Benchmark for Scene Memory in Interactive Video World Models
summary: Interactive video world models generate navigable worlds frame by frame, but a persistent world requires previously observed scenes to remain recoverable as users move away and return. Existing memory evaluations, however, often focus on seen-view revisits and full rollouts, leaving cross-view scene recovery underexplored while entangling memory with trajectory-following errors and accumulated generation degradation. We introduce SceneMemBench, a benchmark for scene memory in interactive video world models. It evaluates two complementary dimensions: seen-view recall versus novel-view recovery, and controlled diagnosis versus end-to-end interaction. We introduce Continued Rollout from a shared ground-truth observation history, alongside Full Rollout over complete model-generated interactions. SceneMemBench contains 600 controlled trajectories across 33 Unreal Engine scenes and 60 Full Rollout cases, covering eight representative open- and closed-source models. We evaluate scene recovery along subject consistency, appearance fidelity, and geometric consistency. Results show that novel-view recovery is generally more challenging than seen-view recall, while model profiles under controlled histories can differ markedly from those observed in full interaction. Together, these findings reveal complementary failure modes obscured by seen-view revisits or end-to-end rollouts alone.

AI.title_zh: SceneMemBench：交互式视频世界模型中场景记忆的基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: 交互式视频世界模型逐帧生成可导航的世界，但一个持久的世界要求先前观察到的场景在用户离开并返回时仍可被恢复。然而，现有的记忆评估往往聚焦于已见视角的重访和完整 rollout（完整推演），使得跨视角的场景恢复研究不足，同时将记忆与轨迹跟随误差以及累积的生成退化纠缠在一起。我们提出 SceneMemBench，一个用于交互式视频世界模型中场景记忆的基准测试。它评估两个互补的维度：已见视角回忆与新视角恢复，以及受控诊断与端到端交互。我们引入基于共享的真实观测历史的 Continued Rollout（延续推演），以及基于完整模型生成交互的 Full Rollout（完整推演）。SceneMemBench 包含跨 33 个 Unreal Engine 场景的 600 条受控轨迹和 60 个 Full Rollout 案例，覆盖八个具有代表性的开源与闭源模型。我们沿主体一致性、外观保真度和几何一致性评估场景恢复。结果表明，新视角恢复通常比已见视角回忆更具挑战性，而在受控历史下的模型表现概况可能与在完整交互中观察到的情况显著不同。综合来看，这些发现揭示了仅凭已见视角重访或端到端推演所掩盖的互补性失效模式。

title: Dreamcatcher: Remembering What Surprises a World Model in Video Streams
summary: As live video streams grow longer, repeatedly encoding and processing their full histories becomes increasingly costly. Answering questions as they arrive therefore calls for visual memory built in one pass before future questions are known. Existing methods mainly keep tokens that differ from earlier ones or match surrogate queries fixed in advance. Without modeling world dynamics, these criteria struggle to tell subtle surprising details from expected change. We introduce Dreamcatcher, a training-free framework and, to our knowledge, the first to use predictive signals from an independently pretrained, frozen video world model for online memory formation in streaming video question answering. Conditioned on recent history, the world model predicts incoming features using learned world priors. Its normalized prediction errors yield temporal and spatial surprisal signals that guide online segmentation and the retention of a frozen Video-LLM's native visual tokens, balancing surprising details with broad visual coverage under budgets that decay with segment age. At query time, an evidence gate admits a segment from a similarity-based shortlist only when the Video-LLM judges that it adds evidence for the question beyond the current view. We evaluate Dreamcatcher on three streaming and three offline long-video benchmarks. On OVO-Bench, Dreamcatcher achieves the highest overall accuracy among the compared training-free methods for each of four frozen Video-LLMs, reaching 78.9% with Qwen3.8-27B. With the three Qwen Video-LLMs, it also reduces average input tokens for answer generation by more than 80% relative to their base models at 1 fps.

AI.title_zh: Dreamcatcher：在视频流中记住令世界模型感到意外之处
AI.abstract_zh: 随着实时视频流变得越来越长，反复编码并处理其完整历史所付出的代价日益高昂。因此，在问题抵达时即时作答，需要一种在未来问题尚不可知之前以单次遍历（one pass）构建的视觉记忆。现有方法主要保留与先前不同的token，或保留与预先固定的替代查询（surrogate queries）相匹配的token。由于缺乏对世界动态的建模，这些准则难以将细微的意外细节与预期内的变化区分开来。我们提出Dreamcatcher，这是一个免训练框架，据我们所知，也是首个利用来自独立预训练、冻结的视频世界模型的预测信号，在流式视频问答中进行在线记忆形成的方法。以近期历史为条件，世界模型利用学到的世界先验预测即将到来的特征。其归一化预测误差产生时间与空间上的意外性（surprisal）信号，这些信号引导在线分割以及对冻结Video-LLM原生视觉token的保留，在以随片段年龄衰减的预算下，平衡意外细节与广泛的视觉覆盖。在查询时，证据门控（evidence gate）仅当Video-LLM判断某个片段能为问题在现有视野之外补充证据时，才允许来自基于相似度的候选短列表中的该片段通过。我们在三个流式与三个离线长视频基准上评估Dreamcatcher。在OVO-Bench上，对于四个冻结的Video-LLM中的每一个，Dreamcatcher在所比较的免训练方法中均取得最高的总体准确率，其中使用Qwen3.8-27B时达到78.9%。在三个Qwen Video-LLM上，相对于其基座模型在1 fps下，它还将答案生成的平均输入token减少了80%以上。

title: GeoMVGen: Joint Appearance-Geometry Modeling for Multi-View Video Generation in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation requires predicting how robot-object interactions evolve over time, encompassing both visual appearance and scene geometry. In multi-camera settings, such predictions need to capture the evolving 3D scene consistently across viewpoints, while supporting controllable generation under different robot actions and camera configurations. Existing video generation models provide strong priors for visual appearance and motion but typically lack explicit geometric modeling. Meanwhile, recent advances in geometry-aware and multi-view generation have explored joint appearance-geometry modeling and cross-view consistency, yet generating temporally coherent appearance and geometry across multiple viewpoints under robotic manipulation conditions remains challenging. In this work, we propose GeoMVGen, a framework for joint multi-view RGB and pointmap video generation in robotic manipulation. Built on a video diffusion transformer, our framework employs modality-specific adaptation modules to capture the distinct characteristics of appearance and geometry, while using cross-modal residual connections to facilitate information exchange between the two modalities. To establish geometric correspondences across viewpoints, we further introduce a cross-view projection mechanism with complementary geometric supervisions, combining pointmap consistency with geometry foundation model-guided feature alignment. These designs enable controllable generation of temporally evolving multi-view observations with coherent appearance and geometrically consistent scene structures. Extensive experiments on 4D video generation dataset comprising simulated and real-world robotic manipulation scenarios demonstrate that GeoMVGen outperforms state-of-the-art methods in video quality, geometric accuracy, and cross-view consistency.

AI.title_zh: GeoMVGen：面向机器人操作多视角视频生成的联合外观-几何建模
AI.abstract_zh: 机器人操作需要预测机器人与物体交互如何随时间演化，这既涵盖视觉外观，也涵盖场景几何。在多相机设置下，此类预测需要在各视角之间一致地捕捉不断演化的三维场景，同时支持在不同机器人动作与相机配置下的可控生成。现有的视频生成模型为视觉外观与运动提供了强有力的先验，但通常缺乏显式的几何建模。与此同时，近期在几何感知与多视角生成方面的进展已探索了联合外观-几何建模与跨视角一致性，然而在机器人操作条件下跨多个视角生成时间上连贯的外观与几何仍然具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出 GeoMVGen，一个用于机器人操作中联合多视角 RGB 与点图（pointmap）视频生成的框架。我们的框架构建于视频扩散 Transformer 之上，采用模态特定的适配模块以捕捉外观与几何各自不同的特性，同时使用跨模态残差连接以促进两种模态之间的信息交换。为在视角之间建立几何对应关系，我们进一步引入了一种带有互补几何监督的跨视角投影机制，将点图一致性与几何基础模型引导的特征对齐相结合。这些设计使得能够可控地生成具有连贯外观与几何一致场景结构、随时间演化的多视角观测。在包含仿真与真实世界机器人操作场景的 4D 视频生成数据集上的大量实验表明，GeoMVGen 在视频质量、几何精度与跨视角一致性方面优于最先进的方法。

title: LimoBench: How Street Smart Are Large Language Models?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed how humans interact with information, enabling natural-language interfaces across various domains. They are increasingly deployed for geospatial applications including map-based question answering, location-based services, and natural-language interfaces to spatial databases. But are LLMs truly location-aware, able to reliably interpret and precisely answer location queries involving real-world coordinates, points of interest (POIs), and geospatial distances? To answer this concretely, we present LimoBench, a street-level benchmark of 82 natural-language location queries over seven canonical spatial operations: geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing, directionality, range search, $k$-nearest-neighbor search, and spatial join. The queries are grounded in real map data of West Lafayette, Indiana, and are graded by location and semantic complexity. They are designed to probe LLMs' street-level spatial awareness, from simple lookups to multi-step spatial reasoning. We also present Limo, an approach based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that enhances the location awareness of LLMs. Limo grounds LLMs in PostGIS-backed spatial data through a compact set of tools. We find that ungrounded models mostly achieve single-digit accuracy (3.1% for GPT-6 Luna) across different spatial operations. In contrast, the same models achieve near-perfect accuracy (99.3% for GPT-6 Luna) when given access to Limo's spatial tools through MCP. Current LLMs thus have limited and unreliable street-level spatial knowledge, while grounding provides accurate answers at modest overhead (+0.2 s latency, 7.7$\times$ tokens, and 2.2$\times$ cost for GPT-6 Luna). We release the benchmark, Limo toolset, and evaluation code to encourage the community to evaluate their own location-aware LLM approaches.

AI.title_zh: LimoBench：大语言模型有多"街道智慧"？
AI.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已经改变了人类与信息交互的方式，使自然语言接口能够在各个领域中得以实现。它们越来越多地被部署于地理空间应用，包括基于地图的问答、基于位置的服务，以及面向空间数据库的自然语言接口。但大语言模型是否真正具备位置感知能力，能够可靠地解释并精确回答涉及真实世界坐标、兴趣点（POI）和地理空间距离的位置查询？为了具体回答这一问题，我们提出了 LimoBench，这是一个街道级基准，包含 82 个自然语言位置查询，覆盖七种典型的空间操作：地理编码、逆地理编码、路径规划、方向性、范围搜索、$k$ 最近邻搜索和空间连接。这些查询以印第安纳州西拉法叶（West Lafayette）的真实地图数据为基础，并按位置复杂度和语义复杂度进行分级。它们旨在考察大语言模型的街道级空间感知能力，从简单的查找一直到多步空间推理。我们还提出了 Limo，这是一种基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的方法，用于增强大语言模型的位置感知能力。Limo 通过一组紧凑的工具，将大语言模型与由 PostGIS 支持的空间数据相结合。我们发现，在不同空间操作上，未经数据结合（ungrounded）的模型大多只达到个位数准确率（GPT-6 Luna 为 3.1%）。相比之下，当通过 MCP 访问 Limo 的空间工具时，同样的模型能达到近乎完美的准确率（GPT-6 Luna 为 99.3%）。因此，当前的大语言模型所具有的街道级空间知识有限且不可靠，而数据结合（grounding）则以适度的开销提供准确答案（对 GPT-6 Luna 而言，延迟增加 +0.2 s，token 数为 7.7$\times$，成本为 2.2$\times$）。我们发布该基准、Limo 工具集和评估代码，以鼓励社区评估其自身的位置感知大语言模型方法。

title: RePT: 3D Geometry Emerges from 2D Relational Pretraining
summary: Learning spatial representations often relies on explicitly predicting geometric quantities, but how physical geometry is organized within learned representations remains less understood. We ask whether 3D structure can emerge from learning relations across 2D observations, without 3D prediction targets. We introduce RePT, which learns compact relations between distinct physical points through cross-view 2D point prediction. The learned relation space develops a geometric organization in which magnitudes, angles, and neighborhoods reflect physical 3D displacement. A single linear readout fitted on 16 scenes recovers displacement length and angle on 39 held-out scenes without refitting (Pearson r = 0.72 and 0.78). The ARKitScenes-trained checkpoint also retains strong geometric organization on ScanNet++, showcasing generalizability. In controlled comparisons, distinct-point relational prediction consistently yields stronger geometric organization than matched same-point correspondence learning. This organization depends on additive relations and adaptive scene context, and higher point-transfer accuracy does not by itself produce stronger organization. More broadly, our results suggest that 3D geometry need not be an explicit prediction target and can instead emerge as a structural property of representations trained to relate 2D observations, pointing to relational prediction as a complementary route to learning the representations that spatial intelligence builds on.

AI.title_zh: RePT：3D 几何从 2D 关系预训练中涌现
AI.abstract_zh: 学习空间表征往往依赖于显式地预测几何量，但物理几何在学习到的表征中如何被组织起来，仍知之甚少。我们提出这样一个问题：3D 结构能否在没有 3D 预测目标的情况下，从跨 2D 观测的关系学习中涌现？我们提出 RePT，它通过跨视角的 2D 点预测来学习不同物理点之间的紧凑关系。所学习到的关系空间形成了一种几何组织，其中幅值、角度和邻域反映了物理 3D 位移。在 16 个场景上拟合的单一线性读出器，无需重新拟合即可在 39 个留出场景上恢复位移长度和角度（Pearson r = 0.72 和 0.78）。在 ARKitScenes 上训练的检查点在 ScanNet++ 上同样保持了很强的几何组织，展示了泛化能力。在受控比较中，不同点之间的关系预测始终比匹配的同点对应学习产生更强的几何组织。这种组织依赖于可加关系与自适应场景上下文，而更高的点迁移准确率本身并不会产生更强的组织。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，3D 几何不必作为显式的预测目标，而可以作为被训练以关联 2D 观测的表征的一种结构性质而涌现，这指向关系预测是学习空间智能所依托的表征的一条互补途径。

title: SpatialCraft: Evolving Procedural Intelligence from Experience and Skills for Spatial Reasoning Agents
summary: Spatial reasoning agents increasingly rely on external tools, such as 3D reconstruction, segmentation, and geometric computation, to answer questions that a multimodal large language model (MLLM) cannot resolve from pixels alone. Tool access, however, shifts the bottleneck to orchestration: the agent must decide which tools to call, in what order, and how to interpret their outputs, yet a stateless agent repeats the same mistakes across tasks. We ask whether a frozen tool-using agent can improve its orchestration from its own interaction history, without parameter updates. We present SpatialCraft, a self-evolving framework that maintains two forms of external knowledge: Experiences, condition-action tactics distilled by contrasting rollouts of the same task, and Skills, multi-step procedures with explicit activation and termination conditions. Three designs couple the two streams. Experiences can be anchored to a Skill, appearing only while it is active rather than once per task. A Contrastive Utility Score estimates each Experience's effect by randomly withholding it across rollouts of the same task, separating its contribution from task difficulty, and Experiences with consistently positive utility are consolidated into the Skills they support. Across five spatial benchmarks and four backbones, SpatialCraft achieves the best accuracy in all 20 settings, showing that a frozen agent can learn to orchestrate spatial tools from its own experience.

AI.title_zh: SpatialCraft：从经验与技能中演化面向空间推理智能体的过程性智能
AI.abstract_zh: 空间推理智能体日益依赖外部工具（如三维重建、分割和几何计算）来回答多模态大语言模型（MLLM）仅凭像素无法解决的问题。然而，工具的使用将瓶颈转移到了编排（orchestration）上：智能体必须决定调用哪些工具、以何种顺序调用，以及如何解释工具的输出，而无状态智能体却会在不同任务上重复相同的错误。我们研究的问题是：一个冻结参数的、使用工具的智能体能否在不更新参数的情况下，从自身的交互历史中改进其编排能力。我们提出 SpatialCraft，一个自演化框架，它维护两种形式的外部知识：经验（Experiences），即通过对比同一任务的不同 rollout 而蒸馏出的条件—动作策略；以及技能（Skills），即带有显式激活与终止条件的多步流程。我们采用三种设计将这两条知识流耦合起来。经验可以锚定到某个技能上，仅在该技能激活期间出现，而不是每个任务出现一次。对比效用分数（Contrastive Utility Score）通过在同一个任务的多次 rollout 中随机保留或不保留某条经验，来估计该经验的效果，从而将其贡献与任务难度区分开来；效用持续为正的经验会被整合进其所支持的技能中。在五个空间基准和四个骨干模型上，SpatialCraft 在全部 20 种设置中均取得了最佳准确率，表明冻结参数的智能体能够从自身经验中学会编排空间工具。

title: AdProducer: Towards Agentic Advertising Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in video generation have made automated advertising production increasingly feasible. However, an effective advertisement must faithfully represent the product and communicate its selling points through compelling visual storytelling, which requires more than visual synthesis: it calls for deeper product understanding and strategic decisions about how to present product value. Crucially, product research and creative design are closely intertwined, as the information gathered about a product determines which features can be faithfully demonstrated and how they should be presented. In this paper, we introduce AdProducer, the first end-to-end agentic framework for advertising video creation, transforming concise creative briefs into finished advertisements. Our multimodal agent autonomously researches products through web and image search and translates its findings into selling-point-driven storyboards that guide a frozen video generator. To achieve this, we develop a dedicated data construction pipeline that yields two training datasets, AdProducer-SFT and AdProducer-RL, and train the agent through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with joint optimization of storyboard- and video-level rewards. We further introduce AdCreation-Bench, comprising 305 advertising briefs across eight domains, with two complementary metrics: PG-Score for product correctness and creative execution, and Ad-Score for overall advertising effectiveness assessed by an independent judge. Experiments demonstrate that AdProducer improves the PG-Score of MiniMax H3 from 17.3 to 51.3 and generalizes to Veo 3.1 without additional training, improving its score from 28.0 to 35.9, with consistent gains in Ad-Score, VideoScore2, and human evaluations. Code, models, and data are released.

AI.title_zh: AdProducer：迈向智能体化的广告视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 视频生成领域的最新进展使自动化广告制作日益可行。然而，一则有效的广告必须忠实呈现产品，并通过富有吸引力的视觉叙事传达其卖点，这所需要的远不止视觉合成：它要求更深入的产品理解，以及关于如何呈现产品价值的策略性决策。关键在于，产品调研与创意设计紧密交织，因为所收集到的产品信息决定了哪些特性能够被忠实展示以及应如何展示。在本文中，我们提出 AdProducer，这是首个用于广告视频创作的端到端智能体框架，可将简洁的创意简报转化为成片广告。我们的多模态智能体通过网页搜索与图像搜索自主调研产品，并将其发现转化为以卖点驱动的分镜脚本，用以引导一个冻结的视频生成器。为此，我们开发了一套专门的数据构建流程，产出两个训练数据集 AdProducer-SFT 和 AdProducer-RL，并通过监督微调以及随后采用分镜级与视频级奖励联合优化的强化学习来训练该智能体。我们进一步提出 AdCreation-Bench，涵盖八个领域的 305 条广告简报，并配有两项互补的指标：用于评估产品正确性与创意执行的 PG-Score，以及由独立评判方评估整体广告效果的 Ad-Score。实验表明，AdProducer 将 MiniMax H3 的 PG-Score 从 17.3 提升至 51.3，并在无需额外训练的情况下泛化至 Veo 3.1，将其得分从 28.0 提升至 35.9，同时在 Ad-Score、VideoScore2 和人工评估中均取得一致的提升。代码、模型与数据均已发布。

title: Ground, Guide, Act: Improving VLA Spatial Generalization with Multimodal Foundation Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models effectively learn action policies from robot demonstrations, but struggle to generalize to changes in object positions and task goals. General multimodal foundation models (MFMs) offer complementary scene understanding and spatial reasoning, but remain slow and unreliable for direct fine-grained control. To understand how MFMs can improve VLA spatial generalization, we conduct a systematic capability analysis across multiple VLA architectures using atomic-stage interventions, revealing that many failures stem from poor target grounding and global spatial routing, while local manipulation skills remain largely usable. Based on these findings, we propose MFM-VLA, a selective collaboration framework in which an MFM provides target grounding and spatial guidance, controllers execute free-space motion, and the VLA retains control over fine-grained manipulation. We fine-tune the VLA with action-chunk-level dense geometric captions and perturbed-state recovery data to improve local guidance following and recovery from unfamiliar handoff states. A development-calibrated capability router selects between direct VLA execution and MFM-assisted execution to avoid unnecessary intervention. Across LIBERO-PRO, ALOHA-Sim-PRO, RoboCasa365, and real-world chemistry tasks, MFM-VLA improves success rates by 14.9, 74.0, 3.6, and 30.9 percentage points, respectively, over the corresponding base VLA. The project page is available at https://tom-zgt.github.io/MFM-VLA

AI.title_zh: 定位、引导、执行：利用多模态基础模型提升VLA的空间泛化能力
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够有效地从机器人示范中学习动作策略，但难以泛化到物体位置和任务目标发生变化的情形。通用多模态基础模型（MFM）提供了互补的场景理解与空间推理能力，但在直接进行细粒度控制时仍然速度慢且不可靠。为理解MFM如何提升VLA的空间泛化能力，我们使用原子阶段干预在多种VLA架构上开展了系统的能力分析，揭示出许多失败源于目标定位（grounding）不佳和全局空间路由不佳，而局部操作技能大体上仍然可用。基于这些发现，我们提出MFM-VLA，一个选择性协作框架：由MFM提供目标定位与空间引导，控制器执行自由空间运动，VLA保留对细粒度操作的控制。我们使用动作块级（action-chunk-level）稠密几何描述以及受扰动状态的恢复数据对VLA进行微调，以提升其对局部引导的遵循能力以及对不熟悉交接状态的恢复能力。一个经开发阶段校准的能力路由器在VLA直接执行与MFM辅助执行之间进行选择，以避免不必要的干预。在LIBERO-PRO、ALOHA-Sim-PRO、RoboCasa365以及真实世界化学任务上，MFM-VLA相比相应的基础VLA分别将成功率提升了14.9、74.0、3.6和30.9个百分点。项目页面见 https://tom-zgt.github.io/MFM-VLA

title: CaLA: Causal Latent Adjustment for World Models under Adaptive Policies
summary: World models is answering ``imagine" answers to ``what-if'' questions via imagined rollouts. But rollouts collected by adaptive policies induce treatment-outcome confounding in imagined rollouts. We study this problem in Match-3 difficulty adjustment, where latent player skill influences both assigned difficulty and churn. We build a fully specified Match-3 SCM with sequential mechanics, adaptive assignment, and paired ground-truth interventions, on which unadjusted models fit to the logged trajectories select difficulty settings that raise churn. We then introduce Causal Latent Adjustment (CaLA), a DAG-constrained world model that infers a variational player representation from pretreatment history. Across our evaluations, CaLA provides the most reliable population-level intervention estimates and competitive individualized decisions, although rich handcrafted histories can remain advantageous for individual-level adjustment. We further find that residual correction can degrade causal decision quality despite improving predictive fit, highlighting the need to distinguish predictive accuracy, confounding adjustment and the behavior of downstream causal estimators.

AI.title_zh: CaLA：自适应策略下世界模型的因果潜变量调整
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型通过想象出的推演（imagined rollouts）来为“what-if”问题给出“imagine”式的回答。但由自适应策略收集的推演会在想象推演中引入处理—结果混杂（treatment-outcome confounding）。我们在 Match-3 难度调整中研究这一问题，其中潜在的玩家技能同时影响所分配的难度与流失（churn）。我们构建了一个完整设定的 Match-3 结构因果模型（SCM），其包含序列机制、自适应分配以及配对的真值干预，在未做调整的模型上，拟合于记录轨迹的模型会选择导致流失上升的难度设置。随后我们提出因果潜变量调整（Causal Latent Adjustment, CaLA），这是一种受 DAG 约束的世界模型，从预处理历史（pretreatment history）中推断变分玩家表征。在我们的各项评估中，CaLA 提供了最可靠的人群层面干预估计以及具有竞争力的个体化决策，尽管丰富的手工设计历史在个体层面调整上仍可能具有优势。我们进一步发现，残差校正尽管能改善预测拟合，却可能降低因果决策质量，这凸显出有必要区分预测准确性、混杂调整以及下游因果估计量的行为。

title: Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory
summary: Exploring a scene from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough that extends far beyond what was captured, yet remains consistent upon return. Memory-based video generation methods preserve what they have already seen, but have no anchor beyond it, where the camera drifts from its path and a text prompt can name objects but not place them. Layout-conditioned methods provide such an anchor and precise control over what appears where, but rely on layouts that are typically authored by hand. Both limitations arise because, beyond what was captured, nothing anchors the video model unless a human authors one. To overcome both, we propose Lyris, a long video generation framework that never leaves the video model without an anchor: a persistent point-cloud memory where the scene has been observed or generated, and a 3D layout that a vision-language model authors where it has not. Our key insight is that the interface between the two models can be surprisingly coarse. A layout of one labeled 3D box per object is simple enough for a vision-language model to author (and for a user to edit), yet expressive enough for a video model to follow once rendered along the camera path. We demonstrate walkthroughs of over three minutes and 50 meters from a single photo, passing through doorways into rooms it never shows. When evaluated on minute-long round trips across four datasets, Lyris outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a wide margin, reducing camera error by 3.8x and improving consistency upon return by 22% on average.

AI.title_zh: Lyris：基于持久三维记忆的布局引导长视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 仅凭一张照片探索一个场景，需要生成一段长得多的、由相机控制的长距离漫游视频，其范围远超照片所拍摄的内容，同时在返回时仍保持一致。基于记忆的视频生成方法会保留已经看到过的内容，但对除此之外的区域没有任何锚定，于是相机会偏离其路径，而文本提示可以命名物体却无法确定其位置。布局条件方法提供了这样的锚定以及对什么出现在何处的精确控制，但依赖通常由人工创作的布局。这两类局限都源于：在已拍摄内容之外，除非由人创作一个锚定，否则没有任何东西为视频模型提供锚定。为克服这两点，我们提出 Lyris，一个从不使视频模型失去锚定的长视频生成框架：在场景已被观测或已生成之处使用持久点云记忆，而在尚未生成之处使用由视觉-语言模型创作的 3D 布局。我们的关键洞见是，两个模型之间的接口可以出奇地粗糙。每个物体一个带标签 3D 框的布局简单到足以让视觉-语言模型创作（也便于用户编辑），却足够表达，使视频模型在沿相机路径渲染后能够遵循。我们展示了从单张照片生成超过三分钟、50 米的漫游，穿过门口进入照片从未展示的房间。在四个数据集上进行一分钟往返评测时，Lyris 以较大幅度优于最先进的方法，将相机误差降低 3.8 倍，并使返回时的一致性平均提升 22%。

title: Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Humans explore unfamiliar spaces with purpose, deciding where to look until they have gathered the evidence a spatial question requires. However, can vision-language models (VLMs), which reason increasingly well over curated images and videos, also seek in space when the evidence is not handed to them? We present ActSpace-Bench, a benchmark of 994 questions across 234 exploration episodes in 72 real-scanned indoor scenes, where a model starts from a single view, navigates real captured frames, and must gather evidence before answering. To assess whether such exploration is purposeful, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol that fixes each model as the reasoner and compares its own exploration against a same-budget random walk and an oracle route, separating evidence seeking from spatial reasoning. Every question is verified to require exploration and answered from 3D annotations, masked-evidence questions test whether models know when to abstain, and over 95% of sampled questions are confirmed correct by human verification. Evaluations of 23 proprietary, open-weight, and spatially specialized VLMs reveal that the strongest models do seek evidence with purpose but lose much of it to limited memory, whereas weaker and specialized models explore no better than a random walk or fail to reason over the evidence they are given, pointing to memory and evidence-grounded reasoning as the next targets for active spatial intelligence.

AI.title_zh: 在空间中寻求：面向空间推理的视觉语言模型有目的主动探索基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: 人类会有目的地探索陌生空间，决定该往哪里看，直到收集到某个空间问题所需的证据。然而，那些在精选图像和视频上进行推理且表现日益出色的视觉语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs），在证据并未直接交给它们时，是否也能在空间中进行寻求？我们提出 ActSpace-Bench，这是一个包含 72 个真实扫描室内场景、234 个探索回合中 994 个问题的基准；在该基准中，模型从单一视角出发，在真实采集的帧之间进行导航，并且必须在回答之前收集证据。为了评估这种探索是否有目的性，我们引入一种受控评测协议：将每个模型固定为推理器，并将其自身的探索与同等预算的随机游走（random walk）以及一个 oracle 路线进行比较，从而将证据寻求与空间推理区分开来。每个问题都经过验证以确保其需要探索，并依据 3D 标注给出答案；掩蔽证据问题（masked-evidence questions）检验模型是否知道何时应当弃答；抽样问题中有超过 95% 经人工核验确认为正确。对 23 个专有、开放权重以及空间专门化的 VLM 的评测显示：最强的模型确实会有目的地寻求证据，但因记忆有限而丢失了大量证据；而较弱的模型和专门化模型要么探索效果不优于随机游走，要么无法对其获得的证据进行推理。这表明，记忆与基于证据的推理是主动空间智能的下一个目标。

title: WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation
summary: Generative Pre-Training (GPT) represents a profound milestone in natural language processing, serving as the foundation for most of today's state-of-the-art large language models. By casting diverse understanding and generation problems into a shared token representation, GPT enables a single architecture and unified optimization loop to master heterogeneous tasks across massive corpora, giving rise to powerful foundation models for natural language. In contrast, 4D spatiotemporal vision lacks a common representational protocol: perception (such as depth and camera estimation) and generation are either handled by separate one-way pipelines or bolted together from unaligned single-modality spaces. In this work, we introduce WorldLatent, a framework that formulates a unified 4D latent space as a common protocol for both world perception and generation. Rather than relying on fragmented, task-specific models or stacked single-modality representations, our framework proposes a multimodal VAE architecture that compresses and fuses complex 4D visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single structured latent representation. Within this formulation, perception and generation operate as complementary denoising processes over the same latent space, enabling one generative model to learn both capabilities simultaneously within a single training loop. Experiments across representative 4D benchmarks verify that our fused latent protocol achieves specialist-level zero-shot 4D perception, coherent 4D generation, and controllable editing from a single model. By demonstrating that diverse 4D tasks can be seamlessly unified under a shared representational protocol, our work provides a scalable foundation for general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence.

AI.title_zh: WorldLatent：面向世界感知与生成的统一4D潜空间
AI.abstract_zh: 生成式预训练（Generative Pre-Training, GPT）是自然语言处理领域的一个深刻里程碑，构成了当今大多数最先进大语言模型的基础。通过将多样的理解与生成问题转化为共享的token表示，GPT使单一架构和统一优化循环能够在海量语料上掌握异构任务，从而催生出强大的自然语言基础模型。相比之下，4D时空视觉缺乏一种通用的表示协议：感知（如深度与相机估计）与生成要么由各自独立的单向流水线处理，要么由未对齐的单模态空间拼接而成。在本工作中，我们提出WorldLatent，一个将统一4D潜空间形式化为世界感知与生成共同协议的框架。我们的框架不依赖碎片化的任务专用模型或堆叠的单模态表示，而是提出一种多模态VAE架构，将复杂的4D视觉外观、几何与动态压缩并融合为单一的结构化潜表示。在这一形式化框架中，感知与生成作为同一潜空间上互补的去噪过程运行，使单个生成模型能够在单一训练循环中同时学习这两种能力。在代表性4D基准上的实验验证，我们的融合潜协议（fused latent protocol）能够在单一模型上实现专家级零样本4D感知、连贯的4D生成以及可控编辑。通过证明多样的4D任务可以无缝地统一在共享表示协议之下，我们的工作为通用4D空间智能提供了可扩展的基础。

title: On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation
summary: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.

AI.title_zh: 面向高效全能视频生成的同策略编解码器蒸馏
AI.abstract_zh: 现代视觉生成模型在 token 上运行，它们接收的每一个视觉素材——无论是身份、涂鸦、深度图还是运动视频——都会被 token 化并追加到输入 token 序列中。因此，条件很快便在计算开销中占据主导地位。然而，这些 token 中大多数携带的是冗余的时空信息。我们的关键洞见是：识别什么是真正新出现的信息，正是经典视频编解码器长期以来所解决的问题。因此，我们首先提出一种基于编解码器的 token 剪枝方法，用以丢弃冗余 token。随后，我们提出一种同策略自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation, OPSD）策略，用于训练一个 DiT 适配器，使其能够很好地学习编解码器剪枝模式而不造成质量下降。二者共同构成了同策略编解码器蒸馏（On-Policy Codec Distillation, CodecOPSD）。我们在自有的视频扩散模型上将 CodecOPSD 扩展到 16 种条件模态，平均剪除 66% 的条件 token，而质量几乎不下降。因此，去噪速度提升 2 倍，在 KV cache 模式下缓存内存最多缩减 73%。CodecOPSD 还可推广到其他最先进的预训练图像与视频生成模型，并且随着条件更多、帧数更长、分辨率更高，其收益进一步增大。

title: Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
summary: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $π$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $π$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.

AI.title_zh: 分析与改进自回归视频模型的 FlowMap 蒸馏
AI.abstract_zh: FlowMap 蒸馏通过直接学习教师的去噪轨迹，为少步生成建模提供了一条自然的途径。然而，对于自回归（AR）视频生成，现有的少步模型仍依赖分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）以保持竞争力，这牺牲了样本多样性，并且需要一个大型的双向教师模型。在本工作中，我们分析了限制独立 AR FlowMap 蒸馏的因素，并引入两种互补的引导机制来弥补这一差距：（1）抗漂移引导（anti-drifting guidance），它通过训练一个辅助模型来模仿学生漂移，并将其用作负向引导分支，从而帮助 AR 教师纠正发生漂移的学生 rollout；（2）运动感知引导（motion-aware guidance），它通过定位运动 patch 并有选择地施加跳层引导（skip-layer guidance），使运动更易于被 FlowMap 学生学习。在实验上，我们的方法适用于使用 1.3B AR 教师的 $π$-Flow、MeanFlow 和一致性蒸馏，在超过 30 s 的 rollout 中提升了生成质量并减少了漂移。值得注意的是，我们的 4 步 $π$-Flow 学生在 VBench 上与从 14B 教师蒸馏得到的 DMD 学生相匹配，同时保留了其 AR 教师的样本多样性，这表明纯 FlowMap 蒸馏对于少步自回归视频生成是有效的。

title: Wrist-Camera Video Diffusion as Generalizable Robot Policies
summary: A generalist manipulation policy should perform new tasks, operate in unfamiliar scenes, and transfer skills across robot embodiments. We present Wrist Video Policy (WVP), a closed-loop manipulation framework that learns how manipulation unfolds through video prediction and recovers executable motion through geometric estimation. Our key idea is to represent robot motion through wrist-camera trajectories, which determine the corresponding end-effector poses through a fixed hand-eye transformation. We pair a video generator that predicts future wrist views with a pose estimator adapted from a pretrained 3D model to recover the corresponding camera trajectories. Model stitching maps the generator's predicted latents directly into the estimator's intermediate feature space, bypassing RGB decoding. This decomposition allows task knowledge to expand through broad human and robot video data while reusing geometric motion estimation across tasks and embodiments. The resulting pose estimator transfers across Franka Panda, PiPER-X, and Galaxea R1 Pro without further fine-tuning. Across tabletop and laundry-room settings, WVP generalizes to tasks ranging from precise grasping and inserting to handling deformable objects, achieving a success rate of over 50% in zero-shot out-of-distribution evaluations. Our project page is at https://wrist-video-policy.github.io.

AI.title_zh: 腕部相机视频扩散作为可泛化的机器人策略
AI.abstract_zh: 通用操作策略应能执行新任务、在陌生场景中运行，并跨机器人本体迁移技能。我们提出腕部视频策略（Wrist Video Policy, WVP），这是一个闭环操作框架，它通过视频预测学习操作如何展开，并通过几何估计恢复可执行的运动。我们的核心思想是通过腕部相机轨迹来表示机器人运动，该轨迹通过固定的手眼变换确定相应的末端执行器位姿。我们将一个预测未来腕部视角的视频生成器，与一个由预训练3D模型适配而来的位姿估计器配对，以恢复相应的相机轨迹。模型拼接（model stitching）将生成器预测的潜变量直接映射到位姿估计器的中间特征空间，从而绕过RGB解码。这种分解使得任务知识能够通过广泛的人类和机器人视频数据得以扩展，同时跨任务和本体复用几何运动估计。所得的位姿估计器在无需进一步微调的情况下可迁移至Franka Panda、PiPER-X和Galaxea R1 Pro。在桌面和洗衣房环境中，WVP可泛化到从精确抓取与插入到处理可变形物体等各类任务，在零样本分布外（out-of-distribution）评估中取得了超过50%的成功率。我们的项目页面为 https://wrist-video-policy.github.io。

title: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
summary: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.

AI.title_zh: 解析视觉潜变量以实现多模态空间推理
