AI.abstract_zh: 跨多个视图的空间推理需要从二维观测中推断物体与相机之间的三维关系，而这依赖于跨视图对应关系和场景几何，视觉语言模型（VLM）并不能可靠地提取这些信息。预训练的视觉编码器已在其潜特征中捕获了这些信息：CLIP 将物体与图像区域关联，DINOv3 跨视图匹配语义，VGGT 编码多视图几何。然而，当我们把这些特征以灰度特征图像的形式直接置于上下文中呈现给 VLM 时，VLM 并不能从中受益。因此，我们提出 LatentParse，一个无需训练的框架，将潜特征解析为显式的空间证据以供 VLM 使用。在 LatentParse 中，一个分析者 VLM 使用预定义工具探查全部三个编码器的特征，这些工具用于定位物体、跨视图跟踪物体以及测量视图之间的运动。随后它将结果提炼为一份简明的文本报告，该报告与图像一同提供给 VLM 以回答问题。我们在 MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench 和 SPAR-Bench 上评估 LatentParse，其使全部五个 VLM 相对仅图像基线平均提升 0.7–2.4 个百分点。在 MMSI-Bench 上，它将 Qwen3.8-27B 从 34.4% 提升至 39.5%，其中在相机相关问题上的提升最大，达 19.2 个百分点。这些结果表明，一旦潜特征被解析为关系证据，它们无需训练即可用于空间推理。代码见 https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse。

title: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
summary: AI systems can now operate Blender, follow instructions in complex video games, and manipulate objects with robot arms. What range of physical goals can today's AI systems achieve autonomously? Answering this question requires testing systems on tasks that demand different combinations of perception, memory, planning, and action. We introduce \textbf{WorldLeague}, a benchmark that compares AI systems on a common set of \textbf{60 simulated robot tasks} by measuring progress toward each task's physical goal from the robot's trajectory. Robots explore scenes to gather evidence in \textbf{WorldSeek}, rearrange objects in \textbf{WorldShape}, and adapt to changes in \textbf{WorldShift}. Tying these goals to a single control interface limits which AI systems can be compared. In WorldLeague, vision-language models (VLMs) choose targets and motions, while vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs) use their native controls. For each of six capability dimensions, we measure how much progress a system makes toward its goals (Interactive Score) and how often it achieves them (physical success rate). Together, these measures form the system's \emph{Physical Agency Profile}. Among 13 representative AI systems, Claude Fable 5.2 achieves 13 of the 60 goals and earns the highest mean Interactive Score (28.58/100). Fable leads in four dimensions, while GPT-6.1-Sol and GPT-6-Astra tie for first on rule-following tasks. Even when VLMs answer every final question correctly, they receive an Interactive Score of zero in 71.8\% of those episodes. WorldLeague gives Embodied AI, Physical AI, and Agentic AI a shared basis for comparing what AI systems achieve autonomously, from partial progress toward a physical goal to full goal completion. Project Webpage: https://xyangzhou.github.io/WorldLeague

AI.title_zh: WorldLeague：物理能动性基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: AI 系统如今能够操作 Blender、在复杂电子游戏中遵循指令，并用机械臂操控物体。当今的 AI 系统能够自主实现哪些范围的物理目标？回答这一问题，需要在要求不同感知、记忆、规划与行动组合的任务上测试系统。我们提出 \textbf{WorldLeague}，这是一个在共同的 \textbf{60 个模拟机器人任务}集合上比较 AI 系统的基准，通过从机器人轨迹中度量每个任务物理目标的推进程度来进行比较。机器人在 \textbf{WorldSeek} 中探索场景以收集证据，在 \textbf{WorldShape} 中重排物体，并在 \textbf{WorldShift} 中适应变化。将这些目标绑定到单一控制接口会限制可被比较的 AI 系统范围。在 WorldLeague 中，视觉语言模型（VLMs）选择目标与动作，而视觉语言动作模型（VLAs）与世界动作模型（WAMs）使用其原生控制。对于六个能力维度中的每一个，我们度量系统朝其目标取得的进展程度（Interactive Score）以及达成目标的频率（physical success rate）。这些度量共同构成该系统的 \emph{Physical Agency Profile}。在 13 个代表性 AI 系统中，Claude Fable 5.2 达成了 60 个目标中的 13 个，并获得最高的平均 Interactive Score（28.58/100）。Fable 在四个维度上领先，而 GPT-6.1-Sol 与 GPT-6-Astra 在遵循规则任务上并列第一。即使 VLMs 正确回答了每一个最终问题，它们在这些回合中有 71.8\% 的 Interactive Score 为零。WorldLeague 为具身 AI（Embodied AI）、物理 AI（Physical AI）与智能体 AI（Agentic AI）提供了一个共同基础，用以比较 AI 系统自主实现的成果，从朝物理目标的部分进展到完全达成目标。项目网页：https://xyangzhou.github.io/WorldLeague

title: Diffutoon-2: Toon Shading with Video Diffusion Models
summary: Toon shading renders objects with a flat, stylized appearance. Diffusion models open a new route to this task by transforming photorealistic videos into an anime style. However, existing approaches often rely on curated source and style training pairs or additional visual references. Diffutoon avoids these requirements through structure guidance and colorization, but builds on an image diffusion backbone with short-window motion modules and repeated overlapping-window denoising. We present Diffutoon-2, a video diffusion framework that learns toon shading through animation reconstruction. Two complementary modules independently reconstruct animation clips from outlines and blurred colors, with the video backbone frozen. At inference, the modules jointly guide generation using the same types of conditions extracted from photorealistic footage, requiring neither cross-domain training pairs nor external style references. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diffutoon-2 outperforms both general-purpose and domain-specific baselines, across quantitative metrics and human evaluation.

AI.title_zh: Diffutoon-2：基于视频扩散模型的卡通（Toon）着色
AI.abstract_zh: 卡通（Toon）着色以扁平的、风格化的外观渲染物体。扩散模型通过将照片级真实感视频转换为动漫风格，为这一任务开辟了新的路径。然而，现有方法往往依赖精心选取的源域与风格训练对，或额外的视觉参考。Diffutoon 通过结构引导与着色（colorization）避免了这些要求，但其建立在带有短窗口运动模块和重复重叠窗口去噪的图像扩散骨干之上。我们提出 Diffutoon-2，一个通过动画重建来学习卡通着色的视频扩散框架。两个互补的模块分别在视频骨干冻结的情况下，从轮廓（outlines）和模糊颜色（blurred colors）独立重建动画片段。在推理时，这两个模块利用从照片级真实感影像中提取的同类条件共同引导生成，既不需要跨域训练对，也不需要外部风格参考。大量实验表明，在量化指标和人工评估方面，Diffutoon-2 均优于通用性和领域专用基线方法。

title: DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
summary: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. Executable robot commands are then recovered from the predicted geometric motion without requiring an embodiment-specific action decoder. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that the learned latent actions exhibit controllable and compositional motion, transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and support zero-shot manipulation with unseen gripper geometries. Following task-agnostic adaptation, our model achieves 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, respectively, compared with DexWM's reported 72%, 58%, and 28%. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot real-world manipulation with an unseen dexterous hand, achieving an 86% success rate across 50 trials on five diverse tasks involving pushing, grasping, and lifting everyday objects. These results highlight the potential of geometry-grounded latent actions as a unified, transferable interface for world-model-based robotic manipulation. Project materials, including demonstration videos and source code, are available at https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/.

AI.title_zh: DexLatentWorld：面向零样本机器人操作的3D跨具身潜在动作世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型通过使智能体能够预见其动作的后果，促进了机器人操作中的规划与控制。然而，它们通常依赖带动作标注的交互数据，这类数据获取成本高且难以规模化。这些模型也往往与其训练时所使用的特定具身绑定，限制了向此前未见过的机器人形态的迁移能力。我们提出了一种3D潜在动作世界模型，它直接从重定向后的人类操作演示的点云观测中学习连续动作表示。我们采用对比目标来鼓励不同具身之间一致的运动表示。由此得到的统一潜在动作空间直接作为模型预测控制的搜索空间，其中采样的潜在动作作为基于粒子的未来预测的条件。随后，可从预测的几何运动中恢复出可执行的机器人指令，而无需具身特定的动作解码器。通过大量评估，我们证明所学到的潜在动作表现出可控且可组合的运动，能够迁移到未见过的机器人具身，并支持在未见过的夹爪几何形状下的零样本操作。经过与任务无关的适配后，我们的模型在到达、抓取和放置任务上分别达到90%、92%和60%的成功率，而DexWM报告的对应结果为72%、58%和28%。最后，我们使用一只未见过的灵巧手展示了零样本真实世界操作，在涉及推动、抓取和提起日常物体的五个多样化任务上，50次试验中达到了86%的成功率。这些结果凸显了以几何为基础的潜在动作作为基于世界模型的机器人操作之统一、可迁移接口的潜力。项目材料，包括演示视频和源代码，可在 https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/ 获取。

title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://pawteam-eai.github.io/native-lam/
summary: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.

AI.title_zh: 世界模型作为原生潜在动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 大规模且多样的视频来源，例如第一人称人类视频和异构机器人录制数据，蕴含着丰富的动力学信息，但它们要么不包含动作，要么不共享同一动作空间。潜在动作模型（LAM）能够恢复这些动力学，但它们是从零开始训练其逆动力学模型（IDM）和前向动力学模型（FDM），需要在像素重建与潜在容量和准确性之间进行权衡。预训练的视频世界模型能够原生地生成高保真动力学，但以稠密方式表示这些动力学，并在所有层之间相互纠缠。我们将世界模型视为一种 LAM，并表明只需对模型做最小改动即可提取这些动力学。原生 LAM（Native LAM）将同一个预训练视频扩散 Transformer 同时用作 IDM 和 FDM，仅以可学习的动力学寄存器（dynamics registers）作为两者之间唯一的因果桥梁，并在仅在运动上不同的反事实时间对上训练，从而使这些寄存器将视频的动力学蒸馏为一个紧凑的原生潜在动作。我们进一步提出一种面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的预训练范式——从世界模型预训练动作（Pretraining Actions from World models，PAWlicy），其中 Native LAM 在大规模视频上充当动力学教师；与世界动作模型不同，它从不生成视频。原生潜在动作在 LARY 基准上的动作分类和控制回归两项任务中均优于现有 LAM，并能在新机器人、新场景中以及从人类手部到机器人的情况下重放相同的运动，尽管训练中未使用任何迁移目标。在 3.8B 模型下，PAWlicy 在使用域随机化演示训练的 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 93.6% 的平均成功率，为 VLA 中最高。在 RoboDojo 上，它在我们所评估的每个维度上都具有竞争力，并且由我们评估的其 Precision 与排行榜领先条目相当。在真实机器人上，它在两项任务上均优于 pi_0.5 基线。两个阶段均仅使用公开数据和公开释放的世界模型。

title: Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing?
summary: Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error. We propose MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens. Training pairs full and subset views of the same degraded observations, penalizing higher error with more sensors. Where geometry permits, the distance readout uses range measurements alone, while the rest of the prediction draws on all available inputs. Paired tests across five datasets reveal helpful and harmful sensor additions. MakeSense reduces negative fusion on MM-Fi. With lightweight adapters and per-dataset training, the same design improves UAV localization on MMAUD, cooperative 3D detection on V2X-Real, few-shot pose transfer to RELI11D, and command prediction on Humanoid-Everyday, where a world model trained on the frozen core's outputs forecasts future fused states more accurately than a linear baseline at longer tested horizons. MakeSense supports embodied sensing across human activity, aerial systems, robotics, and autonomous driving.

AI.title_zh: 多模态融合能否为退化感知下的具身视觉带来MakeSense？
AI.abstract_zh: 具身视觉系统依赖互补传感器，在条件变化时进行感知与行动。即便是接受任意传感器子集的模型，也可能表现出负融合（negative fusion）：增加一个传感器反而使预测误差上升。我们提出MakeSense，一种多模态融合框架，它将各传感器特有的证据保留在私有流（private streams）中，并通过共享瓶颈令牌（shared bottleneck tokens）组合信息。训练时将同一退化观测的完整视图与子集视图配对，对传感器更多时误差更高的情况施加惩罚。在几何条件允许时，距离读数仅使用测距测量，而预测的其余部分则利用所有可用输入。在五个数据集上的配对测试揭示了有益的与有害的传感器添加。MakeSense减少了MM-Fi上的负融合。借助轻量适配器和按数据集训练，同一设计在MMAUD上改进了无人机（UAV）定位，在V2X-Real上改进了协同3D检测，在RELI11D上改进了少样本姿态迁移，在Humanoid-Everyday上改进了指令预测；在该任务中，一个以冻结核心输出为训练基础的世界模型，在更长的测试时域上比线性基线更准确地预测未来的融合状态。MakeSense支持跨越人类活动、空中系统、机器人和自动驾驶的具身感知。

title: LiveAudio: From Bidirectional to Autoregressive Diffusion for Real-Time Streaming Video-to-Audio Generation
summary: Video-to-audio generation synthesizes sound that matches a video in content and timing, with applications ranging from film post-production to live streaming, games and interactive world models. Interactive applications receive video continuously and need the sound to follow it in real time, yet most existing video-to-audio models are bidirectional and must observe an entire clip before producing any sound. We propose LiveAudio, a streaming video-to-audio framework that generates high-quality and synchronized audio in real time while the video is playing. In contrast to prior streaming models trained from scratch, LiveAudio converts a bidirectional model into a streaming generator so as to build on its audio quality and synchronization. LiveAudio generates audio block by block, and each block depends only on the video that has already been played. The streaming generator is obtained from the bidirectional model through progressive causal fine-tuning and distillation, so that each block needs only a few sampling steps. Experiments on VGGSound show that LiveAudio outperforms existing streaming models in audio quality and synchronization, and surpasses the bidirectional model it starts from in synchronization. On a single A100 GPU, it runs in real time with a real-time factor of 0.79 and a time to first frame of 143 ms. Audio samples are available at https://streamaudio.github.io.

AI.title_zh: LiveAudio：从双向到自回归扩散的实时流式视频到音频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 视频到音频生成旨在合成在内容与时间上与视频相匹配的声音，其应用涵盖电影后期制作、直播、游戏以及交互式世界模型等领域。交互式应用会连续接收视频，并需要声音实时跟随视频。然而，现有大多数视频到音频模型都是双向的，必须观察完整片段后才能生成任何声音。我们提出 LiveAudio，一个流式视频到音频框架，可在视频播放的同时实时生成高质量且同步的音频。与以往从零开始训练的流式模型不同，LiveAudio 将双向模型转换为流式生成器，以便利用其音频质量与同步性。LiveAudio 逐块生成音频，每个音频块仅依赖于已经播放过的视频。该流式生成器通过渐进式因果微调与蒸馏从双向模型获得，从而使每个音频块只需少量采样步数。在 VGGSound 上的实验表明，LiveAudio 在音频质量与同步性上优于现有流式模型，并在同步性上超过其所基于的双向模型。在单块 A100 GPU 上，它以 0.79 的实时因子（real-time factor）和 143 ms 的首帧时间（time to first frame）实时运行。音频样例可在 https://streamaudio.github.io 获取。

title: Optimising VLM Harnesses to Localise Errors in Generated Videos
summary: Identifying subtle errors in generated videos is an important step toward automated video generation, where errors must be detected to assess and refine generated clips. Recent work shows that pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) can localise such errors, but their effectiveness depends strongly on the workflow used: choices about which frames to inspect, which tools and model calls to make, and how to combine predictions can lead to substantially different results. We study VLM harnesses for video error localisation. Instead of relying on manually designed harnesses, we propose Harness Search and Merge (HSM), an algorithm that automatically constructs them by searching over executable evaluation programs. An LLM orchestrator refines candidate harnesses independently on random training subsets, records findings in a memory, and constructively merges complementary candidates. We evaluate HSM on Spotlight, a recently proposed benchmark for localising errors in generated videos. HSM achieves 0.234 $\pm$ 0.012 F1, exceeding the strongest benchmark strategy (0.173 $\pm$ 0.016), and retains its lead on an unseen video generator (0.213 $\pm$ 0.008 versus 0.140 $\pm$ 0.003). On IPV-Bench, it achieves strong localisation performance with lower false-alarm rates than existing optimisation baselines. Together, these results show that searching over complete VLM harnesses can outperform existing evaluation strategies, transfer to an unseen video generator, and reduce false alarms on real videos.

AI.title_zh: 优化 VLM 执行框架以定位生成视频中的错误
AI.abstract_zh: 识别生成视频中的细微错误是迈向自动化视频生成的重要一步，因为必须检测出错误才能评估和精炼生成的视频片段。近期工作表明，预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够定位此类错误，但其有效性在很大程度上取决于所使用的工作流程：关于检查哪些帧、调用哪些工具与模型、以及如何组合预测的选择，可能导致显著不同的结果。我们研究用于视频错误定位的 VLM 执行框架（harness）。我们并不依赖人工设计的执行框架，而是提出 Harness Search and Merge（HSM），一种通过在可执行评估程序上进行搜索来自动构建这些框架的算法。一个 LLM 编排器（orchestrator）在随机训练子集上独立地精炼候选执行框架，将发现记录在记忆（memory）中，并以构造性方式合并互补的候选方案。我们在 Spotlight 上评估 HSM，这是一个近期提出的用于定位生成视频中错误的基准。HSM 取得 0.234 $\pm$ 0.012 的 F1，超过最强的基准策略（0.173 $\pm$ 0.016），并在一个未见过的视频生成器上保持领先（0.213 $\pm$ 0.008 对 0.140 $\pm$ 0.003）。在 IPV-Bench 上，它取得了很强的定位性能，且误报率低于现有优化基线。总之，这些结果表明，在完整的 VLM 执行框架上进行搜索可以优于现有评估策略、迁移到未见过的视频生成器，并降低真实视频上的误报。

title: Zhengrong: World Models with Pole-Based Action-Response Factorization for Direct Visual Planning
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Technical report, Beijing Freedo Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Direct visual world models predict the effects of candidate action sequences without recursive latent rollout, yet they leave the temporal structure of action effects unspecified. We introduce Zhengrong (Zhengrong-PoleWM), a world model that decomposes a latent trajectory into an initial-condition anchor, a free response, and delayed responses to action innovations. Nonlinear networks map visual history and causal action prefixes to response coefficients. A shared bank of stable conjugate poles determines how each response evolves with elapsed time. This factorization preserves nonlinear interactions across actions, anchors predictions exactly at the initial state, prevents future actions from affecting earlier predictions, and yields bounded responses to finite control plans. We derive an exact re-anchoring identity that identifies the additional basis direction $Ψ_κ(s)$ needed to represent shifted trajectory tails. Across four offline image-goal control benchmarks (Cube, TwoRoom, PushT, and Reacher), Zhengrong-PoleWM achieves $90.83\% \pm 0.47\%$ macro-average success over two training seeds at epoch 20, exceeding the strongest baseline (QQWorld) by 6.08 percentage points. Selecting checkpoints by validation loss yields $91.21\% \pm 1.00\%$. In a controlled first-epoch Cube study without restart regularization, neural and pole response heads outperform a generic direct predictor by 20.67 and 23.34 percentage points, respectively. On an NVIDIA A100 GPU, median latency for a full 30-iteration cross-entropy method search ranges from 74 to 87 ms across the four tasks. The mean of these medians is 77.5 ms, a 15.8% latency reduction relative to Fast-LeWM and a $7.1\times$ speedup over autoregressive LeWM.

AI.title_zh: Zhengrong: 面向直接视觉规划的基于极点动作-响应因子分解的世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 直接视觉世界模型无需递归潜在推演即可预测候选动作序列的效果，但它们未明确动作效应的时间结构。我们提出Zhengrong（Zhengrong-PoleWM），一种世界模型，将潜在轨迹分解为初始条件锚点、自由响应以及针对动作新息的延迟响应。非线性网络将视觉历史与因果动作前缀映射为响应系数。一个共享的稳定共轭极点库决定每个响应如何随经过时间演化。该因子分解保留了动作之间的非线性交互，使预测在初始状态处精确锚定，防止未来动作影响更早的预测，并对有限控制计划产生有界响应。我们推导出一个精确的重锚定恒等式，它识别出表示平移后轨迹尾部所需的额外基方向 $Ψ_κ(s)$。在四个离线图像目标控制基准（Cube、TwoRoom、PushT 和 Reacher）上，Zhengrong-PoleWM在第20个epoch、两个训练种子上取得 $90.83\% \pm 0.47\%$ 的宏平均成功率，比最强基线（QQWorld）高出6.08个百分点。按验证损失选择检查点可得到 $91.21\% \pm 1.00\%$。在一项无重启正则化的受控首轮epoch Cube研究中，神经响应头与极点响应头分别比通用直接预测器高出20.67和23.34个百分点。在NVIDIA A100 GPU上，针对四个任务，完整30次迭代的交叉熵方法搜索的中位延迟范围为74至87 ms。这些中位数的均值为77.5 ms，相对于Fast-LeWM降低15.8%的延迟，并相对于自回归LeWM实现 $7.1\times$ 的加速。

title: ActField: Learning Action Effects as Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics
summary: Learning how actions change visual states is essential for prediction and decision-making in embodied tasks. Existing action-conditioned JEPA world models typically predict future representations at discrete observation intervals, leaving the temporal evolution of action effects implicit. We introduce ActField, a continuous-time JEPA world model that explicitly models latent state evolution through an action-conditioned vector field integrated over physical time. ActField separates action-independent evolution from action-induced changes, with the latter modulated by the latent context. A reference-conditioned representation and multi-step dynamics loss further support accurate long-horizon prediction. Together, these components provide a structured and temporally continuous formulation for predicting action-conditioned visual dynamics. Experiments across LIBERO, DROID, and BEHAVIOR demonstrate improved visual prediction fidelity and more accurate action-induced motion prediction over existing world models. Further evaluations on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the utility of ActField in improving downstream policy planning through VLM-guided action selection.

AI.title_zh: ActField：将动作效应学习为连续时间潜在动力学
AI.abstract_zh: 学习动作如何改变视觉状态，对于具身任务中的预测与决策至关重要。现有的以动作为条件的 JEPA 世界模型通常以离散的观测间隔预测未来表征，从而使动作效应的时间演化保持隐含。我们提出 ActField，一种连续时间 JEPA 世界模型，它通过对物理时间进行积分的、以动作为条件的向量场来显式建模潜在状态演化。ActField 将动作无关的演化与动作引起的变化相分离，后者由潜在上下文调制。参考条件表征与多步动力学损失进一步支持准确的长时程预测。这些组件共同为预测以动作为条件的视觉动力学提供了一种结构化且时间连续的表述。在 LIBERO、DROID 和 BEHAVIOR 上的实验表明，相较于现有世界模型，其视觉预测保真度有所提升，动作引起的运动预测也更加准确。在仿真与真实世界操作任务上的进一步评估表明，ActField 可通过 VLM 引导的动作选择来改善下游策略规划。

title: CineAct: Interaction-State Agents for Playable, Branching Film Generation
summary: Open video generators such as MiniMax-H3 produce short clips of only several to a dozen seconds per run. To synthesize longer sequences, existing methods either rely on agentic systems following preset scripts, or roll out autoregressively from the previous clip's last frame, losing off-screen states and accumulating hallucinations across turns. Consequently, users still cannot take an explicit goal, choose how to accomplish it, and see that choice persist across subsequent clips. We study goal-grounded interactive video generation, where one goal admits multiple valid approaches, the user's chosen approach must be executed on screen, and its consequences must persist across clips. To this end, we propose CineAct, a state-first agentic framework in which language-model agents handle reasoning while frozen image and video generators serve purely as renderers. Before interaction, the Architect initializes the world as a spatial layout with cameras, an asset library, and a scene graph; at each turn, the system deduces the planned state change, generates a target end frame with an image generator and rigorously verifies it, and synthesizes intermediate motion with an FL2V model. We further introduce a multi-space benchmark covering two suites: long-horizon step execution and open-intent branching admissibility. Experiments show that explicit world-state modeling boosts multi-step rollout consistency over the pixel-only baseline (+11.4 automated, +23.1 human points) and raises paired branching success toward a shared goal by +30.8 points.

AI.title_zh: CineAct：面向可玩、分支式电影生成的交互状态智能体
AI.abstract_zh: 开放视频生成器（如 MiniMax-H3）每次运行仅产生数秒至十几秒的短片段。为合成更长的序列，现有方法要么依赖遵循预设剧本的智能体系统，要么从上一片段的最后一帧自回归式地逐步外推，从而丢失屏幕外状态并在多轮之间累积幻觉。因此，用户仍无法提出一个明确的目标、选择如何实现该目标，并看到该选择在后续片段中得以延续。我们研究目标锚定的交互式视频生成，其中同一个目标允许多种有效实现路径，用户所选择的路径必须在画面上被执行，且其后果必须在片段之间保持延续。为此，我们提出 CineAct，一个状态优先的智能体框架，其中语言模型智能体负责推理，而冻结的图像与视频生成器仅充当渲染器。在交互开始之前，Architect 将世界初始化为带有相机的空间布局、资产库与场景图；在每一轮中，系统推断计划的状态变化，用图像生成器生成目标结束帧并对其进行严格验证，再用 FL2V 模型合成中间运动。我们进一步引入一个多空间基准，涵盖两个套件：长时程步骤执行与开放意图分支的可采纳性。实验表明，显式的世界状态建模相比仅基于像素的基线提升了多步外推的一致性（自动指标 +11.4，人类评分 +23.1 分），并将面向共同目标的成对分支成功率提升了 +30.8 分。

title: ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild
comment: Main text 8 pages with supplementary material, 54 pages in total
summary: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras. In this work, we propose ViDiHand2, a geometry-driven framework that reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation from direct regression into fine-grained geometric constraint solving. Specifically, we introduce Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting and Clip-Level Ray Fitting, which recover metric depth by enforcing geometric consistency between pixel-aligned 2D joints and the metric structure of MANO hands, while leveraging temporal observations across the clip. Since the lifting relies on these 2D joints, to improve robustness under occlusion and image truncation, we further develop Confidence-Gated Fusion to adaptively combine geometrically lifted joints with MANO predictions according to localization confidence. Finally, we enhance the VDM backbone to better capture spatial-temporal representations and produce the per-frame 2D joint and MANO predictions that both steps rely on. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets demonstrate that ViDiHand2 consistently outperforms 18 baselines, reducing in-the-wild absolute joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x compared with the best baseline on each metric, while running at 57 FPS. The project page is available at https://vidihand2.github.io/.

AI.title_zh: ViDiHand2：统一视频扩散先验与手部几何，实现野外场景下的三维手部运动重建
AI.abstract_zh: 从第一人称人类视频中学习机器人操作需要准确的度量三维手部运动。近期方法利用预训练视频扩散模型（VDM）先验，直接从全帧视频中恢复被遮挡的手部，但其基于外观的深度回归对未见过的相机泛化性较差。在本工作中，我们提出 ViDiHand2，一个几何驱动的框架，它将基于 VDM 的手部深度估计从直接回归重新表述为细粒度几何约束求解。具体而言，我们引入细粒度几何提升（Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting）与片段级射线拟合（Clip-Level Ray Fitting），通过强制像素对齐的二维关节与 MANO 手部的度量结构之间的几何一致性，并利用整个片段内的时序观测，来恢复度量深度。由于该提升过程依赖于这些二维关节，为提升在遮挡与图像截断下的鲁棒性，我们进一步提出置信度门控融合（Confidence-Gated Fusion），依据定位置信度自适应地将几何提升得到的关节与 MANO 预测相结合。最后，我们增强 VDM 骨干网络以更好地捕捉时空表征，并产生上述两个步骤所依赖的逐帧二维关节与 MANO 预测。在七个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，ViDiHand2 一致优于 18 个基线方法，与各指标上的最佳基线相比，将野外场景的绝对关节误差降低 42%，检测失败降低 8.82 倍，同时运行速度达 57 FPS。项目页面见 https://vidihand2.github.io/。

title: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld. Project page: https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld

AI.title_zh: 写入、演化、读取：将相机流式输入持久世界状态以进行4D占用预测
AI.abstract_zh: 4D占用预测旨在预测驾驶场景在未来数秒内的3D语义占用。在几秒的时间尺度上，场景变化很小而车辆在移动，因此前方大部分空间已经被看到过。将未来空间划分为未变化、已变化和未见过三类后，我们发现当前基于相机的世界模型在未变化部分表现不足：它们未能保持住已经看到过的内容，而不是未能预测将会发生变化的内容。因此，我们让模型已经看到的内容成为其状态。PersistWorld将相机帧流式写入一个锚定在场景中的持久3D世界状态，每帧只写入一次，而不是从过去帧重建状态。该状态与预测任务端到端联合学习，并由一个演化器（evolver）在自车轨迹上任意查询时刻预测该状态。在Occ3D-nuScenes上，PersistWorld在1-3秒将最佳基于相机的世界模型的IoU提升19个点，在最长8秒内提升18至24个点，同时运行速度超过其两倍。代码与模型：https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld。项目页面：https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld

title: VeriTouch: Verified Visuo-Tactile World Models that Improve Robot Policy Learning
summary: Scaling visuo-tactile policy learning is constrained by the high cost of real-world data collection and the difficulty of building realistic simulations. Generative models offer a scalable source of training data, yet useful demonstrations require plausible tactile feedback, temporal alignment with visual contact, and accurate actions. To this end, we present VeriTouch, a framework for generating and verifying synthetic visuo-tactile trajectories for policy learning. Conditioned on initial images and task instructions, our world model, VeriGen, jointly generates high-fidelity dual-view videos and realistic tactile sequences over complete manipulation trajectories. By integrating a dedicated tactile expert with a pretrained video model, it captures realistic visual details and tactile deformation dynamics through joint visuo-tactile modeling. Our multimodal verifier VeriEval then checks visual quality while focusing on tactile reliability, assessing tactile realism, contact-force plausibility, and temporal alignment between visible contact and tactile signals, thereby directly filtering out unreliable sequences. Finally, our inverse dynamics model, VeriIDM, combines global scene information from both camera views with fine-grained gripper details and motion across neighboring frames to extract actions from verified videos. Experiments on five real-world tasks show that synthetic data improves all four evaluated policies, with further scaling synthetic trajectories substantially boosting policy performance without additional real-world data collection.

AI.title_zh: VeriTouch：提升机器人策略学习的经验证的视觉-触觉世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 扩展视觉-触觉策略学习受限于真实世界数据采集的高昂成本以及构建逼真仿真的困难。生成模型提供了可扩展的训练数据来源，然而有用的演示需要合理的触觉反馈、与视觉接触的时间对齐以及准确的动作。为此，我们提出 VeriTouch，一个用于生成和验证用于策略学习的合成视觉-触觉轨迹的框架。以初始图像和任务指令为条件，我们的世界模型 VeriGen 在完整的操作轨迹上联合生成高保真双视角视频和逼真的触觉序列。通过将专门的触觉专家与预训练视频模型相结合，它通过联合视觉-触觉建模捕捉逼真的视觉细节和触觉形变动力学。我们的多模态验证器 VeriEval 随后检查视觉质量，同时聚焦于触觉可靠性，评估触觉真实性、接触力的合理性以及可见接触与触觉信号之间的时间对齐，从而直接过滤掉不可靠的序列。最后，我们的逆动力学模型 VeriIDM 将来自两个相机视角的全局场景信息与细粒度的夹爪细节及相邻帧间的运动相结合，从经过验证的视频中提取动作。在五个真实世界任务上的实验表明，合成数据提升了所有四个被评估的策略，而进一步扩展合成轨迹可在不额外采集真实世界数据的情况下大幅提升策略性能。

title: Assembly-JEPA: Using World Models for Fine-Grained Industrial Image Verification
summary: Automated verification of industrial assembly processes remains a challenging problem due to substantial visual variability, limited availability of labeled defect data, and the fine-grained nature of many assembly errors. Existing approaches often rely on object detection, CAD models, or supervised classification pipelines, which can struggle to generalize across changing products and assembly configurations. In this work, we propose a novel self-supervised assembly verification framework based on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs). Starting from the JEPA-based world model LeWorldModel, we investigate how the architecture must be adapted to verify the correctness of fine-grained assembly operations. To this end, we formulate assembly verification as a predictive world modeling task operating on before-and-after observations of assembly processes. Experimental results on industrial assembly tasks demonstrate that the proposed approach reliably detects both fine-grained incorrect assembly states and action-state mismatches, achieving an AUROC of 86.9% on a newly introduced assembly verification dataset. These results indicate that JEPA-based predictive representations constitute a promising foundation for robust and data-efficient industrial assembly verification.

AI.title_zh: Assembly-JEPA：使用世界模型进行细粒度工业图像验证
AI.abstract_zh: 由于存在显著的视觉变异性、标注缺陷数据获取受限，以及许多装配错误具有细粒度性质，工业装配过程的自动化验证仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。现有方法通常依赖目标检测、CAD 模型或有监督分类流程，这些方法难以在变化的产品和装配配置之间泛化。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures，JEPAs）的新型自监督装配验证框架。以基于 JEPA 的世界模型 LeWorldModel 为起点，我们研究了该架构必须如何调整才能验证细粒度装配操作的正确性。为此，我们将装配验证形式化为一个预测性世界建模任务，作用于装配过程的前后观测（before-and-after observations）之上。在工业装配任务上的实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够可靠地检测细粒度的错误装配状态以及动作-状态不匹配（action-state mismatches），在一个新引入的装配验证数据集上取得了 86.9% 的 AUROC。这些结果表明，基于 JEPA 的预测性表示构成了稳健且数据高效的工业装配验证的一个有前景的基础。

title: AXE: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
comment: Innovation Award winner, Physical AI AV Track (PAI-AV), AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge 2026, with results shared at the NeurIPS 2026 World Models in Physical AI Workshop. 15 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables
summary: This report presents a comprehensive pipeline for developing an end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving model for the Physical AI AV Track. The framework consists of data curation, HD map auto-labelling, data-driven imitation learning, and simulator-based reinforcement learning. To ensure safety in the closed-loop setting, we introduce a selection-based E2E planning approach that leverages object detection and BEV segmentation to filter out trajectory candidates likely to cause collisions or off-road driving. Trained on NVIDIA NuRec and the NVIDIA PAI-AV dataset, our method scores a fixed vocabulary of trajectory candidates for collision, drivable-area compliance, and progress learned from simulated rollouts, and selects the best candidate that passes the filter. This design highlights the effectiveness of combining E2E planning with perception-based trajectory filtering for safe and reliable closed-loop autonomous driving.

AI.title_zh: AXE：AlpaSim 端到端闭环挑战赛技术报告
AI.abstract_zh: 本报告提出了一套用于为 Physical AI AV Track 开发端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型的完整流水线。该框架由数据整理、高清地图自动标注、数据驱动的模仿学习以及基于模拟器的强化学习组成。为确保闭环场景中的安全性，我们引入了一种基于选择的端到端规划方法，利用目标检测和 BEV 分割来滤除可能引发碰撞或驶出道路的轨迹候选。我们的方法在 NVIDIA NuRec 和 NVIDIA PAI-AV 数据集上训练，对一组固定的轨迹候选词表在碰撞、可行驶区域合规性以及从模拟推演中学习到的进度方面进行评分，并选出通过筛选的最佳候选。该设计凸显了将端到端规划与基于感知的轨迹过滤相结合，对于安全可靠的闭环自动驾驶的有效性。

title: Spatial-Zero: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models from Zero Data
comment: 19 pages, including appendices. 4 figures and 3 tables in the main text
summary: Spatial reasoning requires a vision-language model~(VLM) to understand metric distances, three-dimensional relationships, and viewpoint-dependent geometry. Learning these capabilities typically requires externally curated training data. This paper introduces Spatial-Zero, a VLMs' training framework that can self-evolve through autonomous spatial exploration with zero data. Spatial-Zero addresses two key challenges in autonomous spatial exploration: reliably generating valid spatial interaction tasks and providing accurate supervision for learning from these tasks. Specifically, a proposer specifies object configurations and questions, and a Coder turns them into executable scene programs that produce multi-view images and explicit scene geometry. A Geometric Oracle checks spatial constraints, visibility, and answer uniqueness and derives ground-truth labels from executed geometry; these labels supervise the Solver and ground difficulty feedback, while validation outcomes guide subsequent task generation. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks and three VLM backbones, Spatial-Zero yields consistent gains through iterative self-evolution. After three iterations, Qwen3.5-9B improves average accuracy by 3.23 percentage points; with Qwen3.5-4B, Spatial-Zero also outperforms existing VLM self-evolution methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/YutongLi2024/Spatial-Zero

AI.title_zh: Spatial-Zero：视觉语言模型从零数据中自演化的空间推理
AI.abstract_zh: 空间推理要求视觉语言模型（VLM）理解度量距离、三维关系以及依赖视角的几何。学习这些能力通常需要外部精心整理（curated）的训练数据。本文提出 Spatial-Zero，一个 VLMs 训练框架，能够在零数据条件下通过自主空间探索实现自演化。Spatial-Zero 解决了自主空间探索中的两个关键挑战：可靠地生成有效的空间交互任务，以及为从这些任务中学习提供准确的监督。具体而言，一个提议者（proposer）指定物体配置和问题，一个 Coder 将其转化为可执行的场景程序，从而生成多视角图像和显式的场景几何。一个几何神谕（Geometric Oracle）检查空间约束、可见性和答案唯一性，并从执行得到的几何中导出真值标签；这些标签用于监督 Solver 并支撑难度反馈，而验证结果则指导后续的任务生成。在六个空间推理基准和三个 VLM 骨干（backbone）上，Spatial-Zero 通过迭代自演化取得了一致的提升。经过三次迭代后，Qwen3.5-9B 的平均准确率提升了 3.23 个百分点；在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，Spatial-Zero 也优于现有的 VLM 自演化方法。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/YutongLi2024/Spatial-Zero 获取。

title: ColonoWorld: Camera-Controlled Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Video Generation
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld
summary: Navigation systems in colonoscopy are advancing from guiding the endoscopist to steering the scope autonomously. Since an incorrect motion can injure the patient, developing and evaluating these systems calls for a world model of colonoscopy. Such a model must follow a commanded scope motion, keep the colon anatomy consistent, and show lesions and procedural events. Yet camera-controlled generators trained on general scenes lose the colon's structure under motion, and endoscopic generators offer no camera control. We present ColonoWorld, a colonoscopy world model conditioned on a camera trajectory and a coarse 3D tube of the colon, trained on in vivo videos. From a whole-colon tube, it generates a full cecum-to-rectum procedure, even for unseen colon shapes. It also places polyps, instruments, and irrigation at specified locations and times. ColonoWorld outperforms state-of-the-art video generators, reducing camera trajectory error by 32% and FVD by 29%. Our code and annotations will be released at https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld.

AI.title_zh: ColonoWorld：相机可控的全流程结肠镜视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 结肠镜检查中的导航系统正从引导内镜医师推进到自主操控内镜。由于错误的运动可能伤害患者，开发与评估这些系统需要一个结肠镜检查的世界模型。这样的模型必须遵循所指令的内镜运动、保持结肠解剖结构的一致性，并呈现病变与操作事件。然而，在通用场景上训练的相机可控生成器在运动下会丢失结肠的结构，而内镜生成器则不提供相机控制。我们提出 ColonoWorld，一个以相机轨迹和结肠的粗略 3D 管状结构为条件、在活体视频上训练的结肠镜检查世界模型。基于整段结肠的管状结构，它能够生成从盲肠到直肠的全流程检查，即使对于未见过的结肠形状也是如此。它还能够在指定的位置和时间放置息肉、器械和冲洗。ColonoWorld 优于最先进的视频生成器，将相机轨迹误差降低 32%，FVD 降低 29%。我们的代码与标注将发布于 https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld。

title: SceneCast: Learning Indoor Scene Synthesis from Curated Synthetic Videos with LLM Reward
summary: 3D indoor scene synthesis requires generating objects to form a complete and coherent scene. Existing approaches rely heavily on manually annotated datasets, leading to high costs and limited generalization. We present SceneCast, an annotation-free framework that trains on large-scale, unlabeled videos, addressing two key challenges: (1) Videos provide only partial views of a scene, requiring the model to extrapolate unseen 3D regions, which is inherently error-prone; (2) Raw videos available online are uncurated, suffering from uncontrolled conditions and variable data quality. First, we design a Transformer-based model that predicts objects sequentially and is fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL), where an LLM acts as a spatial common-sense evaluator. The LLM provides reward signals through chain-of-thought reasoning and code-executable geometric checks to refine object configurations. Second, we introduce \trim, a data curation approach that generates training videos with controllable video generation models. Crucially, it retains only high-quality prefix clips via multi-criteria quality assessment with an entropy-based weighting strategy. Evaluated on curated synthetic video sets, our annotation-free approach outperforms state-of-the-art supervised methods in scene quality.

AI.title_zh: SceneCast：利用精选合成视频与LLM奖励学习室内场景合成
AI.abstract_zh: 3D室内场景合成需要生成物体以构成完整且连贯的场景。现有方法严重依赖人工标注的数据集，导致成本高昂且泛化能力有限。我们提出SceneCast，一个无需标注的框架，它在大规模无标注视频上进行训练，并解决两个关键挑战：（1）视频只提供场景的部分视图，要求模型外推未见过的3D区域，而这本身容易出错；（2）网络上可获取的原始视频未经精选，受制于不受控的条件和可变的数据质量。首先，我们设计了一个基于Transformer的模型，它顺序地预测物体，并通过强化学习（RL）进行微调，其中LLM充当空间常识评估器。LLM通过思维链推理和可执行代码的几何检查提供奖励信号，以细化物体配置。其次，我们引入\trim，一种数据精选方法，它使用可控的视频生成模型生成训练视频。关键在于，它通过多标准质量评估并结合基于熵的加权策略，仅保留高质量的前缀片段。在精选的合成视频集上评估，我们的无需标注方法在场景质量上优于最先进的监督方法。

title: Draft Forcing: Target-guided Speculative Drafting and Learned Verifier for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable streaming synthesis chunk by chunk, yet invoking the large model for every chunk remains costly. While chunk-level speculative decoding can offload chunks to a lightweight draft model, existing approaches suffer from two limitations: (1) an off-the-shelf draft diverges from the target's trajectory, compounding errors in history; and (2) they either omit verification or rely on costly post-decode aesthetic scores rather than verifying consistency against the target. We address both with Draft Forcing, a framework coupling target-guided drafting with an on-policy trained verifier. Specifically, to align the draft for high acceptance, we opt for feature-level drafting, conditioning it on multi-layer target hidden states persisted from committed chunks, whose outputs are pushed to match target trajectories with multi-aspect losses. For verification, we propose an on-policy trained feature-space verifier predicting CDF-calibrated frame-wise relative RMSE against the target. It is trained on speculative rollouts as contexts anneal from random to inference-aligned mixtures, and gates proposals without VAE decoding. On the 14B Self-Forcing target, Draft Forcing achieves $1.63\times$ DiT and $1.57\times$ end-to-end speedups on VBench with minimal quality loss, and up to $1.93\times$ DiT ($1.82\times$ end-to-end) when combined with orthogonal KV compression. It generalizes to accelerate a streaming variant of MiniMax-H3, generating over $50\%$ draft frames with competitive quality.

AI.title_zh: Draft Forcing：面向自回归视频生成的目标引导推测起草与学习型验证器
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归视频扩散模型能够逐块进行流式合成，但为每个块都调用大模型仍然代价高昂。虽然块级推测解码（chunk-level speculative decoding）可以将块卸载给轻量级起草模型，但现有方法存在两点局限：(1) 现成的起草模型会偏离目标模型的轨迹，导致历史中的误差不断累积；(2) 它们要么省略验证，要么依赖代价高昂的解码后美学分数，而不是验证与目标模型的一致性。我们通过 Draft Forcing 同时解决这两个问题，该框架将目标引导的起草与在策略（on-policy）训练的验证器耦合起来。具体而言，为对齐起草模型以获得高接受率，我们选择特征级起草，以从已提交块中留存的多层目标隐藏状态为条件，并通过多方面损失将其输出推向匹配目标轨迹。在验证方面，我们提出一种在策略训练的特征空间验证器，预测相对于目标的、经 CDF 校准的逐帧相对 RMSE。该验证器在推测性展开（speculative rollouts）上训练，其上下文从随机混合退火至与推理对齐的混合，并在无需 VAE 解码的情况下对候选提案进行门控。在 14B 的 Self-Forcing 目标模型上，Draft Forcing 在 VBench 上实现了 $1.63\times$ 的 DiT 加速和 $1.57\times$ 的端到端加速，且质量损失极小；当与正交的 KV 压缩结合时，DiT 加速最高可达 $1.93\times$（端到端 $1.82\times$）。该方法还可推广用于加速 MiniMax-H3 的流式变体，在具有竞争力的质量下生成超过 $50\%$ 的起草帧。

title: Seeing Together, Acting Apart: Shared Environmental Understanding for Multi-Robot Navigation
summary: Multi-robot embodied systems are typically designed to collaborate by coordinating actions, sharing trajectories, or learning joint policies. We ask a complementary question: can collaboration emerge before decision-making, by first building a shared understanding of the environment? We introduce Shared Environmental Understanding, a policy-agnostic representation that aggregates partial egocentric observations from multiple robots into a shared latent world model. This shifts collaboration from the policy space to the representation space, enabling decentralized decision-making with shared environmental context. To this end, we propose Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval (SEER), a framework that organizes multi-robot observations into a shared memory, retrieves relevant context via spatio-temporal similarity, and encodes it using a predictive latent world model. The resulting representations are injected into downstream navigation agents as tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that SEER captures action-relevant environmental structure and consistently improves navigation performance across both specialized VLN agents and general vision-language model agents, while preserving single-agent capabilities.

AI.title_zh: 共同观察，分头行动：面向多机器人导航的共享环境理解
AI.abstract_zh: 多机器人具身系统通常被设计为通过协调动作、共享轨迹或学习联合策略来进行协作。我们提出一个互补的问题：协作能否在决策之前就涌现出来，即先建立对环境的共享理解？我们引入共享环境理解（Shared Environmental Understanding），这是一种与策略无关的表示，它将来自多个机器人的部分自我中心观测聚合到一个共享的潜世界模型中。这将协作从策略空间转移到表示空间，使得在具备共享环境上下文的情况下进行去中心化决策成为可能。为此，我们提出共享环境编码与检索（Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval, SEER）框架，它将多机器人观测组织到一个共享记忆中，通过时空相似性检索相关上下文，并使用预测性潜世界模型对其进行编码。所得到的表示以 token 的形式注入下游导航智能体。实验结果表明，SEER 能够捕捉与动作相关的环境结构，并在专门化的 VLN 智能体和通用视觉语言模型智能体上均持续提升导航性能，同时保持单智能体的能力。

title: VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments
comment: 32 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Code at https://github.com/VITA-Group/VeriWorld and dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/yanyanzheng96/VeriWorld
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for spatial tasks such as navigation and manipulation, where they must infer geometry and object relationships from visual input in order to act correctly. Existing benchmarks usually test perception and reasoning in isolation, making it hard to tell whether failures come from visual understanding, downstream reasoning, or the bridge between them. We introduce VeriWorld, a benchmark for spatial reasoning in interactive 3D environments with executable actions and deterministic verification. For task families where all three channels are well-defined, we evaluate matched visual, structured, and combined input conditions on the same instance, environment, and verifier; families without a clean visual/structured/combined split are reported separately. This design supports controlled comparisons of perception, reasoning, and their interaction. Using this setup, we uncover two diagnostic findings. First, models often perform much better when task-relevant information, such as object identity, current state, or target location, is given explicitly than when it must be read from the rendered scene, revealing a recurring visual-to-structure gap. Second, action-space and harness design can change outcomes even under the same task and information condition, showing that interaction protocol is itself a confounding variable. VeriWorld is open-sourced to support reproducible and fine-grained evaluation of spatial reasoning in VLMs.

AI.title_zh: VeriWorld：一个用于3D环境中空间推理的可验证视觉SWE-Bench
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）越来越多地被用于导航与操作等空间任务，在这些任务中，它们必须从视觉输入中推断几何结构与物体关系，以便正确行动。现有基准通常孤立地测试感知与推理，使人难以辨别失败究竟源自视觉理解、下游推理，还是二者之间的衔接。我们提出 VeriWorld，这是一个用于交互式3D环境中空间推理的基准，具有可执行动作与确定性验证。对于三类通道均已良好定义的任务族，我们在同一实例、同一环境和同一验证器上评估匹配的视觉、结构化以及组合输入条件；对于不存在清晰的视觉/结构化/组合划分的任务族，我们单独报告。这一设计支持对感知、推理及其相互作用进行受控比较。借助该设置，我们揭示了两项诊断性发现。第一，当与任务相关的信息（如物体身份、当前状态或目标位置）被明确给出时，模型的表现往往远好于必须从渲染场景中读取这些信息时，这揭示出一种反复出现的视觉到结构（visual-to-structure）差距。第二，即使在相同任务和信息条件下，动作空间与测试框架（harness）设计也可能改变结果，这表明交互协议本身就是一个混杂变量。VeriWorld 已开源，以支持对 VLMs 中空间推理进行可复现且细粒度的评估。

title: RoomTokens: Masked Diffusion over Structured Tokens for Indoor Scene Synthesis
summary: Generating 3D indoor scenes requires a representation that captures object semantics, instance identity, height structure, and orientation while respecting room geometry. Methods that model scenes as sequences of object vectors learn spatial constraints implicitly, leaving collisions and boundary violations to losses or post-processing; semantic-map methods make occupancy explicit, but collapse instance and directional structure. We introduce RoomTokens, a sliced structured-token representation in which each token stores semantic class, instance-color identity, and facing field. This representation allows a scene to be generated as a discrete grid while preserving cues for instance grouping, orientation estimation, and 3D extent prediction. To learn the RoomToken distribution, we propose MDIRT (Masked Diffusion over RoomTokens), a masked discrete diffusion model that denoises semantic/instance-color/facing channels jointly with a shared cross-slice backbone. Architectural tokens are clamped as explicit floor- plan constraints, so the model samples furniture layouts that respect room geometry while retaining instance and object-attribute structure. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that RoomTokens with MDIRT improve layout fidelity and physical consistency over sequence/vector- and map-based methods, suggesting structured spatial tokens as a practical choice for discrete 3D scene synthesis.

AI.title_zh: RoomTokens：面向室内场景合成的结构化 Token 上的掩码扩散
AI.abstract_zh: 生成 3D 室内场景需要一种能够同时刻画物体语义、实例身份、高度结构和朝向，并服从房间几何的表示方式。将场景建模为物体向量序列的方法隐式地学习空间约束，把碰撞和越界交给损失函数或后处理来解决；语义图（semantic-map）方法显式表达占用情况，但丢失了实例结构与方向结构。我们提出 RoomTokens，一种切片式结构化 Token 表示，其中每个 Token 存储语义类别、实例颜色身份和朝向场（facing field）。该表示使场景能够以离散网格的形式生成，同时保留用于实例分组、朝向估计和 3D 范围预测的线索。为学习 RoomToken 分布，我们提出 MDIRT（Masked Diffusion over RoomTokens），一种掩码离散扩散模型，通过共享的跨切片骨干网络对语义／实例颜色／朝向通道进行联合去噪。建筑 Token 作为显式的户型图约束被钳制（clamped），因此模型采样的家具布局既服从房间几何，又保留实例与物体属性结构。在 3D-FRONT 上的实验表明，结合 MDIRT 的 RoomTokens 在布局保真度和物理一致性上优于基于序列／向量和基于图的方法，表明结构化空间 Token 是离散 3D 场景合成的一种实用选择。

title: Audio-Visual Rearrangement
summary: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action prediction. Experiments establish baseline performance in both seen and unseen environments, laying the groundwork for future research on embodied intelligence and human-robot interaction. The code will be publicly available soon.

AI.title_zh: 音视频重排（Audio-Visual Rearrangement）
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出音视频重排（Audio-Visual Rearrangement, AVR），这是一项新任务：智能体听到一段口述请求，取回合适的物体，并将其递送给提出请求的用户或指令指定的目的地。AVR 要求智能体理解口述请求，并通过声学方式定位说话者以完成递送。为支持该任务，我们构建了一个数据集，涵盖三种查询类型：显式目标指定、说话者相对的空间指代，以及隐含用户意图，共包含八种子类型，具有多样的物体选择与递送要求。此外，我们提出了一个框架，将运动感知的空间音频模块集成到音视频大语言模型中，以编码来自口述请求的空间线索，并在智能体移动时更新这些线索。我们进一步通过多任务指令调优，引入针对语音理解、空间音频感知和视觉定位的辅助监督，以改进动作预测。实验在已见和未见环境中建立了基线性能，为具身智能和人机交互的未来研究奠定了基础。代码将很快公开。

title: ReVAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Ruize Han is the corresponding author
summary: A central challenge in generating instructional videos for reasoning-intensive topics is to show how and why the state changes at each step. Even when an animation renders successfully, the depicted object relationships and state transitions can conflict with the explanation, making the reasoning difficult to follow. We present ReVAgent, a multi-agent framework that solves a problem, generates keyframes for its explanation, and synthesizes an instructional video. The agents share the execution record of a solution program, reuse intermediate results and constructions in the scenes, and check rendered keyframes to guide revisions to the solution or the scenes. We also introduce a multidimensional rubric for assessing whether generated videos present the problem clearly, organize the steps coherently, and use visuals to explain the reasoning. We calibrate a multimodal judge using human ratings and apply it to instructional videos for mathematics and algorithms. In the evaluated samples, ReVAgent presents multi-step reasoning coherently and uses diagrams to show how key operations lead to subsequent states.

AI.title_zh: ReVAgent：多智能体推理密集型视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 为推理密集型主题生成教学视频的一个核心挑战在于，展示状态在每一步是如何以及为何发生变化的。即使动画能够成功渲染，其所描绘的物体关系与状态转换也可能与讲解相冲突，使推理过程难以被理解。我们提出 ReVAgent，一个多智能体框架，它求解一个问题、为其讲解生成关键帧，并合成一段教学视频。各智能体共享求解程序的执行记录，在场景中复用中间结果与构造，并检查渲染出的关键帧，以指导对解或场景的修改。我们还引入了一套多维评分量表，用于评估生成的视频是否清晰地呈现问题、是否连贯地组织各个步骤，以及是否运用视觉元素来解释推理过程。我们使用人工评分校准了一个多模态评判器，并将其应用于数学与算法领域的教学视频。在所评估的样本中，ReVAgent 能够连贯地呈现多步推理，并运用图示展示关键操作如何导致后续状态。

title: AxE: Benchmarking Agent-Environment Generalization of Video World Models via Grounded Events
summary: Edge cases are not the long tail; they are the norm. An embodied system deployed across changing environments, bodies, objects, and tasks will routinely encounter combinations that were absent from its training data. General-purpose physical intelligence therefore requires world models that reuse prior knowledge, predict consequences, and adapt with little or no additional training. Yet current evaluations of conditional video generation emphasize visual quality, prompt alignment, or isolated physical plausibility, leaving systematic generalization difficult to measure. We introduce AxE Bench, a benchmark that organizes condition changes along eight factors of the acting agent and of its environment, and pairs every original condition with controlled variants that change one side or both. WBench-plus applies the same structure to an existing multi-turn benchmark, pairing each WBench scenario with variants on the environment side, through its world setting or camera behavior, or on the agent side, through its interaction instructions. Additionally, to score generated futures, we develop an evaluation harness that combines vision-language reasoning with targeted computer-vision evidence, converting each video into temporally localized events and comparing generated events with reference events in both time and semantics. We summarize each model with the AxE Score, event Fidelity weighted by its Stability across original-variant pairs. Across twenty models, generated events match reference events far more often in timing than in content: no model exceeds a Fidelity of 13.01, the highest Stability is 0.55, and the highest AxE Score is 7.10. Together, these components turn world-model generalization from an informal aspiration into a falsifiable evaluation program for real and simulated interactions. Our project website can be found at: AxEBench.github.io

AI.title_zh: AxE：基于接地事件评测视频世界模型的智能体—环境泛化能力
AI.abstract_zh: 边缘案例并非长尾；它们才是常态。一个部署于不断变化的环境、本体、物体与任务之中的具身系统，将经常遇到其训练数据中不存在的组合。因此，通用物理智能需要能够复用先验知识、预测后果并在极少或无需额外训练的情况下进行适应的世界模型。然而，当前对条件视频生成的评测强调视觉质量、提示对齐或孤立的物理合理性，使得系统性泛化难以被度量。我们提出 AxE Bench，这是一个沿着行动智能体及其环境的八个因素来组织条件变化的基准，并将每一个原始条件与改变单侧或双侧的受控变体配对。WBench-plus 将同样的结构应用于一个现有的多轮基准，为每个 WBench 场景配以环境侧的变体（通过其世界设定或相机行为）或智能体侧的变体（通过其交互指令）。此外，为对生成的未来进行评分，我们开发了一套评测框架，将视觉—语言推理与有针对性的计算机视觉证据相结合，把每段视频转换为时间上局部化的事件，并在时间与语义两方面将生成事件与参考事件进行比较。我们用 AxE Score 对每个模型进行总结，即事件保真度（Fidelity）按其跨原始—变体对的稳定性（Stability）加权。在二十个模型中，生成事件在时间上与参考事件匹配的频率远高于在内容上的匹配：没有任何模型的 Fidelity 超过 13.01，最高的 Stability 为 0.55，最高的 AxE Score 为 7.10。这些组件共同将世界模型泛化从一种非正式的愿望转变为面向真实与模拟交互的可证伪评测方案。我们的项目网站见：AxEBench.github.io

title: RadarOSV: Unified 3D Scene and Motion Perception from mmWave Radars
summary: Millimeter-wave radar offers weather-resilient sensing for 3D occupancy prediction. Existing radar occupancy methods mainly model geometry, with limited joint modeling of semantics and motion. Cascaded imaging radar provides fine spatial detail but has a limited unambiguous velocity range, whereas single-chip radar offers a wider range but coarser spatial resolution. We propose RadarOSV, to our knowledge the first radar-only framework that jointly predicts occupancy, dynamic object semantics, and ground-relative velocity from raw radar data in unified voxels, by exploiting complementary measurements from both radars. Its Polar-to-Cartesian Geometry (PCG) backbone maps polar imaging-radar features into Cartesian voxels through fixed and deformable sampling, guiding cross-radar fusion for geometry and attribute prediction. Single-chip detection outputs provide class evidence, while raw Doppler spectra supply motion features and radial-velocity candidates. The velocity readout selects from these candidates using fused features to resolve aliasing, then combines the selected radial estimate with learned motion. Ego-motion compensation uses radar-estimated velocity, so inference requires no external odometry or other sensors. On K-Radar, single-frame PCG achieves 40.7% mIoU within 12.8 m, compared with RadarOcc's reported 34.3%. On the BRIDGE-Liv dataset, compared with a cascaded-radar baseline predicting the same outputs with external ego velocity, RadarOSV improves macro-averaged accuracy across four dynamic object classes within annotated object regions from 63.1% to 75.5% and reduces object radial-velocity MAE against manual Doppler annotations from 1.03 to 0.51 m/s, while maintaining geometric occupancy mIoU.

AI.title_zh: RadarOSV：基于毫米波雷达的统一三维场景与运动感知
AI.abstract_zh: 毫米波雷达为三维占据预测提供了不受天气影响的感知能力。现有的雷达占据方法主要对几何进行建模，对语义与运动的联合建模较为有限。级联式成像雷达能提供精细的空间细节，但其无模糊速度范围有限；而单芯片雷达速度范围更宽，但空间分辨率更粗糙。我们提出 RadarOSV，据我们所知，这是首个仅使用雷达的框架，通过利用两种雷达的互补测量，从原始雷达数据在统一体素中联合预测占据、动态物体语义以及相对于地面的速度。其极坐标到笛卡尔几何（Polar-to-Cartesian Geometry, PCG）主干通过固定采样与可变形采样将极坐标成像雷达特征映射到笛卡尔体素中，并引导跨雷达融合以进行几何与属性预测。单芯片检测输出提供类别证据，而原始多普勒谱提供运动特征与径向速度候选。速度读出利用融合特征从这些候选中进行选择以消解混叠，然后将所选的径向估计与学习得到的运动相结合。自车运动补偿使用雷达估计的速度，因此推理时无需外部里程计或其他传感器。在 K-Radar 上，单帧 PCG 在 12.8 m 以内达到 40.7% mIoU，而 RadarOcc 报告的结果为 34.3%。在 BRIDGE-Liv 数据集上，与使用外部自车速度预测相同输出的级联雷达基线相比，RadarOSV 将标注物体区域内四个动态物体类别的宏平均准确率从 63.1% 提升至 75.5%，并将相对于人工多普勒标注的物体径向速度 MAE 从 1.03 降至 0.51 m/s，同时保持了几何占据的 mIoU。

title: How Latent Transition Geometry Matters for Planning in World Models
summary: World models support planning by predicting how the environment evolves under candidate actions. However, one-step predictive accuracy alone does not characterize multi-step planning utility, which depends on distinguishing candidate futures. This raises a natural question: How does latent transition geometry shape planning? We investigate this through an action-conditioned transition-field view, using curvature regularization as a controlled intervention. Across four continuous-control tasks, appropriately tuned regularization improves planning, while excessive regularization can be detrimental. By decomposing the transition field into affine and non-affine components, we find that regularization reduces action sensitivity mainly through the non-affine component. To assess its role in planning, we directly manipulate the non-affine action response in frozen models and show that it affects candidate selection and closed-loop success. Further analysis shows that curvature generally brings predicted futures closer together, while preserving more of the differences along the goal direction. This helps explain why the planning effects vary across tasks. We observe broadly consistent planning trends across five sampling- and gradient-based solvers on LeWM and similar rollout-geometry trends on DINO-WM. Qualitative attention visualizations reveal accompanying shifts toward task-relevant visual structure. Together, these findings clarify how latent transition geometry influences multi-step planning.

AI.title_zh: 潜空间转移几何如何影响世界模型中的规划
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型通过预测环境在候选动作下如何演化来支持规划。然而，仅凭一步预测的准确性并不能刻画多步规划的效用，因为多步规划效用取决于能否区分候选未来。这自然引出一个问题：潜空间转移几何如何塑造规划？我们通过一个以动作为条件的转移场（transition field）视角对此进行研究，并将曲率正则化作为受控干预手段。在四个连续控制任务上，经过恰当调节的正则化能够改善规划，而过度的正则化则可能有害。通过将转移场分解为仿射分量和非仿射分量，我们发现正则化主要通过非仿射分量降低动作敏感性。为评估其在规划中的作用，我们直接操纵冻结模型中的非仿射动作响应，并表明它会影响候选选择与闭环成功率。进一步分析表明，曲率通常使预测的未来彼此更加接近，同时更多地保留沿目标方向的差异。这有助于解释为何规划效果因任务而异。我们在 LeWM 上的五种基于采样和基于梯度的求解器中观察到总体上一致的规划趋势，并在 DINO-WM 上观察到类似的推演几何（rollout-geometry）趋势。定性注意力可视化揭示出伴随出现的、向任务相关视觉结构的转变。综上，这些发现阐明了潜空间转移几何如何影响多步规划。

title: SWAM: State-aware World Action Model for Multi-Agent 3D Environments
summary: Interactive world models generate virtual environments autoregressively from player actions and visual history. However, visual history alone cannot reliably capture the evolving states of independently acting non-player characters (NPCs) in real games, particularly when they are outside the camera view. Recent multi-agent world models address this challenge through joint multi-view generation or persistent shared state, but often rely on external observations, like maps or scene geometry, or predefined state transitions. We present SWAM, a State-aware World Action Model that separates agent-state evolution from autoregressive visual generation in interactive 3D environments. A lightweight state model propagates character dynamics from actions without consuming generated frames, combining motion priors with learned scene-dependent corrections. The predicted states then guide an autoregressive diffusion transformer alongside visual history through a novel conditioning scheme. Rather than requiring an explicit scene geometry map or visibility tests, the conditioning indicates where characters may appear, allowing the diffusion model to learn their appearance and occlusion. This design enables NPCs to evolve independently of visual generation while maintaining consistent observations across visibility changes, interactions, and respawns. Evaluations in a custom Godot-based first-person shooter game demonstrate improvements in visual fidelity, NPC consistency, and long-horizon stability over existing approaches.

AI.title_zh: SWAM：面向多智能体3D环境的状态感知世界动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 交互式世界模型根据玩家动作与视觉历史，以自回归方式生成虚拟环境。然而，仅凭视觉历史无法可靠地刻画真实游戏中独立行动的非玩家角色（NPC）不断演变的状态，尤其当它们处于摄像机视野之外时。近期的多智能体世界模型通过联合多视角生成或持久化共享状态来应对这一挑战，但往往依赖外部观测（如地图或场景几何），或依赖预定义的状态转移。我们提出 SWAM——一种状态感知的世界动作模型（State-aware World Action Model），在交互式3D环境中将智能体状态演化与自回归视觉生成分离。一个轻量级状态模型在不消耗已生成帧的情况下，由动作传播角色动态，并将运动先验与学习到的场景相关修正相结合。随后，预测的状态通过一种新颖的条件化方案，与视觉历史一同引导一个自回归扩散Transformer。该条件化方案无需显式的场景几何图或可见性测试，而是指示角色可能出现的位置，从而使扩散模型能够学习其外观与遮挡。这一设计使NPC能够独立于视觉生成而演化，同时在可见性变化、交互与重生过程中保持一致观测。在基于Godot定制的第一人称射击游戏中的评估表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在视觉保真度、NPC一致性以及长时程稳定性方面均有提升。

title: MOVER: Planning Beyond Motion
summary: Residual world models forecast a driving scene through its temporal change, so feature components that stay constant over time vanish from the residual pathway. We ask whether evidence with weak temporal change, such as a waiting pedestrian or a stopped vehicle, can be used more effectively for planning, and introduce MOVER, a complementary event-routing mechanism. A training-time teacher measures how each spatially grounded event query responds when a past frame is removed from shared history and contrasts that sensitivity with the event's pooled temporal residual, prioritizing events that depend on history but receive weak residual evidence. A student predicts the resulting priorities from unperturbed history, so the teacher adds no inference cost. Under fixed total routing mass, one distribution scales a low-rank future bird's-eye-view update and biases trajectory-conditioned event reading. On nuScenes, MOVER reduces ResWorld's UniAD-style average L2 from 0.65 to 0.55 m and its collision rate from 0.23% to 0.12% without direct planner ego status (0.50 m and 0.09% with it), adding 4.1 ms per frame. Matched controls show that the complementary teacher outperforms either signal alone and that the allocation acts mainly during training. Adapted to BridgeDrive-LEAD, MOVER reaches a 96.52 +/- 0.65 driving score over three seeds on the 220-route Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, exceeding matched controls in each paired seed by a margin within seed variation.

AI.title_zh: MOVER：超越运动的规划
AI.abstract_zh: 残差世界模型通过驾驶场景的时间变化来预测该场景，因此随时间保持恒定的特征分量会从残差通路中消失。我们提出疑问：具有微弱时间变化的证据（例如等待中的行人或停止的车辆）能否被更有效地用于规划，并为此引入 MOVER，一种互补的事件路由机制。训练阶段的教师模型测量在将某一过去帧从共享历史中移除时，每个空间接地的事件查询（event query）如何响应，并将该敏感性与该事件池化的时间残差进行对比，从而优先选择那些依赖历史但获得的残差证据较弱的事件。学生模型从无扰动的历史中预测由此得到的优先级，因此教师模型不增加推理开销。在固定的总路由质量下，一个分布用于缩放低秩的未来鸟瞰图（bird's-eye-view）更新，并偏置以轨迹为条件的事件读取。在 nuScenes 上，MOVER 将 ResWorld 的 UniAD 式平均 L2 从 0.65 m 降至 0.55 m，并将碰撞率从 0.23% 降至 0.12%，且不使用规划器的直接自车状态（ego status）（使用时为 0.50 m 和 0.09%），每帧增加 4.1 ms。匹配对照表明，该互补教师优于任一单独信号，且该分配主要在训练期间起作用。适配到 BridgeDrive-LEAD 后，MOVER 在 220 条路线的 Bench2Drive 闭环基准上跨三个随机种子达到 96.52 +/- 0.65 的驾驶分数，在每个配对种子中均超过匹配对照，其幅度处于种子变异范围之内。

title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
summary: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. We introduce DivDynBench, which evaluates rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories, with instructions requiring multi-phase part coordination and explicit timing, angle, repetition, and trajectory constraints. With large language models, we systematically compare three common paradigms: specialized motion generation, video generation followed by motion recovery, and direct agent-driven generation. We analyze their control capabilities, cross-morphology adaptability, and generation costs. Guided by this comparison, we propose an Agentic Motion Framework in which an agent writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs, and a deterministic executor performs rigging, kinematic solving, and geometric correction. Compact parameter control reduces generation overhead and improves rigging reliability and motion-control accuracy, providing practical guidance for deploying complex 3D motion generation.

AI.title_zh: 3AGameFactory-Motion：面向多样化3D资产的智能体化绑定与可靠复杂运动生成
AI.abstract_zh: 根据指令为任意3D资产制作动画既需要结构推断，也需要运动控制，然而现有的运动基准大多只覆盖常规的人或动物骨架以及简单指令。我们提出DivDynBench，它在六个形态类别上评估绑定（rigging）与运动生成，其指令要求多阶段部件协同，并显式给出时序、角度、重复次数与轨迹约束。借助大语言模型，我们系统地比较了三种常见范式：专用运动生成、先生成视频再恢复运动，以及直接由智能体驱动的生成。我们分析了它们的控制能力、跨形态适应性和生成成本。以此比较为指导，我们提出一种智能体化运动框架（Agentic Motion Framework）：由智能体编写紧凑的参数化骨架程序与运动程序，由确定性执行器执行绑定、运动学求解与几何校正。紧凑的参数控制降低了生成开销，并提升了绑定可靠性与运动控制精度，为部署复杂3D运动生成提供了实践指导。

title: One Latent World for Heterogeneous LiDARs: A Scan Pattern Agnostic 4D World Model via Direct Ray Decoding
summary: LiDAR world models generate and predict metric 3D observations in the form of LiDAR scans. They typically synthesize scans following the scan pattern of their training sensor or render them from an intermediate 3D surface or field. However, following one scan pattern limits transfer to LiDARs with other patterns, and rendering from intermediate geometry can cause incorrect depths and false returns. In this paper, we propose a scan pattern agnostic 4D LiDAR world model that decouples the scene from sensor observation, so one spatial latent can be observed by heterogeneous LiDARs at the same mounting position without regeneration. Our decoder predicts the hit probability and depth of each ray directly from the latent, combining global scene context with local features retrieved at a preliminary depth. Without an intermediate surface or field, it reduces incorrect depths and false returns, and as each ray is decoded independently from one latent, LiDARs that share a ray receive the same return and observe one consistent scene. Finally, a diffusion transformer generates scenes in this latent and predicts 4D sequences from observed latents warped by the given ego and object motion. On KITTI-360 and nuScenes, our model generates realistic scenes and reduces the registration error between predicted frames by about 70% relative to the best compared world model. Its decoder yields 19 to 28% lower depth error than the rendering used by other world models, and generated scans benefit several downstream tasks. Our code will be open-sourced. More details are available at https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld.

AI.title_zh: 异构 LiDAR 的单一潜空间世界：通过直接光线解码的扫描模式无关 4D 世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: LiDAR 世界模型以 LiDAR 扫描的形式生成并预测度量的 3D 观测。它们通常按照其训练传感器的扫描模式来合成扫描，或从中间的 3D 表面或场中渲染扫描。然而，遵循单一扫描模式限制了向具有其他模式的 LiDAR 的迁移，而从中间几何渲染可能导致不正确的深度和虚假回波。在本文中，我们提出一种扫描模式无关的 4D LiDAR 世界模型，它将场景与传感器观测解耦，使得一个空间潜变量能够被同一安装位置上的异构 LiDAR 观测，而无需重新生成。我们的解码器直接从潜变量预测每条光线的命中概率和深度，将全局场景上下文与在初步深度处检索到的局部特征相结合。由于没有中间表面或场，它减少了不正确的深度和虚假回波；并且由于每条光线都独立地从同一个潜变量解码，共享某条光线的 LiDAR 会得到相同的回波并观测到一致的场景。最后，一个扩散 Transformer 在该潜空间中生成场景，并根据由给定自车与物体运动所变形的已观测潜变量预测 4D 序列。在 KITTI-360 和 nuScenes 上，我们的模型生成了逼真的场景，并且相较于最佳对比世界模型，将预测帧之间的配准误差降低约 70%。其解码器产生的深度误差比其他世界模型所用渲染低 19% 至 28%，生成的扫描有益于若干下游任务。我们的代码将开源。更多细节见 https://minwoo0611.github.io/OneLatentWorld。

title: EnvTrap: Revealing the Environment-Only Attack Surface in Embodied AI via Consequence-Blind Action Execution
summary: As AI models evolve from text and vision to physical agents, embodied AI faces a fundamentally different attack surface. Prior attacks on embodied systems have used crafted instructions, adversarial visual inputs, and training-time policy modifications; we study environment-only object rearrangements with unchanged models and instructions. We reveal an attack surface in safety-critical spatial relations among existing objects. An adversary who rearranges objects, without modifying instructions or accessing models, can cause hazardous consequences. In this work, we propose EnvTrap, a diagnostic pipeline that constructs paired safe, trap, and null-trap (benign but misleading) embodied scenarios. We demonstrate that environment-only perturbations raise hazardous-action rates to an average of 83.4% across the five evaluated action policies, with similar vulnerability patterns confirmed in world models. On a consequence-prediction task, model accuracy remains near chance, while human evaluators achieve high accuracy. We further propose a consequence-aware defense that reduces trap trigger rates by an average of 76.3 percentage points across action policies in simulation and by 62.9 percentage points pooled across physical backends. Together, these findings link environment-only attacks to a broader deficit in physical reasoning: embodied models recognize task-relevant objects yet fail to anticipate how spatial relations change the consequences of acting on them. EnvTrap makes this gap directly testable and turns hazardous layouts into training scenarios for safer embodied action. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/INKSIR/Envtrap.

AI.title_zh: EnvTrap：通过后果盲目的动作执行揭示具身AI中仅环境层面的攻击面
AI.abstract_zh: 随着AI模型从文本与视觉演进到物理智能体，具身AI面临着一种根本不同的攻击面。以往针对具身系统的攻击使用了精心构造的指令、对抗性视觉输入以及训练阶段的策略修改；我们研究的是模型与指令均保持不变、仅对环境中物体进行重新摆放的情形。我们揭示了现有物体之间安全关键的空间关系中所存在的一个攻击面。攻击者在既不修改指令也不访问模型的情况下重新摆放物体，即可造成危险后果。在本工作中，我们提出EnvTrap，一个诊断流程，用于构造配对的安全、陷阱与空陷阱（良性但具误导性）具身场景。我们证明，仅环境层面的扰动使危险动作率在所评估的五个动作策略上平均升至83.4%，并且在世界模型中确认了相似的脆弱性模式。在后果预测任务上，模型准确率仍接近随机水平，而人类评估者则达到高准确率。我们进一步提出一种后果感知防御，在仿真中将陷阱触发率在动作策略上平均降低76.3个百分点，在汇总各物理后端后降低62.9个百分点。这些发现共同将仅环境层面的攻击与物理推理中更广泛的缺陷联系起来：具身模型能够识别任务相关物体，却未能预见空间关系如何改变对其采取动作的后果。EnvTrap使这一差距可直接被检验，并将危险布局转化为用于更安全具身动作的训练场景。我们的代码和数据可在 https://github.com/INKSIR/Envtrap 获取。

title: CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes
summary: Situated 3D reasoning requires embodied agents to interpret objects, scene geometry, and viewpoint dependent spatial relations. Existing methods learn grounded interactions from supervised traces, but largely imitate prescribed evidence acquisition patterns rather than optimizing the support that the returned evidence provides for the correct answer. Moreover, outcome rewards provide limited credit for intermediate tool choices and may leave infrequent tools underexplored. An effective agent should instead adaptively decide what to ground, which tool to invoke, and how to assess the utility of returned evidence. To this end, this paper presents CARE-3D, a reinforcement post-training framework for adaptive grounded reasoning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on grounding instructions first establishes valid interactions, after which Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) optimizes the agent while keeping the 3D grounding module frozen. CARE-3D combines Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence for evidence sensitive credit assignment, and Group Coverage Sampling to preserve tool coverage. Experiments on MSQA and Beacon3D show consistent gains over SFT and GRPO using only answer and format rewards, especially in spatial reasoning and grounding answer coherence. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/xiaoqian-UQ/CARE-3D}{CARE-3D}.

AI.title_zh: CARE-3D：面向具身三维场景中证据锚定智能体推理的强化学习
AI.abstract_zh: 具身三维推理要求具身智能体理解物体、场景几何以及依赖视角的空间关系。现有方法从监督轨迹中学习锚定交互，但在很大程度上只是模仿预先规定的证据获取模式，而非优化所返回证据为正确答案提供的支撑。此外，结果奖励对中间工具选择的信用分配有限，并可能导致不常用工具探索不足。一个有效的智能体应当自适应地决定对什么进行锚定、调用哪个工具，以及如何评估所返回证据的效用。为此，本文提出 CARE-3D，一个用于自适应锚定推理的强化后训练框架。首先通过基于锚定指令的监督微调（SFT）建立有效交互，随后在保持三维锚定模块冻结的情况下，使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化智能体。CARE-3D 结合了用于证据敏感信用分配的返回证据反事实归因（Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence），以及用于保持工具覆盖的组覆盖采样（Group Coverage Sampling）。在 MSQA 和 Beacon3D 上的实验表明，相较于仅使用答案奖励和格式奖励的 SFT 与 GRPO，本方法取得了持续提升，尤其是在空间推理和锚定答案一致性方面。我们的代码可在 \href{https://github.com/xiaoqian-UQ/CARE-3D}{CARE-3D} 获取。

title: Training-Free Interventions for Hallucination in Large Language Models
summary: A frozen language model can give a wrong answer because a fact is unavailable, a reliable passage is ignored, or an unsupported claim survives generation. We review 116 works on inference-time hallucination intervention and its foundations. We trace the development from retrieval and controllable generation to methods that act on input evidence, token scores, internal representations, completed claims, or the decision to answer. For each family we compare its source of evidence, model access, preparation cost, and the task on which a correction can be established. For activation steering, we distinguish estimating a subspace from applying a state-dependent edit and separate interventions on the prompt from those on the generated prefix. Published comparisons show why faithfulness to a source, factual correctness, informativeness, and answer coverage must be measured separately. Applications in time-sensitive question answering, document synthesis, and visual grounding identify when source authority, evidence availability, or capability preservation limits a reported gain.

AI.title_zh: 面向大语言模型幻觉的无训练干预方法
AI.abstract_zh: 一个冻结的语言模型可能给出错误答案，原因在于某个事实不可获取、可靠的段落被忽略，或者一个缺乏支持的论断在生成过程中得以保留。我们综述了116项关于推理时幻觉干预及其基础的研究工作。我们梳理了从检索与可控生成，到作用于输入证据、词元分数、内部表示、已完成论断或是否作答这一决策的方法的发展脉络。对于每一类方法，我们比较其证据来源、模型访问方式、准备成本，以及可用于确立纠正效果的任务。对于激活引导（activation steering），我们区分估计子空间与应用状态相关编辑，并将作用于提示词的干预与作用于已生成前缀的干预区分开来。已发表的比较表明，为什么必须分别衡量对来源的忠实性、事实正确性、信息量与答案覆盖率。在时效性强的问答、文档生成和视觉 grounding 中的应用，揭示了来源权威性、证据可得性或能力保持何时会限制所报告的增益。

title: World Models and the Law
summary: Current AI may have a model of how we use human language, but this does not translate into a reliable representation of physical reality. World models promise to fill this gap by learning how an environment changes over time and predicting the consequences of an action, and they are already used to steer robots and generate explorable worlds. This article asks how AI regulation in three major legal contexts, the European Union, California, and China, copes with the distinctive challenges they raise. I propose a definition and a taxonomy of world models based on who or what acts on their predictions, and identify the risks of misplaced reliance on them. I argue that existing rules tend to cover world models but leave three questions open, i.e., action provenance, trajectory validity, and the weight of simulated evidence, and recommend ways to fill these gaps.

AI.title_zh: 世界模型与法律
AI.abstract_zh: 当前的人工智能或许拥有一个关于我们如何使用人类语言的模型，但这并不能转化为对物理现实的可靠表征。世界模型（world models）有望通过学习环境如何随时间变化并预测某一行动的后果来填补这一空白，它们已被用于操控机器人和生成可探索的世界。本文探讨欧盟、加利福尼亚和中国这三大法律语境下的人工智能监管如何应对世界模型所带来的独特挑战。我基于由谁或什么依据其预测采取行动，提出了世界模型的定义与分类体系，并识别出对其产生错位依赖的风险。我认为现有规则往往覆盖了世界模型，但留下了三个悬而未决的问题，即行动来源（action provenance）、轨迹有效性（trajectory validity）以及模拟证据的权重，并就如何填补这些空白提出了建议。

title: World Models Are the Right Foundation for Simulating Mars Terraforming
summary: Terraforming Mars is a long-horizon, action-conditioned control problem that requires predicting atmospheric responses to interventions over centuries to identify effective policies. This position paper argues that physics-regularized recurrent state-space world models are the most promising foundation for this setting. Data-driven climate emulators lack action-conditioning, and physics-based general circulation models (GCMs) are too expensive for policy search. Among learned world models, recurrent state-space architectures with physics constraints are better suited than transformer-based alternatives: they provide native uncertainty quantification through their stochastic-deterministic decomposition, remain stable under sparse non-terrestrial training data, and enforce physical consistency at each rollout step. To make this position concrete, we describe a potential architecture combining JEPA-inspired latent encoding, universal differential equation constraints, and a Dreamer-lineage planning head. We also introduce MarsWorld, an open benchmark proposal for intervention-conditioned planetary world models, and discuss broader implications and objections.

AI.title_zh: 世界模型是模拟火星地球化的正确基础
AI.abstract_zh: 火星地球化是一个长时程、以动作为条件的控制问题，需要预测大气在数百年尺度上对干预措施的响应，以识别有效的策略。本立场论文主张，物理正则化的循环状态空间世界模型是这一问题设定中最有希望的基础。数据驱动的气候模拟器缺乏动作条件化，而基于物理的大气环流模型（GCMs）对于策略搜索而言过于昂贵。在学习型世界模型中，带有物理约束的循环状态空间架构比基于 Transformer 的替代方案更为合适：它们通过其随机-确定性分解提供原生的不确定性量化，在稀疏的非地球训练数据下保持稳定，并在每个 rollout 步骤上强制物理一致性。为使这一立场具体化，我们描述了一种潜在的架构，结合受 JEPA 启发的隐空间编码、通用微分方程约束，以及 Dreamer 谱系的规划头。我们还提出了 MarsWorld——一个面向以干预为条件的行星世界模型的开放基准提案，并讨论了更广泛的影响与反对意见。

title: Dynamics Forcing: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Causal Video World Models
summary: Causal video world models generate block by block from their own previous outputs. Small errors in early blocks are fed back as history and grow until the scene and the robot fall apart. Teacher forcing trains on clean ground-truth history, so the model never sees the history it will actually condition on, and it also finds a shortcut: copying the previous frame instead of predicting how the scene changes. We present Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme that keeps real video as the only supervision and reshapes how history is presented. History is perturbed in three ways: random noising, self-resampling by the model itself, and joint denoising, in which the most recent blocks are still partly noisy when the next block is predicted. On top of this we move history guidance and first-frame anchor guidance from inference into training, so that the model is pushed to use its history and its reference frame rather than ignore them. Dynamics Forcing needs no teacher model, no distillation, and no additional model at inference. Applied to a 5B video model with LoRA on 77 hours of manipulation video on a single GPU, it better matches unseen real continuations and reduces error accumulation.

AI.title_zh: 动力学强制：缓解因果视频世界模型中的误差累积
AI.abstract_zh: 因果视频世界模型基于自身先前的输出逐块生成。早期块中的微小误差会作为历史被反馈回去并不断增大，直到场景和机器人崩溃瓦解。教师强制（teacher forcing）使用干净的真值历史进行训练，因此模型从未见过它实际将要作为条件的历史，而且它还会找到一条捷径：复制上一帧，而不是预测场景如何变化。我们提出动力学强制（Dynamics Forcing），这是一种以真实视频作为唯一监督信号、并重塑历史呈现方式的训练方案。历史以三种方式被扰动：随机加噪、由模型自身进行自重采样，以及联合去噪——在预测下一个块时，最近的若干块仍部分带有噪声。在此之上，我们将历史引导和首帧锚点引导从推理阶段移入训练阶段，从而促使模型使用其历史和参考帧，而不是忽略它们。动力学强制不需要教师模型、不需要蒸馏，推理时也不需要额外的模型。将其应用于一个 5B 视频模型，在单块 GPU 上对 77 小时的机器人操作视频使用 LoRA，它能更好地匹配未见过的真实后续片段，并减少误差累积。

title: What Should World Models Plan Over? Learning Geometry-Aligned Representations of Body Motion
summary: We introduce MotionPort, which learns low-dimensional latent representations of body motion for accurate dynamics prediction and effective long-horizon planning. Existing world-model planners often search over action representations learned for prediction, yet we show that predictive accuracy alone does not ensure that optimization can discover successful trajectories. MotionPort addresses this mismatch by representing body trajectories rather than action chunks and organizing the search space by motion similarity, helping predicted improvements translate into successful execution. Without fine-tuning state encoders, MotionPort raises average goal-reaching success from 37.9% to 87.8% across three backbones and seven settings in four domains. On the evaluated AntMaze-OGBench tasks, it achieves 72% success, compared with 4% for the strongest baseline.

AI.title_zh: 世界模型应在什么之上进行规划？学习几何对齐的身体运动表示
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 MotionPort，它学习身体运动的低维潜在表示，以实现准确的动力学预测和有效的长时程规划。现有的世界模型规划器常常在为预测而学习的动作表示上进行搜索，但我们表明，仅有预测准确性并不能保证优化过程能够发现成功的轨迹。MotionPort 通过表示身体轨迹而非动作块（action chunks），并按运动相似性组织搜索空间，从而解决这一不匹配问题，帮助预测出的改进转化为成功的执行。在不对状态编码器进行微调的情况下，MotionPort 在四个领域的七个设置、三种骨干网络上，将平均目标达成成功率从 37.9% 提升至 87.8%。在所评估的 AntMaze-OGBench 任务上，它达到了 72% 的成功率，而最强基线仅为 4%。

title: CarlHOI: Counterfactual Predictive Imagination for Generalizable Multi-Humanoid Object Interaction under Constrained Environments
summary: Recent advances in physics-based humanoid control enable teams of varying sizes to coordinate their movements and cooperatively transport shared objects. However, adapting learned cooperative behaviors to unseen environmental constraints remains challenging, particularly when obstacles require coordinated detours and changes in team configuration.
