However, existing datasets mainly rely on converting or captioning pre-existing 3D assets, consisting mostly of single-turn code data for static single objects and struggling to scale task diversity and scene complexity, leaving such training data scarce. We present 3DCodeFactory, an automated framework that directly constructs diverse, complex 3D training data from abundant raw text (e.g., diffusion prompts and product descriptions). The framework first leverages an image generator to synthesize 3D reference images from raw text as visual anchors, guiding the generation of concrete modeling specifications and interactive functional requirements; meanwhile, it jointly constructs visual, specification, and functional rubrics from the reference images and requirements to automatically score and filter multi-turn agent rollouts. Based on this framework, we release 3DCodeFactory-Data, comprising 5,045 high-quality task instances and multi-turn interaction trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B on 3DCodeFactory-Data significantly improves performance on BlenderWorld, P3D-Bench, and 3DCodeBench, consistently outperforming models trained on existing open-source 3D code datasets, with our 27B model further surpassing the same-series 2.4T flagship Qwen3.8-Max in overall performance.

AI.title_zh: 3DCodeFactory：为3D代码智能体扩展训练数据
AI.abstract_zh: 随着代码智能体的演进，其范围正从生成简单的静态3D网格扩展到构建结构完整、复杂的交互式3D场景。然而，现有数据集主要依赖对已有3D资产的转换或描述生成（captioning），其中的数据大多为面向静态单一对象的单轮代码数据，难以扩展任务多样性和场景复杂性，导致此类训练数据十分稀缺。我们提出3DCodeFactory，一个自动化框架，可直接从丰富的原始文本（例如扩散提示词和产品描述）构建多样、复杂的3D训练数据。该框架首先利用图像生成器从原始文本合成3D参考图像作为视觉锚点，引导生成具体的建模规格与交互功能需求；同时，它从参考图像与需求出发，联合构建视觉、规格和功能评分准则（rubrics），用以自动评分并筛选多轮智能体rollout。基于该框架，我们发布3DCodeFactory-Data，包含5,045个高质量任务实例及多轮交互轨迹。在3DCodeFactory-Data上微调Qwen3.5-9B与Qwen3.8-27B，可显著提升其在BlenderWorld、P3D-Bench和3DCodeBench上的性能，持续优于在现有开源3D代码数据集上训练的模型；我们的27B模型在整体性能上进一步超过了同系列的2.4T旗舰模型Qwen3.8-Max。

title: Imagine Smarter, Drive Faster: Efficient World Modeling for Decision-Aware Autonomous Driving
comment: 23 pages total, 8 pages main text (4 figures, 8 tables), 12 pages supplementary material (9 figures, 5 tables)
summary: World models hold great promise for autonomous driving planning, yet their ability to imagine the future often comes at a formidable computational cost. Efficiency efforts, such as knowledge distillation and domain-specific pre-training, often shift this burden to costly teachers or training pipelines, leaving lightweight world modeling an open challenge. We introduce FastWorld, a natively lightweight world-model framework for efficient autonomous driving planning. FastWorld reduces computation through compact scene representations, short-horizon action-conditioned prediction, and selective candidate verification and score refinement. These designs support efficient future-informed planning without teacher distillation or additional domain-specific pre-training. On NAVSIMv1, FastWorld achieves 92.2 PDMS at 132 FPS on a single 4090 GPU. It also achieves 89.4 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2 and an average L2 of 0.40 over 3 seconds at 17 FPS on nuScenes. Code and models can be found at https://github.com/MoyangSensei/FastWorld.

AI.title_zh: 更聪明地想象，更快速地驾驶：面向决策感知自动驾驶的高效世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型在自动驾驶规划中展现出巨大前景，然而其想象未来的能力往往伴随着高昂的计算成本。诸如知识蒸馏和领域特定预训练等效率优化工作，常常将这一负担转移给昂贵的教师模型或训练流程，使得轻量级世界建模仍是一个未解决的挑战。我们提出 FastWorld，一个原生轻量级的世界模型框架，用于高效的自动驾驶规划。FastWorld 通过紧凑的场景表示、短时域动作条件预测，以及选择性的候选验证与分数精炼来降低计算量。这些设计无需教师蒸馏或额外的领域特定预训练，即可支持高效的未来信息引导规划。在 NAVSIMv1 上，FastWorld 在单块 4090 GPU 上以 132 FPS 达到 92.2 PDMS。它还在 NAVSIMv2 上达到 89.4 EPDMS，并在 nuScenes 上以 17 FPS 取得 3 秒内平均 L2 为 0.40 的结果。代码与模型见 https://github.com/MoyangSensei/FastWorld。

title: Frozen by the Mean: Early Temporal Guidance Unfreezes Motion in Video Diffusion Models
summary: Video diffusion models can render convincing frames while failing to produce the requested action. Increasing classifier-free guidance (CFG) can strengthen motion, but also saturates and shifts colors. Scalar CFG assigns the same coefficient to the averaged and frame-varying components of its prediction difference, limiting independent control of temporal variation. THAW, Temporal Harmonic Amplification during Warm-up, retains stock CFG and adds a separately weighted residual during an initial denoising window. Its dose specifies the added norm relative to the current CFG difference, giving the extra guidance a consistent relative budget across sampling steps. THAW is training-free and reuses CFG's two model predictions with an unchanged network evaluation count. It improves cost-matched motion over scalar and scheduled CFG on five video models, with positive point estimates against existing guidance methods on three of them. On VBench, THAW raises dynamic degree by about 14 to 15 points over stock CFG while increasing total scores on a different set of three models.

AI.title_zh: 被均值冻结：早期时序引导解除视频扩散模型中的运动冻结
AI.abstract_zh: 视频扩散模型能够渲染出令人信服的帧，却无法生成所要求的动作。提高无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance, CFG）可以增强运动，但也会出现饱和并导致颜色偏移。标量 CFG 对其预测差值的均值分量与帧变化分量赋予相同系数，限制了对时间变化的独立控制。THAW（Temporal Harmonic Amplification during Warm-up，预热期间的时序谐波放大）保留原有的 CFG，并在初始去噪窗口内加入一个单独加权的残差。其剂量规定了相对于当前 CFG 差值的附加范数，从而使额外引导在各采样步骤上具有一致的相对预算。THAW 无需训练，复用 CFG 的两次模型预测，且网络评估次数保持不变。在五个视频模型上，它相较于标量 CFG 和调度式 CFG 提升了成本匹配的运动，并在其中三个模型上相较于现有引导方法取得了正向的点估计。在 VBench 上，THAW 相较于原有 CFG 将动态程度（dynamic degree）提高约 14 至 15 个点，同时在另一组三个模型上提高了总分。

title: PSC-Gen: Physical Sequence Conditioning for Video Generation via Agentic Visual Planning
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion models have enabled the synthesis of high-fidelity, visually compelling videos. However, despite being trained on internet-scale video data, understanding underlying physical laws and generating physically plausible dynamics remain challenging. To mitigate this, conditioning video generators on explicit physical reasoning has emerged as a promising direction. Nevertheless, existing conditioning approaches often fail to incorporate detailed physical guidance into generation, resulting in physically implausible motion or visual artifacts. We propose PSC-Gen, a training-free framework that employs an agentic approach to synthesize visual conditions and inject their core dynamics via low-frequency filtering. By iteratively planning physical states and verifying generated keyframes, our Physics Agent constructs visually and physically consistent keyframe sequences. We then interpolate these keyframes into a continuous physical sequence and inject only its low-frequency components, steering the video model to preserve physical dynamics while synthesizing fine visual details. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations across physics-informed and robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that PSC-Gen faithfully follows instructions and generates physically plausible videos.

AI.title_zh: PSC-Gen：通过智能体视觉规划为视频生成引入物理序列条件
AI.abstract_zh: 近期视频扩散模型的进展使得合成高保真、视觉上引人入胜的视频成为可能。然而，尽管这些模型在互联网规模的视频数据上进行训练，理解底层物理规律并生成物理上合理的动力学仍然具有挑战性。为缓解这一问题，以显式物理推理作为视频生成器的条件已成为一个有前景的方向。然而，现有的条件化方法往往无法将细致的物理引导融入生成过程，导致运动在物理上不合理或出现视觉伪影。我们提出 PSC-Gen，这是一个无需训练的（training-free）框架，采用智能体（agentic）方法合成视觉条件，并通过低频滤波注入其核心动力学。通过迭代地规划物理状态并验证生成的关键帧，我们的 Physics Agent 构建出在视觉与物理上一致的关键帧序列。随后，我们将这些关键帧插值为连续的物理序列，并仅注入其低频分量，从而引导视频模型在合成精细视觉细节的同时保持物理动力学。在物理相关与机器人操作基准上的定性与定量评估表明，PSC-Gen 能够忠实地遵循指令并生成物理上合理的视频。

title: Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates. In robotic manipulation, a human video provides the context that specifies how a task should be performed. However, scaling human-video ICL on world-action models (WAMs) faces two challenges: task-level human-robot pairs are not temporally aligned with robot actions, and standard action losses allow policies to rely on initial-scene or task-identity shortcuts rather than tracking the context. We present Entangle, an in-context world-action model that maps a single human video and current robot observations to future visual states and executable actions. To scale temporally aligned training data, we convert recorded robot videos into matched human contexts via video-to-video generation, supplemented by real paired recordings. For model training, we combine variable-length video windows with an intra-task contrastive objective that distinguishes the paired action trajectory from other executions of the same task, preventing task-identity shortcuts. Without task-specific fine-tuning, Entangle improves steadily as aligned training data scales, reaching an average score of 83.5/100 across six unseen tasks on an Astribot S1 robot, and achieves a 69.5% average success rate on seven unseen RoboTwin tasks, outperforming Zero-WAM by 22.6 percentage points. Under Context-OOD, although trained only on scene-aligned pairs, Entangle transfers context-specified behaviors across rearranged layouts and substituted tools.

AI.title_zh: Entangle：将人类视频上下文世界-动作模型扩展到未见任务与上下文
AI.abstract_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）使基础模型无需参数更新即可根据上下文执行未见任务。在机器人操作中，人类视频提供了指定任务应如何执行的上下文。然而，在世界-动作模型（WAMs）上扩展人类视频ICL面临两个挑战：任务级的人类-机器人配对在时间上与机器人动作不对齐，且标准动作损失使策略依赖于初始场景或任务身份的捷径，而非跟踪上下文。我们提出Entangle，一种上下文世界-动作模型，它将单个人类视频和当前机器人观测映射到未来视觉状态和可执行动作。为扩展时间对齐的训练数据，我们通过视频到视频生成将录制的机器人视频转换为匹配的人类上下文，并以真实配对录制作为补充。在模型训练方面，我们将变长视频窗口与任务内对比目标相结合，该目标将配对的动作轨迹与同一任务的其他执行区分开来，从而防止任务身份捷径。无需任务特定的微调，Entangle随对齐训练数据规模的扩大而稳步提升，在Astribot S1机器人上的六个未见任务上达到83.5/100的平均得分，并在七个未见RoboTwin任务上取得69.5%的平均成功率，比Zero-WAM高出22.6个百分点。在Context-OOD下，尽管仅在场景对齐的配对上训练，Entangle仍能将上下文指定的行为迁移到重排布局和替换工具上。

title: AERIN: Aerial Instance Navigation with a Visual World Model
summary: Searching from high altitude and navigating to a target instance specified by a reference image is a common application for UAVs. In such tasks, high-altitude observations provide broad ground coverage for efficient search, but targets occupy fewer pixels, making instance verification and action selection more difficult. We present AERIN, a visual world model that uses action-conditioned prediction to guide the UAV toward the target while adjusting its viewpoint to obtain higherquality observations for subsequent instance verification. Highaltitude navigation requires fine-grained target details and scene context relevant to visibility, but repeatedly predicting dense visual representations of this information is computationally expensive. AERIN addresses this challenge with a compact, fixedsize, target-conditioned latent state that separately represents both for efficient action evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that AERIN outperforms the evaluated baselines in target approach and observation quality, while requiring substantially less decision time than similar world models.

AI.title_zh: AERIN：基于视觉世界模型的空中实例导航
AI.abstract_zh: 从高空搜索并导航至由参考图像指定的目标实例是无人机的一项常见应用。在此类任务中，高空观测能提供广阔的地面覆盖范围以实现高效搜索，但目标所占像素较少，使得实例验证与动作选择更加困难。我们提出 AERIN，一个视觉世界模型，它利用动作条件预测引导无人机飞向目标，同时调整其视角以获得更高质量的观测，用于后续的实例验证。高空导航需要细粒度的目标细节以及与可见性相关的场景上下文，但反复预测这些信息的稠密视觉表示在计算上代价高昂。AERIN 通过一个紧凑的、固定大小的、以目标为条件的潜在状态来应对这一挑战，该状态分别表示这两类信息，以实现高效的动作评估。实验表明，AERIN 在目标接近与观测质量方面优于所评估的基线方法，同时所需的决策时间显著少于类似的世界模型。

title: ReCoRain: Reliability-Coupled Content and Noise Conditioning for Event-Guided Video Deraining
summary: Event-guided video deraining depends on reliable cross-frame correspondences, yet events generated by scene motion, rain, and sensor noise can provide ambiguous matching evidence. In diffusion-based restoration, an incorrect match can transfer unrelated content and correlate initial noise between unrelated scene locations. We propose ReCoRain, an event-guided residual video diffusion framework that couples temporal content transfer and noise correlation through a common assessment of correspondence reliability. This assessment combines RGB appearance, interval-event evidence, and forward-backward motion consistency. The content path aggregates neighboring features according to alignment reliability, while the noise path uses composed backward motion fields and their associated reliability estimates to regulate initial-noise sharing across the latent sequence. We use the same conditional noise construction during residual flow-matching training and inference, incorporating temporal noise coordination into the learned restoration process. Temporal supervision matches motion-compensated inter-frame differences in restored and clean videos under the same teacher-estimated flow and visibility mask, accommodating legitimate appearance changes. ReCoRain achieves 32.09 dB PSNR on NTURain-Syn and 28.73 dB on RainSynLight25. Enabling reliability gates in both paths reduces warping error by 33.0% relative to disabling both gates.

AI.title_zh: ReCoRain：面向事件引导视频去雨的可靠性耦合内容与噪声条件化
AI.abstract_zh: 事件引导的视频去雨依赖于可靠的跨帧对应关系，然而由场景运动、雨和传感器噪声所生成的事件可能提供模糊的匹配证据。在基于扩散的复原中，错误的匹配会传递无关内容，并在无关的场景位置之间关联初始噪声。我们提出 ReCoRain，一种事件引导的残差视频扩散框架，它通过对对应关系可靠性的共同评估，将时间内容传递与噪声关联耦合起来。该评估综合了 RGB 外观、区间事件证据以及前向—后向运动一致性。内容路径依据对齐可靠性对相邻特征进行聚合，而噪声路径则使用复合的后向运动场及其相应的可靠性估计，来调节隐变量序列中初始噪声的共享。我们在残差流匹配训练和推理过程中使用相同的条件噪声构造，从而将时间噪声协调纳入所学习的复原过程。时间监督在相同的教师估计光流与可见性掩码下，匹配复原视频与干净视频中经运动补偿的帧间差异，从而容许合理的外观变化。ReCoRain 在 NTURain-Syn 上达到 32.09 dB PSNR，在 RainSynLight25 上达到 28.73 dB。与同时禁用两个门控相比，在两条路径中启用可靠性门控可将扭曲误差降低 33.0%。

title: CoopOcc: Cooperative 3D Semantic Occupancy Perception via Multi-Agent and Cross-Modal Fusion
summary: Semantic occupancy perception has emerged as a promising paradigm for jointly modeling 3D scene geometry and semantic information. However, this unified representation cannot compensate for missing information caused by occlusion and sensor coverage. Multi-agent cooperation alleviates this limitation, but information from different agents is not equally useful across spatial regions. Meanwhile, feature representations from each agent form the basis of reliable multi-agent fusion. Cross?modal fusion constructs such representations by integrating complementary semantic and geometric information. Despite this complementarity, jointly establishing reliable 3D correspondence across agents and preserving modality-specific structures remains challenging. To address these limitations, we propose CoopOcc, which performs cooperative 3D semantic occupancy perception through multi-agent and cross-modal fusion. CoopOcc uses ego?query cross-agent attention (EQCA) to selectively aggregate aligned features across agents, and anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction (ABFI) for cross-modal exchange at matched coordinates. We further construct SemanticVVSim, a simulation dataset, and establish a unified benchmark. For simulation-to-real transfer, we propose confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation (CHORD). CoopOcc performs best overall among ten evaluated methods on SemanticVVSim. On Occ3D-nuScenes, CHORD improves performance using knowledge from SemanticVVSim. The code is available at https://github.com/LOTEAT/CoopOcc.

AI.title_zh: CoopOcc：通过多智能体与跨模态融合的协同3D语义占据感知
AI.abstract_zh: 语义占据感知已成为一种有前景的范式，用于联合建模3D场景几何与语义信息。然而，这种统一表示无法弥补由遮挡和传感器覆盖范围造成的信息缺失。多智能体协作缓解了这一局限，但来自不同智能体的信息在不同空间区域中的有用程度并不相同。同时，每个智能体的特征表示构成了可靠多智能体融合的基础。跨模态融合通过整合互补的语义与几何信息来构建此类表示。尽管存在这种互补性，在多个智能体之间联合建立可靠的3D对应关系并保持各模态特有的结构仍然具有挑战性。为解决上述局限，我们提出CoopOcc，它通过多智能体与跨模态融合执行协同3D语义占据感知。CoopOcc使用自车查询跨智能体注意力（ego-query cross-agent attention, EQCA）在多个智能体之间选择性地聚合对齐后的特征，并使用基于锚点的双向特征交互（anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction, ABFI）在匹配坐标处进行跨模态交换。我们进一步构建了仿真数据集SemanticVVSim，并建立了统一基准。针对仿真到真实的迁移，我们提出置信度感知的分层占据与关系蒸馏（confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation, CHORD）。在SemanticVVSim上，CoopOcc在十种被评估方法中总体表现最佳。在Occ3D-nuScenes上，CHORD利用来自SemanticVVSim的知识提升了性能。代码可在 https://github.com/LOTEAT/CoopOcc 获取。

title: ViewAgent3D: A Training-Free Multi-View Pipeline for 3D Scene Understanding
summary: 3D scene understanding tasks are often approached by building explicit 3D scene representations or by training specialized multi-modal models over point clouds, voxels, or scene graphs. We take a complementary view: for many queries, the main bottleneck is not the absence of a stronger 3D representation but the selection of a small subset of multi-view RGB views that actually makes the query answerable. We present a training-free, query-conditioned multi-view pipeline that performs diverse tasks using only 2D images and a set of tools used purely for inference. Our method first decomposes each query into a set of concepts that identify unique attributes that assist with reasoning. This drives a coarse-to-fine evidence selection process: a coarse retrieval selects and scores all views, a diversity-aware selector reduces redundancy, and a reranking stage helps shortlist views by target visibility or answerability. The resulting evidence is optionally grounded for queries that benefit from explicit localization, and a self-verification step helps refine the final response, especially for open-ended cases. Despite using no task-specific training and no explicit 3D representations at inference time, our approach provides approximately 10% gain on 3D VQA and 5% gain on dense captioning and Embodied QA while being applicable across different scenarios. We further propose a unique judge-based evaluation system, motivating a judge who takes into account many semantically correct or partially correct answers, thereby improving holistic scene understanding.

AI.title_zh: ViewAgent3D：一种无需训练的多视图三维场景理解流水线
AI.abstract_zh: 三维场景理解任务通常通过构建显式的三维场景表示，或在点云、体素或场景图上训练专门的多模态模型来实现。我们采取一种互补的视角：对于许多查询而言，主要的瓶颈并非缺少更强的三维表示，而在于选取一小部分真正能使该查询可被回答的多视图 RGB 视图。我们提出一种无需训练、以查询为条件的多视图流水线，仅使用二维图像和一组纯粹用于推理的工具来完成多种多样的任务。我们的方法首先将每个查询分解为一组概念，这些概念识别出有助于推理的独特属性。这驱动了一个由粗到细的证据选择过程：粗检索对所有视图进行选择与打分，多样性感知选择器降低冗余，重排序阶段则依据目标可见性或可回答性帮助筛选出候选视图。对于能够从显式定位中获益的查询，所得证据会被可选地进行接地（grounding），而一个自验证步骤有助于精炼最终回答，尤其针对开放式情形。尽管没有使用任何任务特定的训练，且推理时没有使用显式的三维表示，我们的方法在 3D VQA 上取得约 10% 的提升，在密集描述（dense captioning）和具身问答（Embodied QA）上取得 5% 的提升，同时可适用于不同场景。我们进一步提出一种独特的基于评判者（judge）的评估体系，推动评判者将许多语义正确或部分正确的答案纳入考量，从而改进整体场景理解。

title: RecallWorld: Episodic Memory for Persistent Embodied Video World Models
summary: Video world models generate plausible novel views but often lack persistent memory, failing to preserve a place's geometry and appearance when an agent revisits a scene. A central challenge is how previous views should be effectively used for creating memory. Reconstructing them independently underutilizes geometric constraints between nearby views, while repeatedly reconstructing a growing history can propagate later prediction errors into earlier geometry. We introduce RecallWorld, a persistent embodied video world model that jointly reconstructs short multi-view episodes into Scenelets while keeping geometry independent across episodes. Starting from a single source image, camera-aware ray lifting places perspective and native fisheye images in a common world frame, retaining wide-field content for perspective generation. Each generated segment extends the Scenelet memory and conditions subsequent generation. Coverage-based retrieval selects complementary Scenelets from the full history, while target-view visibility is resolved geometrically before appearance fusion, providing consistent memory conditioning for guiding subsequent generation. Across four datasets, RecallWorld improves revisit PSNR over the strongest evaluated baseline by 2.6 dB on partial revisits and 3.9 dB on full cycles, demonstrating substantially stronger preservation of scene identity across exploration and return.

AI.title_zh: RecallWorld：面向持久化具身视频世界模型的情景记忆
AI.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型能够生成合理的新视角，但往往缺乏持久记忆，当智能体重访某一场景时无法保持该地点的几何结构与外观。一个核心挑战在于如何有效地利用先前的视角来构建记忆。独立地重建这些视角会未充分利用相邻视角之间的几何约束，而反复重建不断增长的历史则可能将后期的预测误差传播到较早的几何结构中。我们提出 RecallWorld，一种持久化具身视频世界模型，它将短多视角片段联合重建为 Scenelets（场景片元），同时在各片段之间保持几何独立。从单张源图像出发，相机感知的射线提升（camera-aware ray lifting）将透视图像和原生鱼眼图像置于共同的世界坐标系中，从而为透视生成保留宽视场内容。每个生成的片段扩展 Scenelet 记忆并对后续生成进行条件化。基于覆盖度的检索从完整历史中选出互补的 Scenelets，而目标视角的可见性在表观融合之前被几何化地解析，从而为引导后续生成提供一致的记忆条件。在四个数据集上，RecallWorld 的重访 PSNR 相较表现最强的评估基线在部分重访上提升 2.6 dB，在完整环路上提升 3.9 dB，表明其在探索与返回过程中对场景身份保持的能力显著更强。

title: Persuasion from Within: Model-Based Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Debate and Consensus
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems for collective decision-making, such as multi-agent debate and consensus games, in which agents exchange messages and update their answers over multiple rounds and a resolution mechanism aggregates them into a final outcome. Most multi-agent LLM frameworks assume that every participant shares the system objective. In practice, however, a malicious agent can join as a legitimate member of the group and persuade the other agents toward a hidden adversarial goal. We formalize such attacks as a sequential decision-making problem in which the insider seeks to degrade the utility of the collective outcome. We propose a model-based insider attack that learns to persuade a group of agents: the insider first learns a world model of the benign agents from offline trajectories and then uses it both to train a persuasion policy and to plan its messages. In two case studies involving a numerical consensus game and a multi-agent debate, the learned insider is the most effective and the stealthiest attack we evaluate, outperforming both prompt-based and trained LLM persuaders from prior work. The attack also transfers to other target models, larger groups, and unseen datasets, and remains effective under existing Byzantine-resilience defenses. The learned insider also enables a new defense: adversarially training benign agents on the attack data largely removes both our attack and the strongest prior persuasion attack. These results show that combining world models with reinforcement learning and planning is an effective route to both attacking and hardening language-based multi-agent systems.

AI.title_zh: 从内部进行说服：多智能体 LLM 辩论与共识中基于模型的内部攻击
AI.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被部署于多智能体系统以进行集体决策，例如多智能体辩论与共识博弈，其中智能体在多轮中交换消息并更新各自的答案，再由某种裁决机制将其聚合为最终结果。大多数多智能体 LLM 框架都假设每位参与者都共享系统目标。然而在实践中，恶意智能体可以作为群体的合法成员加入，并说服其他智能体转向某个隐藏的对抗性目标。我们将此类攻击形式化为一个序贯决策问题，其中内部攻击者力图降低集体结果的效用。我们提出一种基于模型的内部攻击，它学会说服一组智能体：内部攻击者首先从离线轨迹中学习良性智能体的世界模型，然后同时用它来训练说服策略并规划其消息。在两个案例研究（一个数值共识博弈和一个多智能体辩论）中，所学习的内部攻击者是我们评估的最有效且最隐蔽的攻击，优于先前工作中基于提示的和经训练的 LLM 说服者。该攻击还可迁移到其他目标模型、更大的群体以及未见数据集，并且在现有的拜占庭容错（Byzantine-resilience）防御下仍然有效。所学习的内部攻击者还促成了一种新防御：在攻击数据上对良性智能体进行对抗训练，基本可以同时消除我们的攻击和最强大的先前说服攻击。这些结果表明，将世界模型与强化学习和规划相结合，是攻击和加固基于语言的多智能体系统的一条有效途径。

title: Dual-Stream Event-to-Video Reconstruction
summary: Event cameras capture brightness changes with high temporal resolution and dynamic range, but converting event streams into videos remains fundamentally ill-posed due to the lack of absolute intensity information. Resolving this ambiguity calls for a brightness reference that complements the intensity changes recorded by events. Inspired by the complementary spatial and temporal processing of the parvocellular and magnocellular pathways in human vision, we propose EvDualDiff, a dual-stream framework that combines a brightness reference from temporal-mapping events with motion-event cues for video reconstruction. Conditioned on both streams, our video diffusion model autoregressively reconstructs long sequences from a single temporal map. Photometric constraints and finetuning on self-generated rollouts reduce accumulated drift. At the hardware level, our approach requires only a minimal light-modulation mechanism on the lens of an event camera. We build this setup and collect a dataset comprising temporal-mapping events, motion events and synchronised ground-truth RGB frames. Experiments on a public benchmark and on our collected EvDual dataset demonstrate that EvDualDiff outperforms existing event-to-video reconstruction methods in fidelity, perceptual quality and video-level realism. The code and dataset will be released.

AI.title_zh: 双流事件到视频重建
AI.abstract_zh: 事件相机以高时间分辨率和动态范围捕捉亮度变化，但由于缺乏绝对强度信息，将事件流转换为视频在本质上仍是病态问题。解决这一歧义需要一种亮度参考，以补充事件所记录的强度变化。受人类视觉中小细胞通路（parvocellular pathway）与大细胞通路（magnocellular pathway）在空间与时间处理上的互补性启发，我们提出 EvDualDiff，一个双流框架，将来自时间映射事件（temporal-mapping events）的亮度参考与运动事件线索相结合，用于视频重建。以两路流为条件，我们的视频扩散模型从单一时间映射（temporal map）自回归地重建长序列。光度约束（photometric constraints）以及在自生成 rollout 上的微调减少了累积漂移。在硬件层面，我们的方法仅需在事件相机镜头上加装一个极简的光调制机制。我们搭建了该装置并采集了一个数据集，包含时间映射事件、运动事件以及同步的真值 RGB 帧。在公开基准以及我们采集的 EvDual 数据集上的实验表明，EvDualDiff 在保真度、感知质量和视频级真实感方面优于现有的事件到视频重建方法。代码和数据集将发布。

title: S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) in average accuracy. Moreover, the same probes confirm that it acquires both capabilities, reaching fusion and transformation accuracies of 65.11% and 82.17%, against at most 16.02% and 37.28% for the baselines. At inference, S-Mind also runs about 100x faster than a tool-based agent on the same backbone. Instilled through these spatial tokens during training, spatial capability becomes intrinsic to the backbone and persists even when the tokens are withheld, offering a promising path toward spatial intelligence in MLLMs.

AI.title_zh: S-Mind：内化多视图几何以实现空间智能
AI.abstract_zh: 空间智能，即从视觉观测中对三维空间进行推理的能力，随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）进入物理世界而变得至关重要。除了感知每一个视图之外，它还依赖于人类认知的两大基石：将多个视图融合为一个连贯的三维场景，以及在推理展开过程中在头脑中将该场景变换到新的视点。然而，我们的空间探测表明，MLLMs 在很大程度上缺乏这两种能力，即使经过空间微调之后也是如此。因此，我们提出了 S-Mind，它通过一组紧凑的空间 token 在 MLLM 内部内化多视图几何。它监督这些 token 以承载融合后的三维场景，并重新输出它们，以从推理所采用的每一个视点重新表达该场景。在四个空间基准上，S-Mind 使其 Qwen3.5 主干模型的性能提升最多达 22.26 个点，并在平均准确率上超过了 GPT-6-Astra（+0.45）、Kimi-K3.1-Pro（+1.97）和 GLM-5.3-Flash（+7.80）等前沿通用模型。此外，同样的探测确认它获得了这两种能力，融合准确率和变换准确率分别达到 65.11% 和 82.17%，而基线最高仅为 16.02% 和 37.28%。在推理时，S-Mind 在相同主干模型上的运行速度也比基于工具的智能体快约 100 倍。通过在训练中经由这些空间 token 注入，空间能力成为主干模型内在的能力，并且即使在扣留这些 token 时也能保持，这为 MLLMs 通向空间智能提供了一条有前景的路径。

title: SemGuard: Semantics-Decoupled Watermarking for Gaussian Splatting
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (under review)
summary: Gaussian Splatting provides an efficient representation for high-fidelity rendering of static and dynamic 3D scenes, motivating the copyright protection of Gaussian assets. In CLIP-guided Gaussian watermarking, a universal message decoder pretrained on textual watermark representations is subsequently applied to visual features containing both watermark information and scene-dependent semantics. However, text-only pretraining does not explicitly account for the semantic interference encountered during watermark extraction. To address this challenge, we propose SemGuard, a simple yet effective semantics-decoupled watermarking framework that learns to suppress scene-dependent semantic interference during universal message decoder pretraining. Specifically, SemGuard combines message-related CLIP text features with message-independent visual features extracted from unwatermarked scene images, constructing training representations with controllable semantic interference relevant to the target Gaussian assets. A progressive semantic interference curriculum gradually increases the contribution of visual features, allowing the decoder to first learn reliable message representations and then adapt to increasingly strong scene-dependent semantic interference. After pretraining for a given message length and semantic image pool, the decoder is frozen and reused across multiple Gaussian assets whose visual semantics are covered by the pretraining data. Experiments on static and dynamic Gaussian Splatting assets demonstrate improved rendering fidelity alongside reliable watermark extraction, while evaluations on static assets further show enhanced robustness against image-space distortions.

AI.title_zh: SemGuard：面向高斯喷射的语义解耦水印
AI.abstract_zh: 高斯喷射（Gaussian Splatting）为静态与动态 3D 场景的高保真渲染提供了一种高效表示，这推动了高斯资产版权保护的需求。在 CLIP 引导的高斯水印中，一个在文本水印表示上预训练的通用消息解码器随后被应用于同时包含水印信息和场景相关语义的视觉特征。然而，仅在文本上预训练并未显式考虑水印提取过程中遇到的语义干扰。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 SemGuard，一个简单而有效的语义解耦水印框架，其学习在通用消息解码器预训练期间抑制场景相关语义干扰。具体而言，SemGuard 将消息相关的 CLIP 文本特征与从未加水印的场景图像中提取的消息无关视觉特征相结合，构建出具有与目标高斯资产相关的可控语义干扰的训练表示。渐进式语义干扰课程逐步增加视觉特征的贡献，使解码器先学习可靠的消息表示，然后适应逐渐增强的场景相关语义干扰。在针对给定消息长度和语义图像池完成预训练后，解码器被冻结并在多个视觉语义被预训练数据覆盖的高斯资产上重复使用。在静态和动态高斯喷射资产上的实验表明，渲染保真度得到提升，同时水印提取依然可靠；而在静态资产上的评估进一步显示其对图像空间失真的鲁棒性得到增强。

title: WorldWeave: Rethinking Embodied Navigation through Cross-Task World Modeling
summary: Mobile embodied agents continuously alter their observations through their own motion, while external dynamics further shape future interactions. Different mobile embodied tasks therefore capture complementary patterns of state evolution, yet jointly learning world dynamics across such interactions remains less explored. We investigate this problem through Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) and Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT), which respectively involve navigation toward a stationary goal and interaction with a moving target. We propose WorldWeave, a cross-task world model that couples shared predictive dynamics with task-specific adaptation. Instead of conditioning state transitions on heterogeneous physical actions, WorldWeave learns latent actions from observed state changes via inverse-forward dynamics, establishing a shared transition representation across tasks. The resulting future-state predictions are adaptively integrated into task-specific representations for downstream decision making. Experiments across multiple VLN and EVT benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over specialized baselines.

AI.title_zh: WorldWeave：通过跨任务世界建模重新思考具身导航
AI.abstract_zh: 移动具身智能体通过自身运动不断改变其观测，而外部动态进一步塑造未来的交互。因此，不同的移动具身任务捕捉到互补的状态演化模式，然而跨此类交互联合学习世界动态仍较少被探索。我们通过视觉与语言导航（VLN）和具身视觉跟踪（EVT）研究这一问题，二者分别涉及朝向静止目标的导航以及与移动目标的交互。我们提出 WorldWeave，一个跨任务世界模型，它将共享的预测动态与任务特定适配相结合。WorldWeave 不将状态转移条件化于异构的物理动作，而是通过逆向-前向动态从观测到的状态变化中学习潜在动作，从而在任务之间建立共享的转移表示。由此得到的未来状态预测被自适应地整合到任务特定表示中，用于下游决策。在多个 VLN 和 EVT 基准上的实验表明，相较于专门化基线，该方法取得了一致的改进。

title: PhysPPF: Learning Robotic Manipulation with Past, Present, and Future Physical Representations
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced robotic manipulation, yet complex tasks requiring both precise 3D contact and long-horizon coordination remain challenging. Most existing studies enhance spatial perception or temporal reasoning in VLAs separately. Spatial methods primarily inject geometric or affordance priors into current-frame perception without tracking multi-step transitions, while history-aware and world-model VLAs typically capture past context or future dynamics in 2D feature or pixel spaces, either lacking explicit 3D contact cues or incurring high generation overhead. To address this, we propose PhysPPF, a VLA framework that performs unified spatiotemporal modeling in a compact physical token space. Spatially, WWH (What-Where-How) distills pretrained perception teachers exclusively during training into compact token groups capturing what 3D structures occupy the scene, where to interact, and how the gripper should approach, without test-time 3D encoders. Temporally, operating directly in this WWH space without pixel reconstruction, PPF (Past-Present-Future) consolidates executed states into a bounded past physical memory and jointly infers present and future physical tokens via an asymmetric world model. Parallel gated branches then inject these past, present, and future representations into a flow-matching action expert to guide manipulation without cross-temporal interference. Extensive experiments on SimplerEnv, CALVIN, and LIBERO show that PhysPPF consistently outperforms existing spatial, history-aware, and world-model VLAs with modest latency and parameter overhead, improving over the StarVLA baseline by +17.2 points on SimplerEnv, +29.3 points on CALVIN, and +3.5 points on LIBERO.

AI.title_zh: PhysPPF：基于过去、现在与未来物理表征学习机器人操作
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推动了机器人操作的发展，但既需要精确3D接触又需要长时程协调的复杂任务仍然具有挑战性。现有大多数研究分别增强VLA的空间感知或时间推理。空间方法主要将几何先验或可供性（affordance）先验注入当前帧感知中，而不跟踪多步状态转移；而具备历史感知能力的VLA和世界模型VLA通常在2D特征空间或像素空间中捕捉过去上下文或未来动态，要么缺乏显式的3D接触线索，要么带来高昂的生成开销。为解决这一问题，我们提出PhysPPF，一个在紧凑的物理token空间中进行统一时空建模的VLA框架。在空间维度上，WWH（What-Where-How，即"什么-何处-如何"）仅在训练期间从预训练感知教师模型中蒸馏知识，形成紧凑的token组，用以刻画场景中占据何种3D结构、应在何处交互以及夹爪应如何接近，且测试时无需3D编码器。在时间维度上，PPF（Past-Present-Future，即"过去-现在-未来"）直接在该WWH空间中运行而无需像素重建，将已执行状态整合为有界的过去物理记忆，并通过非对称世界模型联合推断当前与未来的物理token。随后，并行的门控分支将这些过去、现在和未来的表征注入基于流匹配（flow-matching）的动作专家中，以引导操作且不产生跨时间干扰。在SimplerEnv、CALVIN和LIBERO上的大量实验表明，PhysPPF以适度的延迟和参数开销，持续优于现有的空间型、历史感知型和世界模型型VLA，相较StarVLA基线在SimplerEnv上提升+17.2个点，在CALVIN上提升+29.3个点，在LIBERO上提升+3.5个点。

title: VG3R: Video Generation Model for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Video generation models are widely used as 3D priors for novel view synthesis and 3D scene generation. Fine-tuned for perception, generation models also excel at dense prediction such as depth estimation. However, methods that apply video generation models to 3D reconstruction either predict depth without cameras or generate geometry and estimate cameras through many iterative denoising steps, which makes them slower. In this paper, we present $\textbf{VG3R}$, which turns a pretrained video generation model into a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model. Our key observation is that such a model already captures the depth and camera motion of a video, but not in the form required for reconstruction. We introduce two components: $\textit{clip-level shift prediction}$, which corrects depth distortion caused by the unknown shift in decoded inverse depth, and a $\textit{multi-layer camera head}$, which predicts per-frame cameras parameters by combining features across transformer blocks. Using Wan2.1 as its video backbone, VG3R reconstructs a scene and estimate the camera of every frame without iterative denoising. It achieves the lowest ATE and reconstruction errors among methods built on video generation models, runs about 4 and 14 times faster than Aether and Geo4D. VG3R also demonstrates competitive depth estimation and 3D reconstruction performance compared with geometry foundation models. Project page: https://github.com/KTH-RPL/VG3R

AI.title_zh: VG3R：用于前馈三维重建的视频生成模型
AI.abstract_zh: 视频生成模型被广泛用作新视角合成与三维场景生成的三维先验。经微调用于感知任务后，生成模型在深度估计等稠密预测任务上也表现出色。然而，将视频生成模型应用于三维重建的方法，要么只预测深度而不预测相机，要么生成几何并通过大量迭代去噪步骤来估计相机，这使其速度较慢。本文提出 $\textbf{VG3R}$，将预训练的视频生成模型转变为前馈三维重建模型。我们的关键观察是：此类模型已经捕获了视频的深度和相机运动，但其形式并不符合重建所需。我们引入两个组件：$\textit{片段级位移预测}$（clip-level shift prediction），用于校正解码后的逆深度中未知位移所导致的深度畸变；以及$\textit{多层相机头}$（multi-layer camera head），通过融合各 Transformer 块的特征来预测逐帧相机参数。VG3R 以 Wan2.1 作为其视频骨干，无需迭代去噪即可重建场景并估计每一帧的相机。在基于视频生成模型的方法中，它取得了最低的 ATE 和重建误差，运行速度分别约为 Aether 和 Geo4D 的 4 倍和 14 倍。与几何基础模型相比，VG3R 还展现出具有竞争力的深度估计与三维重建性能。项目页面：https://github.com/KTH-RPL/VG3R

title: AlpaSafe: Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection for Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
summary: Reasoning-based driving vision-language-action (VLA) models propose multiple candidate trajectories at each decision, yet only one is executed. Standard evaluation scores the best candidate, assuming an oracle selector that deployment lacks, and leaves the risk of the executed candidate unexamined. Existing online evaluators typically close this gap with a purpose-trained scene or world model, often rolling out each candidate through it at inference time. We introduce AlpaSafe, a risk-aware trajectory selector that reuses the scene representation a frozen driving VLA computes while proposing its candidates. AlpaSafe reads the last hidden token of the VLA's prompt prefill. A lightweight head, trained on the closed-loop simulation outcomes of the candidates, fuses this token with each candidate trajectory and predicts a relative score and collision/offroad logits. A fixed rule removes candidates dominated on the two risk logits and selects the highest-scoring candidate among those remaining, adding neither rollouts nor VLA training. Experiments on 525 AlpaSim scenes show that AlpaSafe outperforms Alpamayo's default first-sample rule and uniform random selection in selected regret and top-1 agreement, and reduces the collision-at-fault or offroad rate from 6.41% and 6.10% to 4.93%. The selector has 1.7M parameters and takes 0.75 ms per decision.

AI.title_zh: AlpaSafe：面向自动驾驶中视觉-语言-动作模型的风险感知轨迹选择
AI.abstract_zh: 基于推理的驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在每次决策时提出多条候选轨迹，但仅执行其中一条。标准评估对最佳候选进行打分，这假定存在一个部署中并不具备的预言机选择器（oracle selector），并且未考察实际执行候选的风险。现有的在线评估器通常借助专门训练的场景模型或世界模型来弥补这一差距，往往在推理时让每条候选轨迹通过该模型进行推演（rollout）。我们提出 AlpaSafe，一种风险感知的轨迹选择器，它复用冻结的驾驶 VLA 在提出候选时所计算出的场景表示。AlpaSafe 读取 VLA 提示预填充（prompt prefill）的最后一个隐藏 token。一个轻量级头部（lightweight head）基于候选的闭环仿真结果进行训练，将该 token 与每条候选轨迹融合，并预测相对分数以及碰撞/偏离道路（collision/offroad）logits。一条固定规则剔除在两个风险 logits 上被支配的候选，并在剩余候选中选择得分最高者，既不需要额外的推演，也不需要训练 VLA。在 525 个 AlpaSim 场景上的实验表明，AlpaSafe 在选择后悔值（selected regret）和 top-1 一致性上优于 Alpamayo 的默认首样本规则和均匀随机选择，并将有责碰撞或偏离道路率从 6.41% 和 6.10% 降至 4.93%。该选择器具有 1.7M 参数，每次决策耗时 0.75 ms。

title: State of Mind: Learning and Evaluating World Models of Naturalistic Brain Dynamics
summary: Understanding naturalistic brain activity requires going beyond the stimulus alone, as external inputs continuously interact with an individual's evolving brain state. A world model captures such dynamics in a latent state by inferring it from neural observations, predicting stimulus-driven evolution, and updating with new observations. However, existing brain world models fail to maintain a persistent latent state over time, and standard metrics of neural prediction accuracy cannot tell whether a model tracks an individual's brain state or relies solely on the stimulus. To directly test state inference, prediction, and updating, we introduce BrainStateBench, which evaluates a model's latent state through a frozen linear probe on whole-cortex, movie-driven fMRI. Its State task tests whether a model captures trial-to-trial variability in an individual's responses to repeated stimuli, while Forecast and Updating evaluate future activity predictions without and with new observations, respectively. To track individual brain state across time, we propose Spectator, a linear latent world model trained with a joint-embedding predictive objective. Spectator encodes short- and long-horizon observation histories into a two-timescale latent state and predicts state transitions linearly from the current state and stimulus. Stimulus-only encoders reach 0.320 in fMRI prediction correlation without observing the brain (0% on State), while prior deep brain world models reach 0.239 yet score at most 0.4% on State. In contrast, Spectator achieves 0.349 correlation alongside 5.5% on State, 16.0% on Forecast, and 20.3% on Updating, outperforming all baselines while forecasting over 20x faster than deep forecasting models.

AI.title_zh: 心智状态：学习与评估自然主义大脑动力学的世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 理解自然主义的大脑活动需要超越仅依赖刺激本身，因为外部输入会与个体不断演化的大脑状态持续相互作用。世界模型通过在潜在状态中捕捉此类动力学：从神经观测中推断该状态、预测刺激驱动的演化，并利用新的观测进行更新。然而，现有的脑世界模型无法随时间维持持久的潜在状态，而标准的神经预测准确度指标也无法判断一个模型是在追踪个体的大脑状态，还是仅依赖刺激。为了直接检验状态推断、预测与更新，我们提出了 BrainStateBench，它通过在全皮层、电影驱动的 fMRI 上训练的冻结线性探针（frozen linear probe）来评估模型的潜在状态。其 State 任务检验模型是否捕捉到个体对重复刺激反应的逐试次（trial-to-trial）变异性，而 Forecast 与 Updating 则分别评估在没有新观测和有新观测情况下的未来活动预测。为了随时间追踪个体的大脑状态，我们提出了 Spectator，一个以联合嵌入预测目标（joint-embedding predictive objective）训练的线性潜在世界模型。Spectator 将短时程与长时程的观测历史编码为双时间尺度的潜在状态，并从当前状态与刺激出发线性地预测状态转移。仅依赖刺激的编码器在不观察大脑的情况下达到 0.320 的 fMRI 预测相关性（State 为 0%），而先前的深度脑世界模型达到 0.239，但在 State 上得分至多为 0.4%。相比之下，Spectator 达到 0.349 的相关性，同时在 State 上达到 5.5%、在 Forecast 上达到 16.0%、在 Updating 上达到 20.3%，在优于所有基线方法的同时，其预测速度比深度预测模型快 20 倍以上。

title: VICA: Video Contextual Agreement for AIGC Video Detection and Localization
summary: The rapid advancement of AI-generated content (AIGC) video generation and editing technologies has raised growing societal concerns about the authenticity and reliability of digital videos. Existing video detection methods primarily exploit temporal inconsistencies through holistic frame-level representations, whereas manipulation localization methods focus on artifacts within individual spatial regions. However, holistic representations may obscure localized artifacts through global feature aggregation, while region-centric approaches may overlook disagreements between individual regions and their surrounding spatiotemporal context. To address these limitations, we propose VIdeo Contextual Agreement (VICA), a unified framework that masks individual video regions and leverages a frozen V-JEPA model to predict their representations from the surrounding spatiotemporal context. Complementary masking ensures complete regional coverage, while context-conditioned predictions establish references for assessing regional agreement with the broader video context. By comparing predicted and observed representations, VICA derives spatial residuals that characterize intra-frame discrepancies and bidirectional temporal residuals that capture inconsistencies across preceding and subsequent frames. These residuals characterize contextual disagreements, providing a shared forensic representation for both tasks and shifting the focus from identifying isolated manipulation artifacts to assessing regional agreement with expectations inferred from the broader video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VICA achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks across multiple benchmarks, with strong generalization to unseen video generators and editing methods.

AI.title_zh: VICA：面向AIGC视频检测与定位的视频上下文一致性
AI.abstract_zh: AI生成内容（AIGC）视频生成与编辑技术的快速发展，引发了社会对数字视频真实性与可靠性的日益关注。现有的视频检测方法主要通过整体性的帧级表示来利用时间不一致性，而篡改定位方法则侧重于单个空间区域内的伪影。然而，整体性表示可能通过全局特征聚合掩盖局部伪影，而以区域为中心的方法则可能忽视单个区域与其周围时空上下文之间的不一致。为解决这些局限，我们提出视频上下文一致性（VIdeo Contextual Agreement, VICA），这是一个统一框架，它遮蔽视频中的各个区域，并利用冻结的V-JEPA模型从周围的时空上下文预测这些区域的表示。互补式遮蔽确保了对区域的完整覆盖，而以上下文为条件的预测则为评估区域与更广泛视频上下文之间的一致性建立了参照。通过比较预测表示与观测表示，VICA推导出刻画帧内差异的空间残差，以及捕捉前序与后续帧之间不一致性的双向时间残差。这些残差刻画了上下文不一致性，为两项任务提供了共享的取证表示，并将关注点从识别孤立的篡改伪影转向评估区域与由更广泛视频上下文推断出的预期之间的一致性。大量实验表明，VICA在多个基准上的两项任务中均取得了最先进的性能，并对未见过的视频生成器和编辑方法具有很强的泛化能力。

title: Plan Big, Paint Small: Semantic-Aware Computation Allocation for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion streams a video chunk by chunk, but large AR models are too slow for real-time use. We ask where in an AR rollout a large model is actually needed. Pairing Krea-Realtime-14B with Self-Forcing-1.3B, which share their latent space and denoising schedule, we find that the order of the two models matters: when the 14B model generates only the first chunk and the 1.3B model continues, the rollout keeps 95\% of the 14B model's semantic advantage, whereas the reverse allocation keeps 16\% at about ten times the cost. The large model decides what the video shows; the small model only has to carry it forward. We turn this into BigSmall, a training-free planner--renderer sampler. The 14B model plans the opening chunk and sketches the chunks in which content changes, which preserves motion, and the 1.3B model renders the rest; a faster variant, BigSmall, plans only the opening chunk. A cross-model KV cache that is approximate, windowed and lazy lets the planner leave and re-enter the rollout at low cost. On VBench, BigSmall is $3.02\times$ faster than the 14B model at an unchanged semantic score and motion, and $1.55\times$ faster than SDVG, which lets the small model draft first; BigSmall reaches $3.77\times$ at the same semantic score, trading away 10\% of the motion. On minute-long videos (LoCoT2V-Bench), where the 14B model degrades when it reads its own long history, BigSmall is $3.14\times$ faster than the 14B model and scores higher ($+1.78$).`

AI.title_zh: 大处规划，小处绘制：面向高效自回归视频生成的语义感知计算分配
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归（AR）视频扩散逐块地流式生成视频，但大型 AR 模型速度太慢，无法用于实时场景。我们探究在 AR  rollout（自回归展开）过程中，究竟哪个位置真正需要大模型。将共享同一潜空间与去噪调度（denoising schedule）的 Krea-Realtime-14B 与 Self-Forcing-1.3B 配对使用后，我们发现两个模型的顺序至关重要：当 14B 模型只生成第一个块、由 1.3B 模型继续生成时，该 rollout 保留了 14B 模型 95\% 的语义优势；而相反的分配方式在约十倍成本下仅保留 16\%。大模型决定视频呈现什么内容，小模型只需将其延续下去。我们据此提出 BigSmall——一种免训练（training-free）的规划器—渲染器（planner--renderer）采样器。14B 模型规划开头的块，并为内容发生变化的块绘制草图，从而保持运动，1.3B 模型渲染其余部分；一个更快的变体 BigSmall 仅规划开头的块。一种近似、窗口化且惰性（approximate, windowed and lazy）的跨模型 KV 缓存使规划器能够以低代价离开并重新进入 rollout。在 VBench 上，BigSmall 在语义分数与运动不变的情况下比 14B 模型快 $3.02\times$，比先由小模型起草的 SDVG 快 $1.55\times$；BigSmall 在相同语义分数下达到 $3.77\times$，代价是损失 10\% 的运动。在分钟级长视频（LoCoT2V-Bench）上——此时 14B 模型在读取自身长历史时性能下降——BigSmall 比 14B 模型快 $3.14\times$，且得分更高（$+1.78$）。

title: Knowing What You Carry: Scalable Physics-Anchored World Models for Robotic Planning with Liquid Payloads
summary: Payload-carrying robots, such as delivery robots and autonomous trucks, must choose motions that keep them and their payload safe, so their planners predict the outcome of each candidate motion. Modern planners compare thousands of candidates per step on a GPU, using world models such as batched simulators or learned predictors. Most of them assume a rigid payload, but a liquid payload keeps moving after a maneuver, and its state is rarely measured. Near a safety limit, small prediction errors can make an unsafe plan look safe. Coupled fluid simulations are accurate but too costly for every candidate, while low-order slosh models are cheap but accurate only away from resonance. We study this trade-off on a ground vehicle with a partly filled tank near its rollover limit. First, we build PLiMB (Parallel Liquid-MultiBody), a GPU-parallel slosh simulator that, to our knowledge, couples FLIP liquid two-way with many multibody vehicles for the first time. It provides training data and a high-fidelity reference. Second, we propose a scalable physics-anchored world model that combines a modal-slosh and roll prior, an estimate of the hidden liquid state from the vehicle's own motion history (no sensor in the tank), and a learned correction. Without simulating the fluid, it scores thousands of candidate plans in one batched pass within a 20 Hz control tick on one GPU. We judge each world model by the plans it leads a planner to choose. Near the rollover limit, planners that treat the liquid as a rigid payload or use published low-order slosh models repeatedly pick unsafe plans when a safe one exists. Ours never does in our standard tank and makes about half as many in a wide tank whose sloshing mode lies in the maneuver band. There, the liquid state left by earlier driving can change the best plan, and reading it from the vehicle's history halves our model's near-limit prediction error.

AI.title_zh: 知晓你所承载之物：面向液体载荷机器人规划的可扩展物理锚定世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 携带载荷的机器人，例如配送机器人和自动驾驶卡车，必须选择能保证自身及其载荷安全的运动，因此其规划器需要预测每个候选运动的后果。现代规划器在GPU上每一步比较数千个候选方案，所使用的世界模型包括批量化模拟器或学习型预测器。其中大多数方法假设载荷为刚体，但液体载荷在机动结束后仍会继续运动，且其状态很少被测量。在接近安全极限时，微小的预测误差可能使一个不安全的方案看起来是安全的。耦合流体仿真是准确的，但对每个候选方案而言代价过高；低阶晃动模型虽然廉价，但仅在远离共振时准确。我们在接近侧翻极限、部分充液罐体的地面车辆上研究这一权衡。首先，我们构建了PLiMB（Parallel Liquid-MultiBody，并行液体-多体），这是一种GPU并行晃动模拟器，据我们所知，它首次将FLIP液体的双向耦合与多个多体车辆耦合起来。它提供训练数据和高保真参考。其次，我们提出一种可扩展的物理锚定世界模型，它结合了模态晃动与侧倾先验、基于车辆自身运动历史对隐藏液体状态的估计（罐内无传感器）以及学习型修正。无需模拟流体，它就能在单个GPU上于20 Hz控制周期内以一次批处理完成对数千个候选方案的评分。我们以世界模型引导规划器所选择的方案来评判每个世界模型。在接近侧翻极限时，将液体视为刚性载荷或使用已发表的低阶晃动模型的规划器，在存在安全方案的情况下会反复选择不安全方案。我们的模型在标准罐体中从不如此，而在晃动模态位于机动频带的宽罐体中，其不安全方案数量约为前者的一半。在该宽罐体中，此前行驶所遗留的液体状态可能改变最优方案，而从车辆历史中读取该状态可将我们模型在接近极限时的预测误差减半。

title: CausalNTP: A World-Model Recipe for Causal Next-Token Prediction under Noisy Training-data
summary: This paper shows that transformer networks trained with next-token prediction (NTP) and gradient descent do not learn to make predictions using only causally-relevant tokens in the left context, irrespective of the causal ordering of tokens during training, and identifies the learning deficiencies responsible. We introduce a causal world-model setup, for which, we characterize the Bayes-optimal predictor under the causal view of the data. We then prove that, a function that distills its predictions to non-causal views of data, when realized under Occam's Razor, recovers the true causal predictor. Based on this analysis we propose CausalNTP, a practical training algorithm that approximates this theoretical recipe and trains transformers to depend only the causally relevant tokens in left-context. Empirically in the world-model setup, CausalNTP achieves out-of-distribution generalization that vanilla NTP cannot due to its theoretical limits, regardless of data and model scale. We show similar gains and behavior in the natural language question-answering setting as a proof-of-concept.

AI.title_zh: CausalNTP：噪声训练数据下因果下一词元预测的世界模型方法
AI.abstract_zh: 本文表明，使用下一词元预测（next-token prediction, NTP）和梯度下降训练的 transformer 网络并不会学会仅利用左上下文（left context）中与因果相关的词元进行预测，无论训练过程中词元的因果顺序如何，并指出了造成这一现象的学习缺陷。我们引入了一种因果世界模型（causal world-model）设定，并在该设定下，在数据的因果视角下刻画了贝叶斯最优预测器。随后我们证明，一个将其预测蒸馏到数据的非因果视角的函数，在奥卡姆剃刀（Occam's Razor）原则下实现时，能够恢复真实的因果预测器。基于这一分析，我们提出了 CausalNTP，一种实用的训练算法，它近似这一理论配方，并训练 transformer 仅依赖于左上下文中与因果相关的词元。在世界模型设定下的实证结果表明，CausalNTP 能够实现原始 NTP 因其理论局限而无法实现的分布外泛化，且与数据和模型规模无关。我们在自然语言问答设定中作为概念验证展示了类似的收益与行为。

title: Two Actions from One State: Fork Futures Teach JEPA World Models to Compare
summary: JEPA world models are trained to predict logged transitions but used to compare counterfactual actions from one state. The logged behavior data show one action per state, and under a local linear approximation we prove the action response is unidentified along any direction the policy never varies within a state. We therefore supplement behavior data with measured outcomes of alternative actions from the same state. Our fork futures execute two actions from one restored state, and their outcome difference cancels the state term, identifying the action response on the sampled span. The resulting model, Fork-JEPA, matches predicted to measured differences, anchors the logged successor with behavior prediction, and adds a lookback head that keeps the predecessor recoverable, all at training time, leaving planning unchanged. On three visual control tasks, behavior-only training leaves the predicted action effect no better than a constant guess. Fork-JEPA makes it readable and raises planning success by up to 14\% over LeWM, its base model. Where the action response changes across hidden zones, it nearly doubles cross-zone success, and 1,024 fork pairs beat 1.2M extra behavior steps. Our project is available at https://fork-jepa.github.io/.

AI.title_zh: 一状态双动作：分叉未来（Fork Futures）教 JEPA 世界模型进行比较
AI.abstract_zh: JEPA 世界模型被训练用于预测已记录的转移，却被用于比较同一状态下的反事实动作。已记录的行为数据在每个状态只显示一个动作，而在局部线性近似下，我们证明了：在策略于某个状态内从不变化的任何方向上，动作响应是不可辨识的。因此，我们用同一状态下替代动作的实测结果来补充行为数据。我们的分叉未来（fork futures）从一个恢复的状态出发执行两个动作，其结果之差抵消了状态项，从而在采样张成的空间上辨识出动作响应。由此得到的模型 Fork-JEPA 将预测差异与实测差异相匹配，用行为预测来锚定已记录的后继状态，并加入一个回溯头（lookback head）使前驱状态保持可恢复，所有这些都只在训练时进行，规划过程保持不变。在三个视觉控制任务上，仅用行为数据训练时，预测的动作效果并不优于常数猜测。Fork-JEPA 使其变得可读，并将规划成功率相较其基础模型 LeWM 提升最多 14\%。在动作响应随隐藏区域而变化的情形下，它几乎使跨区域成功率翻倍，并且 1,024 个分叉对胜过 120 万条额外的行为步。我们的项目见 https://fork-jepa.github.io/。

title: Toward Adversarially Robust World Models
summary: Latent dynamic world models have proven to be highly versatile tools for embodied artificial intelligence systems, enabling online action planning, safe policy evaluation, and scalable policy learning. However, this versatility makes world models a vulnerable and centralized point of failure as a compromised model can impact planning, evaluation, and training at once. Therefore it is critical that the security and robustness properties of world models are properly understood before they are universally deployed in embodied AI systems. In this work we take a unifying approach towards this understanding, developing two novel attacks against world models, named state hallucination and dynamic shift attacks, aimed directly at impacting downstream systems, and proposing a new theoretical lens through which to study the robustness of latent dynamic world models. Through our analysis we identify robust latent space encoders as the key component of robust world models. We empirically validate this finding on four separate latent dynamic world model families, studying Dino World Model, Le World Model, r2Dreamer, and Cosmos 3, demonstrating significant improvements in robustness through adversarial encoder model training.

AI.title_zh: 迈向对抗鲁棒的世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 潜变量动态世界模型已被证明是具身人工智能系统中高度通用的工具，能够支持在线动作规划、安全的策略评估以及可扩展的策略学习。然而，这种通用性使世界模型成为一个脆弱且集中的单点故障，因为一个被攻破的模型可以同时影响规划、评估和训练。因此，在世界模型被普遍部署于具身人工智能系统之前，正确理解其安全性和鲁棒性至关重要。在本工作中，我们采取一种统一的视角来推进这一理解，针对世界模型开发了两种新型攻击，分别称为状态幻觉攻击（state hallucination）和动态偏移攻击（dynamic shift attacks），二者直接针对影响下游系统，并提出了一种新的理论视角来研究潜变量动态世界模型的鲁棒性。通过我们的分析，我们确定鲁棒的潜空间编码器是鲁棒世界模型的关键组成部分。我们在四个独立的潜变量动态世界模型系列上对这一发现进行了实证验证，研究了 Dino World Model、Le World Model、r2Dreamer 和 Cosmos 3，展示了通过对抗性编码器模型训练在鲁棒性方面取得的显著提升。

title: Learning a Food World Model That Predicts the Next State from Production Data
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables: a 4-page paper with appendices. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Food assembly robots pick ingredients from a pan, and every pick must deliver a target weight. We learn a world model of food picking from 61,773 production picks, labeled automatically by a camera and a scale (self-supervised learning). From the pre-pick heightmap of the pan on a 2.5 mm grid, the commanded pick action, the food and the utensil, the model predicts the post-pick heightmap and the picked mass with uncertainty. We evaluate the mass prediction on 12,294 held-out picks of nine foods. The production controller keeps each pick near its commanded target. The model's root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 10.93 g is 9% lower than that of the commanded target or of a per-food mean. This RMSE is 24% lower than that of the controller's internal mass estimate. Gradient-boosted trees on 20 hand-crafted features have a 0.2 g lower RMSE, but they predict only the mass, not the next state that planning and policy learning need. Using the predicted uncertainty, we decline the most uncertain picks and answer 89.4% of picks with an RMSE of 10.28 g. The prediction barely responds to the commanded volume and depth, because they vary little in closed-loop production. The model also fails without warning at target weights not seen in training. Future directions include action-primitive conditioning and a more general model across foods and utensils. We give recommendations for learning world models from production data.

AI.title_zh: 从生产数据中学习预测下一状态的食物世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 食物装配机器人从锅中拾取食材，每一次拾取都必须达到目标重量。我们利用 61,773 次生产拾取学习了一个食物拾取的世界模型，这些拾取由相机和秤自动标注（自监督学习）。基于锅中拾取前的 2.5 mm 网格高度图、下发的拾取动作、食物和器具，该模型预测拾取后的高度图以及所拾取的质量，并给出不确定性。我们在九种食物的 12,294 次留出拾取上评估质量预测。生产控制器使每次拾取保持在其下发目标附近。该模型的均方根误差（RMSE）为 10.93 g，比下发目标或按食物均值的 RMSE 低 9%。该 RMSE 比控制器内部质量估计的 RMSE 低 24%。在 20 个手工特征上使用梯度提升树，其 RMSE 低 0.2 g，但它们只预测质量，而不预测规划与策略学习所需的下一状态。利用预测的不确定性，我们拒绝最不确定的拾取，并对 89.4% 的拾取给出回答，其 RMSE 为 10.28 g。该预测对下发体积和深度的响应很小，因为它们在闭环生产中的变化很小。该模型在训练中未出现过的目标重量上也会无预警地失效。未来方向包括以动作基元（action primitive）为条件，以及构建跨食物和器具的更通用模型。我们给出了从生产数据中学习世界模型的建议。

title: Scalable Beckmann Maps Improve One-step Generation
comment: 40 pages, 15 figures, 12 tables. Code and checkpoints: https://tullebulle.github.io/projects/sbm/
summary: Beckmann Transport Models (BTM) learn one-step generative maps end-to-end from data, without a teacher, a distillation stage, or pretrained features. We introduce Scalable Beckmann Maps (SBM), which bring to BTM the two ingredients behind the quality of modern multistep generators: classifier-free guidance (CFG) and a training recipe that scales, while keeping sampling at a single network evaluation. CFG combines conditional and unconditional velocity or score predictions, which a Beckmann map does not have. Our guidance rests on one observation: the BTM current is a positive multiple of an autonomous denoising field, to which CFG applies as it does to a velocity. With exact denoisers this gives guided BTM. In practice we substitute the map's own conditional and null predictions for the denoisers, which requires no additional network and introduces a bias that we characterize. We show that the guided update is consistent with a guided conservation equation, and that guidance can move the boundaries between basins, sending more noise to the modes a condition favors. Trained from scratch in the latent of a representation autoencoder, SBM reaches a one-step FID of 1.6 on ImageNet 256x256 without a teacher or a feature loss, outperforming the Improved-MeanFlow baseline with 3.2x fewer FLOPs. In text-to-image generation it reaches a GenEval score of 0.86 with one network evaluation. As a world model, where we train without guidance, the recipe alone outperforms DriftWorld on all five metrics of two robot-manipulation benchmarks, with 1.9-2.8x less training compute and no pretrained auxiliary feature encoder.

AI.title_zh: 可扩展的Beckmann映射改进一步生成
AI.abstract_zh: Beckmann传输模型（Beckmann Transport Models, BTM）无需教师模型、无需蒸馏阶段、也无需预训练特征，即可端到端地从数据中学习一步生成映射。我们提出可扩展Beckmann映射（Scalable Beckmann Maps, SBM），为BTM引入了支撑现代多步生成器质量的两项要素：无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance, CFG）以及可扩展的训练方案，同时将采样保持在单次网络评估。CFG将条件速度（velocity）或得分（score）预测与无条件预测相结合，而Beckmann映射并不具备这些预测。我们的引导方法基于一个观察：BTM的流（current）是一个自治去噪场（autonomous denoising field）的正倍数，而CFG可作用于该去噪场，正如其作用于速度一样。在精确去噪器下，这给出了带引导的BTM。在实践中，我们以映射自身的条件预测与空（null）预测替代去噪器，这无需额外的网络，并引入了一种偏差，我们对该偏差进行了刻画。我们证明引导更新与带引导的守恒方程相一致，并且引导可以移动盆地之间的边界，从而将更多噪声送往条件所偏好的众数（modes）。在表示自编码器（representation autoencoder）的潜空间（latent）中从零开始训练，SBM在ImageNet 256x256上达到1.6的一步FID，且无需教师模型或特征损失，在FLOPs少3.2倍的情况下优于Improved-MeanFlow基线。在文本到图像生成中，它以单次网络评估达到0.86的GenEval得分。作为世界模型，我们在不带引导的情况下训练，仅该训练方案就在两个机器人操作基准的全部五项指标上优于DriftWorld，训练算力少1.9–2.8倍，且无需预训练的辅助特征编码器。

title: A world model for longitudinal health-trajectory prediction in older adults across multinational cohorts
summary: Aging is characterized by continuously evolving health states, yet most existing prediction models focus on static health risk at isolated time points rather than explicitly modelling how health trajectories unfold over time. We developed a health world model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture to represent evolving health states and simulate future trajectories under specified actions. The model combines a state encoder, an action- and context-conditioned predictor, a stop-gradient target encoder, and clinical outcome heads. We trained the model on the US Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and evaluated it without refitting in the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA) and the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). Open-loop evaluation assessed discrimination and calibration for mortality and worsening of activities of daily living (ADL) and instrumental activities of daily living (IADL). In the held-out HRS test set, the areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) for mortality, ADL worsening, and IADL worsening were 0.89, 0.93, and 0.93 at the first horizon and 0.84, 0.84, and 0.85 at the fifth horizon, respectively. Predicted risks stratified subsequent outcomes across horizons. Across the evaluated horizons, mortality AUROC ranged from 0.867 to 0.881 in ELSA and from 0.796 to 0.801 in CHARLS. Simulated trajectories preserved the expected risk ordering across predefined action regimes. In counterfactual simulations, changes in lifestyle actions shifted predicted risks in directions consistent with observed associations. The model provides a framework for longitudinal risk prediction and action-conditioned simulation in older adults.

AI.title_zh: 一个用于跨国队列老年人纵向健康轨迹预测的世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 衰老的特征是不断演变的健康状态，然而现有的大多数预测模型关注的是孤立时间点上的静态健康风险，而不是显式地对健康轨迹如何随时间展开进行建模。我们开发了一个基于联合嵌入预测架构（Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture）的健康世界模型，用以表示不断演变的健康状态，并在指定动作下模拟未来轨迹。该模型结合了状态编码器、以动作和上下文为条件的预测器、停止梯度目标编码器以及临床结局预测头。我们在美国健康与退休研究（HRS）上训练该模型，并在不重新拟合的情况下在英国老龄化纵向研究（ELSA）和中国健康与退休纵向研究（CHARLS）中对其进行评估。开环评估考察了对死亡率以及日常生活活动能力（ADL）和工具性日常生活活动能力（IADL）恶化的区分度与校准度。在留出的 HRS 测试集中，死亡率、ADL 恶化和 IADL 恶化在第一个预测时域上的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）分别为 0.89、0.93 和 0.93，在第五个预测时域上分别为 0.84、0.84 和 0.85。预测风险在各预测时域上对后续结局进行了分层。在所评估的各预测时域上，ELSA 中的死亡率 AUROC 范围为 0.867 至 0.881，CHARLS 中为 0.796 至 0.801。模拟轨迹在预定义的动作方案之间保持了预期的风险排序。在反事实模拟中，生活方式动作的变化使预测风险朝着与观察到的关联一致的方向发生改变。该模型为老年人的纵向风险预测和以动作为条件的模拟提供了一个框架。

title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
summary: Reliable multimodal decision models must preserve semantic decisions across presentation changes, ignore irrelevant additions, and distinguish supporting from conflicting text, yet existing studies examine decision-interface biases and multimodal behavior separately without matched backbone comparisons. We introduce \textbf{MM-SystemOneBias}, evaluating 8 decision models and 5 backbones on 5,323 original instances across 9 datasets, 11 task scenarios, and 6 interventions: option order, option label, external judgment, image--text description, irrelevant information, and rating scale. Decision models remain sensitive across interventions: incorrect external judgments introduce errors in 20.14\% of originally correct responses on average, conflicting descriptions redirect decisions even when rejected in isolation, and answer probabilities on unchanged decisions show mean absolute shifts of 2.92\% to 8.97\%. Relative to backbones, decision models improve presentation, rating-scale, and irrelevant-information stability, yet face a trade-off on added text: they lose less accuracy to misleading cues while gaining less from correct judgments and often losing accuracy under consistent descriptions. These findings highlight visual grounding and probability robustness as key priorities.The code and dataset is available at https://github.com/ALIENS32/MM-SystemOneBias

AI.title_zh: MM-SystemOneBias：评估多模态 Jev 风格系统一（System One）决策模型中的偏差
AI.abstract_zh: 可靠的多模态决策模型必须在呈现方式变化时保持语义决策不变、忽略无关的添加内容，并区分支持性文本与冲突性文本，然而现有研究往往将决策界面偏差与多模态行为分开考察，缺乏在匹配骨干（backbone）条件下的比较。我们提出 \textbf{MM-SystemOneBias}，在 9 个数据集、11 个任务场景、6 类干预下的 5,323 个原始实例上评估 8 个决策模型和 5 个骨干：选项顺序、选项标签、外部判断、图文描述、无关信息和评分量表。决策模型在各干预下仍然敏感：不正确的���部判断平均在 20.14\% 的原本正确回答中引入错误；冲突性描述即使在被单独拒绝时，仍会改变决策方向；对未改变决策的回答概率，其平均绝对偏移为 2.92\% 至 8.97\%。相对于骨干模型，决策模型提升了呈现方式、评分量表和无关信息方面的稳定性，但在附加文本上存在权衡：它们因误导性线索损失的准确率较少，而从正确判断中获得的增益也较少，并且在一致性描述下往往损失准确率。这些发现凸显了视觉 grounding 与概率鲁棒性是关键优先事项。代码与数据集可在 https://github.com/ALIENS32/MM-SystemOneBias 获取。

title: Choose What Returns: Object-Aware KV Memory for Selective Recall in Interactive Video Generation
summary: Interactive long-video generation lets users build a story through successive prompts and reuse earlier characters and settings under new instructions. Existing memory methods retain past content, yet they often fail at precise selective recall, returning the wrong appearance of a person, mixing different people, or keeping an unrequested background. Based on our analysis of memory form and retrieval, we introduce an object-aware key--value (KV) memory framework for a frozen autoregressive diffusion generator. It keeps the original KV of tracked object regions, selects background KV outside them by attention-scores, and links each memory with a readable record of its source scene and observed appearance. An LLM selects the requested records, and a memory integrator supplies their KV for generation under the current prompt. We also introduce a six-scene evaluation that tests selective attribute modification, time-specific appearance recall, and multi-object composition, in which each person's requested past appearance changes across requests. Experiments show that our framework more reliably preserves each person's identity while reproducing their requested past appearance than existing memory methods, under both explicit scene references and natural-language cues.

AI.title_zh: 择其所需而返：面向交互式视频生成中选择性召回的对象感知KV记忆
AI.abstract_zh: 交互式长视频生成使用户能够通过连续提示词构建故事，并在新指令下复用先前的角色与场景。现有的记忆方法会保留过去的内容，但往往无法实现精确的选择性召回，会返回某个人物错误的 Appearance，混淆不同人物，或保留未被请求的背景。基于我们对记忆形式与检索的分析，我们为冻结的自回归扩散生成器引入了一个对象感知的键–值（KV）记忆框架。它保留被跟踪对象区域的原始 KV，通过注意力分数选取这些区域之外的背景 KV，并将每个记忆与其来源场景和所观察到外观的可读记录相链接。由 LLM 选取被请求的记录，记忆整合器在当前提示词下为生成提供其 KV。我们还引入了一个包含六个场景的评估，用于测试选择性属性修改、特定时间的外观召回以及多对象组合，其中每个人物被请求的过去外观会随请求而变化。实验表明，无论在显式场景引用还是自然语言线索下，我们的框架都比现有记忆方法更可靠地保持每个人物的身份，同时再现其被请求的过去外观。</abstract_zh>

title: ENGRAM: Reliability-Weighted Latent Fusion and Occlusion-Aware Layered Readout for Video World Models
summary: Camera-conditioned video world models aim to generate 3D-consistent videos from a single image along specified camera trajectories. However, set-union updates in latent spatial memory leave repeated observations unconsolidated, while frontmost-only readout limits simultaneous access to stored evidence at different depths. To address these limitations, we present ENGRAM, a latent spatial memory framework combining reliability-weighted latent fusion and occlusion-aware layered readout. Specifically, recursive fusion integrates geometrically and visually compatible observations in a channel-normalized latent space, consolidating repeated evidence into a shared scene representation. Layered readout exposes multiple depth-ordered latent candidates with their reliability and availability at each target cell. This gives the generator access to information from multiple surfaces as visibility changes. Explicit camera rays provide viewpoint information independently of memory coverage, while geometric consistency constraints guide memory updates. Memory retrieval uses a single projection at latent resolution, avoiding intermediate RGB rendering and VAE re-encoding. We adapt a pretrained video generator using only 256 training scenes. On 100 RealEstate10K test scenes, ENGRAM improves novel-view-synthesis and closed-loop PSNRs over Spatia by 0.82 and 4.48 dB, respectively. On a 200-case WorldScore evaluation subset, it achieves an average score of 67.78, exceeding Spatia by 3.31 points. Project page: https://wchkoutian.github.io/engram-website/.

AI.title_zh: ENGRAM：面向视频世界模型的可靠性加权隐空间融合与遮挡感知分层读出
AI.abstract_zh: 相机条件视频世界模型旨在从单张图像出发，沿指定的相机轨迹生成3D一致的视频。然而，隐空间空间记忆中的集合并集（set-union）更新会使重复观测未能被合并，而仅读取最前层的读出方式限制了对存储于不同深度的证据的同时访问。为解决这些局限，我们提出ENGRAM，一个结合可靠性加权隐空间融合与遮挡感知分层读出的隐空间空间记忆框架。具体而言，递归融合在通道归一化的隐空间中将几何与视觉上相容的观测进行整合，把重复证据合并为共享的场景表示。分层读出在每个目标单元处给出多个按深度排序的隐空间候选及其可靠性和可用性。这使生成器在可见性变化时能够访问来自多个表面的信息。显式相机射线独立于记忆覆盖范围提供视角信息，而几何一致性约束引导记忆更新。记忆检索在隐空间分辨率下使用单次投影，避免了中间RGB渲染与VAE重编码。我们仅使用256个训练场景对预训练视频生成器进行适配。在100个RealEstate10K测试场景上，ENGRAM在新视角合成和闭环PSNR上分别比Spatia提升0.82和4.48 dB。在包含200个案例的WorldScore评测子集上，它取得67.78的平均分，比Spatia高出3.31分。项目页面：https://wchkoutian.github.io/engram-website/。

title: Urban State Representation for Autonomous Mobility: A Survey of Multimodal Perception, Architectures, Datasets, and Benchmarks
comment: Accepted to the UrbanState Workshop at WACV 2027. 8 pages + references + 5-page supplementary appendix. Code and data: https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation
summary: Cities are sensed by many platforms at once: on-board cameras, LiDAR and radar on autonomous vehicles, roadside units at intersections, drones and satellites overhead, and the GNSS traces of millions of trips. Yet most learned representations are built for one platform, one city, and one task. We survey this fragmented landscape through a single lens, the Urban State Representation (USR): a georeferenced, layered, time-varying, uncertainty-aware state that any sensing platform can write to and any downstream task can read from. We (i) formalize USR and five desiderata for it, and relate it to bird's-eye-view (BEV) features, occupancy, vectorized maps, neural fields and 3D Gaussians, scene graphs, road-network graphs, language tokens, and world-model latents; (ii) organize sensing platforms, cross-view (ground-aerial) matching, fusion operators, 3D geometric foundation models, end-to-end and vision-language-action models, and generative world models and data engines in one taxonomy that spans sensors to decisions; (iii) compile 26 urban datasets and simulators across ego, cooperative (V2X), aerial, trajectory, and language settings, with a metric glossary, a cross-benchmark results snapshot, a trend analysis, and a platform-coverage gap analysis; and (iv) review applications and propose, as an outlook, USR-5, a five-test protocol with explicit references and one aggregate score for measuring whether a state is shared, together with a research agenda of six open problems covering cross-city and cross-sensor transfer, uncertainty, efficiency, sim-to-real evaluation, and governance. This survey is an entry point for computer vision, autonomous driving, transportation, and urban computing researchers; the paper list, datasets, and USR-5 code are at https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation.

AI.title_zh: 面向自主移动的城市状态表征：多模态感知、架构、数据集与基准综述
AI.abstract_zh: 城市同时被众多平台所感知：自动驾驶车辆上的车载摄像头、LiDAR 与雷达，路口的路侧单元，空中的无人机与卫星，以及数百万次出行产生的 GNSS 轨迹。然而，大多数学习得到的表征都是为单一平台、单一城市和单一任务而构建的。我们通过一个统一的视角来综述这一碎片化的格局，即城市状态表征（Urban State Representation, USR）：一种带地理参考的、分层的、随时间变化的、感知不确定性的状态，任何感知平台都可以向其写入，任何下游任务都可以从中读取。我们：(i) 对 USR 及其五项期望属性进行形式化，并将其与鸟瞰图（bird's-eye-view, BEV）特征、占据、矢量化地图、神经场与 3D 高斯、场景图、路网图、语言 token 以及世界模型隐变量联系起来；(ii) 将感知平台、跨视角（地面—空中）匹配、融合算子、3D 几何基础模型、端到端与视觉—语言—动作模型，以及生成式世界模型与数据引擎，组织为一个从传感器到决策的统一分类体系；(iii) 汇总 26 个城市数据集与模拟器，涵盖自车、协同（V2X）、空中、轨迹与语言等设定，并提供指标术语表、跨基准结果快照、趋势分析以及平台覆盖缺口分析；以及 (iv) 综述相关应用，并作为展望提出 USR-5，即一套包含显式引用与单一聚合分数的五测试协议，用于衡量某一状态是否被共享，同时提出涵盖跨城市与跨传感器迁移、不确定性、效率、仿真到真实（sim-to-real）评估与治理这六个开放问题的研究议程。本综述是计算机视觉、自动驾驶、交通与城市计算研究者的入门参考；论文列表、数据集与 USR-5 代码见 https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation。

title: ReMiC: Representation-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Minimax Hierarchical Clustering
summary: 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning. However, their reliance on multi-view inputs produces long visual token sequences, imposing substantial computational overhead during inference. Existing pruning methods often rely on token salience or feature diversity as proxies for representativeness, without explicitly modeling the representation gap between the original token set and the retained subset, thereby leading to suboptimal representation of the original scene. In this paper, we propose ReMiC, a training-free, representation-driven token pruning framework based on minimax hierarchical clustering. ReMiC treats retained tokens as prototypes for the original observations, formulating pruning as minimizing the maximum representation error under a fixed token budget. Local prototype initialization allocates tokens according to regional representation needs, while global prototype refinement updates the selected prototypes using cross-region information to further reduce the maximum representation error. Extensive experiments conducted on three representative 3D VLMs across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. Notably, by retaining only 10% of visual tokens, ReMiC preserves 93.2% of the performance of Video-3D LLM and achieves a $2.04\times$ faster inference speed.

AI.title_zh: ReMiC：面向3D VLMs的表示驱动型Token剪枝——基于极小极大层次聚类
AI.abstract_zh: 3D视觉-语言模型（3D VLMs）在3D场景理解与空间推理方面已展现出强大的能力。然而，它们对多视图输入的依赖会产生冗长的视觉token序列，在推理过程中带来大量的计算开销。现有的剪枝方法往往依赖token显著性（token salience）或特征多样性作为代表性的替代指标，而没有显式地建模原始token集合与所保留子集之间的表示差距，从而导致对原始场景的表示不够理想。本文提出ReMiC，一个无需训练的、表示驱动的token剪枝框架，基于极小极大层次聚类（minimax hierarchical clustering）。ReMiC将保留的token视为原始观测的原型，将剪枝表述为在固定token预算下最小化最大表示误差的问题。局部原型初始化根据各区域的表示需求分配token，而全局原型细化则利用跨区域信息更新所选原型，以进一步降低最大表示误差。在三个代表性3D VLM上、跨五个3D场景理解基准所进行的大量实验证明了本方法的有效性与泛化能力。值得注意的是，仅保留10%的视觉token，ReMiC便保持了Video-3D LLM 93.2%的性能，并实现了$2.04\times$的推理加速。

title: Seeing the Invisible: How Vision-Language Models Read, Predict and Trace Radio Fields
summary: Operating in the physical world requires reasoning beyond what cameras directly capture. In a city, radio signals are invisible to the lens, yet their strength is governed by the buildings and streets an image does show. Given only these visible structures, can vision-language models (VLMs) infer the invisible radio field they shape? Probing true physical reasoning requires exact fields in real cities, alongside controlled interventions where a single physical factor changes. We build a label-free engine that turns any coordinate on Earth into a ray-traceable city, simulates matched single-factor counterfactuals, and computes every answer exactly. This yields RadioVISTA, a benchmark and training dataset for visual reasoning about invisible fields. Physically, a radio field is the sum of its propagation paths, yet across six continents we uncover a striking field-path dissociation: frontier VLMs accurately judge where a field is strong, but fail to tell whether a single direct or one-wall path exists. Open models fail even earlier at reading the field itself, and are systematically wrong, scoring below random guessing even when credited for any of four attempts. On unseen cities, fine-tuning brings a 9B open model close to frontier proprietary models on fields, yet neither supervised nor reinforcement fine-tuning improves path tracing. Supervising only final answers teaches models to approximate the field, yet leaves single-path geometry out of reach.

AI.title_zh: 看见不可见之物：视觉-语言模型如何阅读、预测与追踪无线电场
AI.abstract_zh: 在物理世界中运行，需要超越相机直接捕获内容的推理能力。在一座城市中，无线电信号对镜头而言是不可见的，然而其强度却由图像所显示的建筑和街道所支配。仅给定这些可见结构，视觉-语言模型（VLM）能否推断出由它们所塑造的不可见无线电场？要检验真正的物理推理，需要在真实城市中获取精确的场，并配合单一物理因素发生变化的受控干预。我们构建了一个无需标注的引擎，可将地球上的任意坐标转化为可进行射线追踪的城市，模拟匹配的单因素反事实情形，并精确计算每一个答案。由此产生了 RadioVISTA，一个用于关于不可见场的视觉推理的基准与训练数据集。在物理上，无线电场是其各传播路径之和，然而横跨六大洲，我们揭示出一种引人注目的场-路径分离现象：前沿 VLM 能准确判断场在何处较强，却无法判断是否存在单条直接路径或单次穿墙路径。开放模型在阅读场本身这一步就更早失败，并且系统性地出错，即使按四次尝试中任意一次正确计分，其得分仍低于随机猜测。在未见过的城市上，微调使一个 9B 开放模型在场方面接近前沿专有模型，然而无论是监督微调还是强化学习微调，都未能改善路径追踪。仅对最终答案进行监督会教会模型近似场，却使单路径几何仍然无法企及。

title: NOVA: Normalization-Aware Output-Guided Attention Acceleration for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) have become the main backbone for video generation. The quadratic cost of self-attention limits their efficiency at high resolutions and long durations. Existing sparse attention methods often rely on preserving high attention weights. However, these criteria do not fully capture the fidelity of the final value-weighted output, whose error depends jointly on changes to the attention numerator and the softmax denominator. We propose NOVA, a coarse-to-fine sparse attention framework that first approximates the full normalized output using size-weighted key/value centroids. Building on this estimate, we construct a residual proxy that accounts for coupled numerator-denominator errors by centering value contributions around the estimated output. This proxy guides the selection of query-key blocks for refinement under a predefined block budget for each query cluster. Selected blocks are evaluated through exact token-level computation, while the remaining blocks contribute through their centroids under a shared softmax normalization. On five vDiTs, NOVA achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among sparse attention methods, improving PSNR by up to 1.55\,dB over the strongest baseline, while delivering up to 1.82$\times$ end-to-end speedup on an H100 GPU.

AI.title_zh: NOVA：面向视频扩散Transformer的归一化感知输出引导注意力加速
AI.abstract_zh: 视频扩散Transformer（vDiTs）已成为视频生成的主要骨干架构。自注意力的二次方开销限制了其在高分辨率和长时长下的效率。现有的稀疏注意力方法往往依赖于保留高注意力权重。然而，这些准则并不能完全刻画最终价值加权输出的保真度，其误差同时取决于注意力分子与softmax分母的变化。我们提出NOVA，一种由粗到细的稀疏注意力框架，它首先使用按规模加权的键/值质心（size-weighted key/value centroids）来近似完整的归一化输出。在这一估计的基础上，我们构建了一个残差代理（residual proxy），通过将价值贡献围绕估计输出进行中心化，来考虑分子与分母的耦合误差。该代理在针对每个查询簇的预定义块预算下，引导选择用于精化的查询-键块。被选中的块通过精确的令牌级计算进行评估，而其余块则在共享的softmax归一化下通过其质心作出贡献。在五个vDiTs上，NOVA在稀疏注意力方法中取得了最佳的PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS，相较最强基线将PSNR最高提升1.55 dB，同时在H100 GPU上实现最高1.82$\times$的端到端加速。

title: VidRouteBench: A Benchmark for Budgeted Video-Generation Routing
summary: Text-to-video generators differ by two orders of magnitude in price, and a cheap configuration of a strong model is often good enough for a prompt. Routing prompts across such arms (model x sampling configuration) should buy quality at fixed budget, but no dataset supports studying it: public video-preference sets contain only closed models, one configuration each. We release VidRouteBench: 16 arms from 7 open families spanning 121x in measured cost ($0.0025-$0.298 per clip), 27,110 clips (1,421 A800-hours) over 1,625 grouped prompts, a quality score frozen after calibration against human preferences (68.7% CV accuracy vs 66.2% for the best single scorer), per-clip scores on 9 identifiable quality dimensions, repeated seeds, an encrypted test split, and a sealed newest family for cold start. The evaluator compares a router against the best prompt-agnostic mixture of arms, not the best single arm. Per-prompt specialisation here is real and predictable (oracle gap 0.642, 47% reproducible across seeds, prompt-arm interaction F=4.47 at p=1.6e-63), unlike LLM-routing arms, where the same pipeline finds none. We then propose OPMU (one probe, many utilities): label a new arm on K probe prompts, predict its 9 dimensions once, and serve any scenario utility by scalarising afterwards. Over 215 utility directions OPMU Pareto-dominates the prompt-agnostic baseline for 94% of directions versus 90% for per-scenario routers, with no per-scenario retraining. Three baselines fail instructively: bag-of-words features lose almost all routing gain in the low-data regime (0.009 vs 0.168); crediting a new arm with its probe average is harmful (-3.32 recovery) although it is the strong baseline on RewardBench-style arms (0.786); Chebyshev scalarisation does not help, our cost-utility front being convex.

AI.title_zh: VidRouteBench：一个面向预算受限视频生成路由的基准
AI.abstract_zh: 文本到视频生成器之间的价格相差两个数量级，而对于某个提示词而言，强模型的一种廉价配置往往就已足够。在此类"臂"（模型 × 采样配置）之间对提示词进行路由，应当能在固定预算下买到质量，但目前没有任何数据集支持对这一问题的研究：公开的视频偏好数据集只包含闭源模型，且每个模型只有一种配置。我们发布 VidRouteBench：来自 7 个开源家族的 16 个臂，实测成本跨度达 121 倍（每段视频 $0.0025–$0.298），涵盖 1,625 个分组提示词上的 27,110 段视频（1,421 A800 小时），一个在经人类偏好校准后冻结的质量分数（交叉验证准确率 68.7%，而最佳单一评分器为 66.2%），在 9 个可识别质量维度上的逐视频分数，重复随机种子，一个加密测试划分，以及一个用于冷启动的密封最新家族。评测器将路由器与最佳的提示词无关的臂混合进行比较，而非与最佳单一臂比较。此处的逐提示词特化是真实且可预测的（oracle 差距 0.642，其中 47% 可在不同随机种子间复现，提示词–臂交互 F=4.47，p=1.6e-63），这与 LLM 路由中的臂不同——在同一流程下后者未发现此类特化。随后我们提出 OPMU（one probe, many utilities，一次探测、多种效用）：在 K 个探测提示词上为一个新臂打标签，一次性预测其 9 个维度，之后通过标量化即可服务于任意场景效用。在 215 个效用方向上，OPMU 在 94% 的方向上帕累托优于提示词无关基线，而逐场景路由器为 90%，且无需逐场景重新训练。三个基线以富有启发性的方式失败：词袋特征在低数据情形下几乎丧失了全部路由收益（0.009 对 0.168）；用新臂的探测平均值来记分是有害的（恢复值为 -3.32），尽管它在 RewardBench 风格的臂上是强基线（0.786）；Chebyshev 标量化没有帮助，因为我们的成本–效用前沿是凸的。

title: Causal Dioramas: Controllable Video Generation, Revision and Editing via Intervention
summary: Two centuries ago, an early cinema-like theater called the Diorama could already control its scenes at will. Today's video generation models produce videos of near-cinematic quality, yet they still lack this controllability. This limitation stems from the inherent semantic gap between text and pixels, since a prompt can describe a video only coarsely and leaves its details and relations beyond control. We bring this ability to video generation with Causal Dioramas, modules that decompose a video into a concept graph of variables that can be intervened on individually. Each instruction is translated into an intervention on the concept graph, modifying the specified concepts and their dependents. A connector then conveys this intervention to the video generator, which reuses the original noise to produce a counterfactual video while preserving all other content. Building on Causal Dioramas, we develop a unified framework for controllable generation, counterfactual revision of generated videos and editing of real videos. We outperform both open-source and commercial models in controllability on T2V-CompBench, CoVEBench and OpenVE-Bench.

AI.title_zh: 因果透景画：通过干预实现可控视频生成、修订与编辑
AI.abstract_zh: 两个世纪前，一种名为透景画（Diorama）的早期类电影剧场就已经能够随意控制其场景。如今，视频生成模型能够生成接近电影质量的视频，却仍然缺乏这种可控性。这一局限源于文本与像素之间固有的语义鸿沟，因为一段提示词只能粗略地描述视频，而使其细节与相互关系无法被控制。我们通过因果透景画（Causal Dioramas）将这一能力引入视频生成，该模块将视频分解为一个由变量构成的概念图（concept graph），其中的变量可以被单独干预。每条指令都被翻译为对概念图的一次干预，修改指定的概念及其依赖项。随后，一个连接器将该干预传递给视频生成器，生成器复用原始噪声以生成反事实视频，同时保留所有其他内容。基于因果透景画，我们开发了一个统一框架，用于可控生成、对已生成视频的反事实修订以及对真实视频的编辑。在 T2V-CompBench、CoVEBench 和 OpenVE-Bench 上，我们在可控性方面优于开源模型和商业模型。
